blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Ask SD3.5-Medium for twelve of an object and then, from the same starting noise, for twenty-five. The picture keeps its layout, but the count changes about as much as it would under a new random seed, and in no consistent direction. We study what number words do once a request passes about ten objects, in five open text-to-image models. Holding the object and the starting noise fixed, we change one thing at a time, and people who never see the request count 3,088 of the images. Every model follows the number for small crowds, but only up to a point, its reach: SD3.5-M and FLUX.1-dev stop following it soon after ten, while FLUX.2 [klein] and Qwen-Image follow it loosely up to twenty-five. Beyond SD3.5-M's reach, the coarse part of the starting noise fixes the composition of the picture but not how many objects it holds: redrawing only the noise finer than an eighth of the image keeps the layout as well as a new number does, and already moves the count two-thirds as far. The number word still reaches the denoiser and acts in its first steps, but nothing we tried gives it a clear direction. Shown instead as a noised grid in the starting latent, the count is drawn: people find it in 59% of images, against 4% when it is only told. Past ten, an exact-match score barely separates a model that follows the number loosely from one that ignores it, and a relative-error score can even prefer a constant guess of sixteen. A same-noise test with a few requests per object tells them apart.
blocks.zh: 问SD3.5-中度一个物体的十二个,然后从同一个起始噪声,为二十五个. 图片保持其布局,但计数变化在新随机种子下会达到多少,没有一致的方向. 我们研究当一个请求通过大约十个对象时,在五个开放的文本到图像模型中,字词会做什么. 持有物体和开始的噪音固定,我们一次改变一件事,从未看到请求的人数到3,088. 每个模型都跟随小群数,但只达到一个点,其影响范围:SD3.5-M和FLUX.1-dev在10之后不久就停止跟随它,而FLUX.2[klein]和Quen-Image则松散跟随它高达25. 在SD3.5-M的伸手范围之外,开始噪声的粗糙部分会固定画面的构成,但不会固定它持有的物体数量:只重绘噪声细于图像的八分之一保持布局以及新数字,并且已经移动了三分之二的计数到远处. 数字单词仍然传到denoiser,并在它的最初步骤中行动,但是我们没有尝试给它一个明确的方向. 相反,在开始的潜伏中显示为一个噪声网格,它被绘制出来:人们在59%的图像中找到它,而只有4%的图像才被告知。 过去10年,一个精确的比分几乎将一个跟随数字松散的模型与一个忽略它的模式分开,一个相对的比分甚至可以选择一个恒定的猜测16. 同样的噪音测试,每个对象都有几个请求,将它们分开。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Ask a text-to-image model for twenty cream pitchers and you will rarely get twenty. Counting is one of the most persistent failures of these models [ 24 , 55 , 18 ] , and it worsens with the number: past ten objects, open and closed models are rarely exact [ 18 , 45 , 56 ] . That much is known. What is not known is whether the number word still does anything there. A model that follows the number loosely and a model that ignores it are both rarely exact, so an exact-match rate cannot tell them apart ( Fig. 2 ). Recent work points to the starting noise, which fixes much of a picture’s layout early in sampling [ 68 , 17 ] . Zhao et al . [ 68 ] find that in a model fine-tuned on synthetic counts, a fixed noise tends to give the same count whatever the prompt asks. If the noise sets the count, what is left for the number word?
blocks.zh: 问20个奶油投手的文字对图像模型 你很少得到20个 计数是这些模型中最持续的失败之一[24,55,18],随着数字的出现而恶化:过去十个对象,开放和封闭的模型很少精确[18,45,56]. 这是众所周知的。 不详的是数字词是否仍然在那里做任何事情. 遵循数字松散的模型和忽略它的模型都是很少精确的,因此精确的匹配率无法将它们区分开来(图2). 近期的作品指出开始的噪音,这在早期的采样中就对一幅图的布局做出了许多固定[68,17]. Zhao et al. [68]发现,在对合成计数进行精细调整的模型中,固定的噪声往往会给出同样的计数,无论即时问候. 如果噪音设定计数,数字单词还剩下什么?

blocks.en: We answer with same-noise interventions. Sampling is deterministic, so an object and a starting noise define a picture, and we can change one thing at a time: the number, the seed, the spelling of the number, an unrelated word, or only the fine-scale part of the noise. The test is simple. If the number still steers the crowd, the larger request should give more objects from the same noise, and a new number should move the count further than changes that do not touch it. We run it in five open models, from SDXL [ 50 ] to FLUX.2 [klein] [ 7 ] and Qwen-Image [ 60 ] , count every image with three detectors, and have 3,088 of the images counted by people who never see the request.
blocks.zh: 我们以同样的噪音发言来回答。 采样是决定性的,所以一个对象和一个开始的噪声可以定义一个画面,我们可以一次改变一件事:数字,种子,数字的拼写,一个无关的单词,或者只有噪音的细度部分. 测试很简单。 如果数字仍然引导着人群,较大的请求应该从相同的噪音中给出更多的对象,一个新的数字应该比不触摸它的改变更能移动计数. 从SDXL[50]到FLUX.2[Klein][7]和Quen-Image[60],我们用5个开放模型运行,用3个探测器计算每个图像,并且有3,088个从未看到请求的人统计的图像.

blocks.en: The answer turns on a split between layout and count ( ). Past the range of requests that SD3.5-M follows, a new number from the same noise keeps the picture’s layout, much as Zhao et al . observed, but not its count: the count changes about as much as under a new random seed, and in no consistent direction. Redrawing only the noise finer than an eighth of the image keeps the layout just as well and already moves a large crowd’s count two-thirds as far. Past the reach, the coarse part of the starting noise fixes the composition of the picture, but not how many objects it holds. Four findings build this picture.
blocks.zh: 答案在布局和计数( ) 之间展开分割 。 在SD3.5-M所遵循的要求范围过去,来自同一噪声的新数字保持了画面的布局,与赵等人所观察到的一样,但并不是它的计数:计数变化与新随机种子下的变化大致相同,而且方向不一致。 重新绘画的噪音小于图像的八分之一, 过了距离,开始噪音的粗糙部分会固定图片的构成,但不会固定它持有多少物体. 四个调查结果形成了这一画面。

blocks.en: Each model follows the number only so far ( Sec. 4 ). Every model follows small numbers: from two to eight objects, a larger request gives more objects in 80–99% of the same-noise pairs whose counts differ. Past ten the models part ways. SD3.5-M and FLUX.1-dev stop following the number soon after ten, while FLUX.2 [klein] and Qwen-Image follow it up to twenty-five about as loosely as a noisy estimator would. We call the range a model follows its reach .
blocks.zh: 每个型号只沿用至今的编号(sec.4 . 每个模型都遵循小数字:从2到8个对象,一个更大的请求给出了80~99%的相同噪声的对数不同的对象. 过去的10个模型 部分的方式。 SD3.5-M和FLUX.1-dev在10之后不久就停止了编号,而FLUX.2[klein]和Quen-Image则跟随大约25个像吵闹的估测器一样松散地进行追踪. 我们称范围为模式,

blocks.en: Past the reach, the count changes beneath a kept layout ( Sec. 5 ). In SD3.5-M, fine-scale noise moves crowds of every size. Within the reach, a new number moves the count further than a redraw of the fine noise, and toward the request. Past it, the redraw moves the count two-thirds as far as the number, by detectors and by people alike, and the number has no direction.
blocks.zh: 超过距离后, 计数会在保留布局下变化( 第 5 节) 。 在SD3.5-M中,细度噪声会移动各种大小的人群. 在可以达到的范围内,一个新的数字移动计数比重新绘制细微的噪音更远,并朝请求方向移动. 通过它,重画移动 三分之二的计数到数字, 通过探测器 和同样的人, 数字没有方向。

blocks.en: The number arrives, without a direction ( Sec. 6 ). The large number can be read off SD3.5-M’s conditioning in order, and in all three models we timed, number words act in the first denoising steps. Nothing we tried gives the large number a clear direction, from amplifying it to fine-tuning on counted crowds.
blocks.zh: 数字到达,没有方向(第6节). 大量数字可以按顺序从SD3.5-M的调制中读取,在我们所有三种模型中,数字单词在第一个去诺步骤中作用. 我们没有尝试过任何方法给大量人一个明确的方向,从扩充到微调人数。

blocks.en: A large count can be shown instead ( Sec. 7 ). Started from a noised grid of its own object, SD3.5-M draws the requested count in 59% of images by people’s counts, against 4% from the prompt. A planted count survives a conflicting number word, while a different object word repaints the grid. A layout written into the noise can carry the count, as Zhao et al . ’s count-aware noise prior does; the random noise’s own layout does not.
blocks.zh: 可以显示一个大数目(第7节)。 SD3.5-M从自己物体的噪声网开始, 一个被植入的计数在冲突的数字单词中幸存下来,而另一个对象单词则重新粉刷网格. 在噪音中写入的布局可以像赵等人之前的计数意识噪声那样携带计数;随机噪声本身的布局则不会.

blocks.en: These results also bear on measurement: past ten, exact-match and relative-error scores barely tell following from ignoring, and a same-noise order can.
blocks.zh: 这些结果也影响到测量:过去10年,精确的比分和相对的比分几乎无法从忽略中得知,同样噪声的顺序也可以。

blocks.en: Contributions. (1) A same-noise protocol, with a fine-scale redraw of the noise and a reference read through people’s own counting noise, and people’s counts of 3,088 generated images, which we will release. (2) The reach of five open models. (3) The finding that past SD3.5-M’s reach the layout and the count come apart: a large crowd’s count changes with noise finer than the layout, the number word changes it about as much as a new seed and without a direction, and a count supplied as a layout is drawn far more often. Unlike Zhao et al . [ 68 ] , who fine-tune a model on synthetic counts, we test off-the-shelf models, separate the noise’s layout from its fine detail, and compare the number with controls that leave its value alone.
blocks.zh: 捐款。 (1)同声协议,对噪声进行精细的重排,通过人们自己计数的噪声读取参考文献,以及3,088人计数生成的图像,我们将发布. (2)五个开放模式的覆盖范围. (3)关于过去SD3.5-M的算法到达布局和计数的发现:一个大群的计数变化比布局更细,数字单词改变的大概是一个新的种子,没有方向,一个作为布局提供的计数被画得更频繁. 与赵等人[68]不同的是,他微调了合成计数模型,我们测试现成的模型,将噪声的布局与它的细微细节区分开来,并将数字与留下其价值的控件进行比较.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Counting past ten. Counting is a standard category of compositional benchmarks [ 14 , 22 , 25 ] , and dedicated benchmarks show scores falling with the number for open, closed and recent large models [ 24 , 18 , 56 ] . Prompt refinement does not help [ 18 ] , and a benchmark that grades counts by relative error finds grid layouts best [ 56 ] . Generated counts up to ten behave like estimates whose errors grow with the number [ 55 ] , and numeral features in FLUX.1 [schnell] order more against fewer objects without sharp values [ 41 ] . We add a test that tells following from ignoring.
blocks.zh: 数十过. 计数是构成基准的标准类别[14,22,25],专用基准显示的分数随开放,封闭和近期大型模型的数下降[24,18,56]. 迅速的完善无助于[18],一个通过相对误差计数的基准发现网格布局最好[56]. 生成的计数最多为十种行为,如其误差随数字[55]而增加,以及FLUX.1中的数字特性,[schnell]顺序比没有锐值的较少对象要多[41]. 我们增加一个测试 说明从忽略。

blocks.en: The noise and the layout. The starting noise fixes much of the layout early in sampling [ 3 , 58 , 40 , 11 ] , its low frequencies carry coarse structure [ 13 , 61 ] , and a seed tends to keep where objects go and how large they are across prompts for the same object [ 63 ] . Zhao et al . [ 68 ] find that in FLUX.1-dev fine-tuned on synthetic counts a fixed noise tends to give the same count whatever the prompt asks, that a diffusion classifier built from the model separates counts only coarsely, and that fine-tuning on counted images helps mainly below ten; their count-aware noise prior raises exact counts from 20% to 85% on a synthetic set of up to fifty objects. Gu et al . [ 17 ] adjust the noise and the early cross-attention at test time. We hold the noise fixed in off-the-shelf models and measure what the word does on top of it, with a new seed, a respelling, an unrelated edit and a fine-scale redraw as controls, since swapping one word under a fixed noise can reshuffle a picture [ 20 ] . Our results qualify theirs for these models: the fixed noise keeps the layout, but past the reach it does not keep the count.
blocks.zh: 声和布局. 开始的噪音在取样早期就对布局进行了很大程度的修补[3,58,40,11],其低频率承载粗糙的结构[13,61],一个种子往往会保留物体去的地方,并且它们横跨同一物体的提示大小[63]. 赵等. [68] 在FLUX中发现. 对合成计数进行1-dev微调的固定噪声往往会随即给出同样的计数,从模型中构建的扩散分类器只粗略地进行计数,对计数图像进行微调主要帮助在10以下;其计数意识噪声之前,其精确计数从20%提高到85%,在50个物体的合成组上。 Gu et al. [17] 在测试时调整噪声和早期交叉注意. 我们把固定在现成模型中的噪声,并测量词的顶部,用新的种子,翻转,不相关的编辑和精细的重划作为控制,因为在一个固定噪声下交换一个词可以重排一个图片[20]. 我们的结果符合他们对这些模型的要求:固定的噪声能保持布局,但过了它到达的地方它不能保持计数.

blocks.en: When the word acts. Text conditioning acts mostly early in sampling [ 2 , 48 , 36 , 65 ] , where coarse decisions are made [ 5 , 31 , 51 ] , and the number of instances is largely fixed early [ 29 ] . Steering early along the difference from a prompt without the count improves counts up to ten [ 52 ] , and attention steering [ 8 ] and counting guidance [ 26 ] use signals of whether a count is right. Prompt switching at chosen steps traces when a concept forms [ 16 ] ; we time the number word against a respelling. Text encoders represent numbers in order [ 57 ] , though CLIP counts poorly [ 47 ] .
blocks.zh: 字行时. 文本调节在采样[2、48、36、65]时大多很早,作出粗糙的决定[5、31、51],实例数目基本上很早固定[29]。 早期沿着没有计数的即时计数的区别方向前进,则计数可达10 [52],注意力方向[8]和计数指导[26]使用计数是否正确的信号. 当一个概念形成 [16] 时, 在选定的步骤中快速切换; 我们按数字字对重写进行计时 。 文本编码器以 [57] 顺序表示数字,尽管CLIP计算差 [47].

blocks.en: Supplying the count. Past ten, the methods that help hand the model a layout: planned boxes [ 34 , 33 , 62 ] , corrected layouts [ 4 , 45 ] , composite or noise starts [ 42 , 27 , 68 , 17 ] or dense-layout training [ 46 ] . Count tokens can be optimized [ 66 , 67 , 54 ] and models fine-tuned on verified counts or rewards [ 32 , 23 , 37 , 69 ] .
blocks.zh: 供给计数. 过去10年,帮助将模型交付布局的方法:计划箱[34,33,62],校正布局[4,45],复合或噪声开始[42,27,68,17]或密集铺设训练[46]. 计数符可以优化[66,67,54],模型可以对已核实的计数或奖励进行微调[32,23,37,69].

blocks.en: 3 Same-Noise Tests
blocks.zh: 3 相同噪音测试

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Why exact rates are not enough (simulated; one line per starting noise, asked for 12–30 objects). A model that counts is always exact. One that estimates the request loosely (log-normal scatter of 0.4) and one that ignores it are both rarely exact, but only the first orders its crowds ( Eq. 1 ).
blocks.zh: 图2:为什么准确率不够(模拟;每开始噪音一行,要求12-30个物体). 算数的模型总是准确的. 一个对请求进行松散估计(log-ormal smission of 0.4),而忽略它的人则很少精确,但只有第一个命令它的人群(Eq. 1 ).

blocks.en: Figure 3 : How far each model follows the number (people’s counts; the same 16 object types for every model, and within a model the same starting noise for every request). (a) Median count by request; dotted: count = request; shaded: past ten. (b) Same-noise order ( Eq. 1 ) for requests of 2–8, for 12–25, and for the pairs that include thirty, with 95% intervals over types; grey: a loose estimator read through people’s counting noise ( s s = 0.30–0.45); dashed: no direction.
blocks.zh: 图3:每个模型跟随数字的距离(人们的计数;每个模型相同的16个对象类型,在一个模型内,每个请求相同的起始噪声). (a) 按请求进行中间点数;点数:数=请求;阴影:过去10年。 (b) 同声命令(Eq. 1),用于12-25的2-8个请求,以及包括30个的对子的请求,在类型上间隔95%;灰色:一个通过人们的计数噪音读取的松散估计器(S=0.30-0.45);破折:没有方向。

blocks.en: Table 1 : The measures at a glance.
blocks.zh: 表1:措施概览。

blocks.en: Every comparison within a model keeps the object and the starting noise and changes exactly one thing.
blocks.zh: 模型中的每个比较都保持物体和开始的噪音,并完全改变一件事.

blocks.en: Models and prompts. We test SD3.5-M [ 12 , 53 ] (a rectified-flow transformer [ 39 , 35 ] with CLIP and T5 encoders, at 768 2 768^{2} ), SDXL [ 50 ] (CLIP only, 1024 2 1024^{2} ), FLUX.1-dev [ 6 ] (T5 and a pooled CLIP vector, 768 2 768^{2} ), FLUX.2 [klein] base 4B [ 7 ] (the language model Qwen3-4B [ 64 ] as encoder, 1024 2 1024^{2} ) and Qwen-Image [ 60 ] (20B, with the vision-language model Qwen2.5-VL-7B [ 1 ] as encoder, 1024 2 1024^{2} , transformer in 4-bit), each with its own sampler and guidance [ 21 ] at 28 to 50 steps (supp. Sec. A.1 ). The prompt is “a photo of c c X X s” with the number c c in words, and X X is one of 64 everyday object types drawn from the LVIS names [ 19 ] without looking at any image. A type and a seed fix the starting noise, so the images of all requests for a type share it. People counted requests from 2 to 30; SD3.5-M’s tests on 64 types ask for 2, 3, 4, 6 and 8 and for nine requests from 12 to 30.
blocks.zh: 模型和提示。 我们测试了SD3.5-M [12,53](一个有CLIP和T5编码器的纠正流变压器[39,35],在768 2 768^{2}),SDXL [50](只有CLIP,1024 2 1024^{2}),FLUX.1-dev [6](T5和一个集合的CLIP矢量,768 2 768^{2}),FLUX.2 [Klein] Base 4B [7](语言模型Quen3-4B [64]作为编码器,1024 2 1024^{2})和Quen-Image [60](20B,视觉语言模型Quen2.5-VL-7B [1]作为编码器,1024 2 1024^{2}转换器,在4-bit中),每个带自己的取样器和指导[21],在28-50步(sup. A.1节。 提示是“c c X X s 照片”,用文字表示数字为c c, X X 是64种日常物体类型之一,来自LVIS名称[19],没有看到任何图像。 一个类型和一个种子固定开始的噪声,所以所有对一个类型请求的图像都共享. 人们计算了2至30个申请;64种类型的SD3.5-M的测试要求2、3、4、6和8个申请,12至30个申请要求9个申请。

blocks.en: Counting. People on CloudResearch Connect counted 3,088 generated images in eight studies, clicking on each object without seeing the request or the model (supp. Sec. B ). Two people count each image in separate rounds, and a third decides where they differ. Composites of known count, mixed into the tasks, were counted exactly in 83–100% of cases. Generated crowds are harder: the first two counts agree on 50–82% of pictures. Yet two final counts of the same crowd of 12 to 30, made in different studies, differ by a mean | Δ ​ log ⁡ ( 1 + n ) | |\Delta\log(1{+}n)| of only 0.12 (SD3.5-M, 48 pictures; supp. Sec. B.4 ), so changes much larger than that are changes in the crowd, not in the counting. The annotators were paid crowdworkers ($0.10 per image, about $12–38 per hour) who counted objects in generated images. The tasks recorded counts of objects, not information about the workers, so we treated them as annotation rather than research on human subjects and did not submit them for IRB review; for the same reason, no consent was sought beyond each worker’s acceptance of the task on the platform. Every image is also counted by SAM 3 [ 9 ] , Grounding DINO [ 38 ] and OWLv2 [ 44 ] . Detectors miss many objects in dense crowds, so we compare models by people’s counts and run the tests within a model on SAM 3, checked against the other two detectors and against people. Unless we say otherwise, a test within SD3.5-M is counted by SAM 3 on all 64 types. Brackets give 95% bootstrap intervals over object types.
blocks.zh: 计数中. CloudResearch Connect上的人计有3,088在8项研究中生成图像,点击每个对象时没有看到请求或模型(supp. B节。 两人在不同的回合中分别计算每个图像,第三人则决定不同的地点. 83-100%的案件都计算了已知数的复合数,混入了各项任务。 产生人群更难:前两项罪状一致, 然而,在不同的研究中给出的12到30的同一组人的两个最终计数,却因一个平均的QQ log QQ (1+n) QQ Delta\log (1{+}n) QQ 0.12(SD3.5-M,48图片;supp. ),所以变化比人群的变化大得多,而不是计数的变化. 统计员是领取工资的人群工作者(每个图像0.10美元,每小时约12-38美元),他们在生成的图像中计算物体。 这些任务记录了物品的数量,而不是有关工人的信息,所以我们把它们当作注释,而不是对人类主题的研究,没有提交IRB审查;出于同样的原因,除了每个工人接受平台上的任务外,没有征求任何同意。 每个图像也由SAM 3 [9],Grounding DINO [38]和OWLv2 [44]计算. 探测器在密集人群中错过了许多物体, 因此我们用人们的计数来比较模型, 除非我们另有说法 SD3.5-M内部的测试 由SAM 3在64种类型中计算 Brackets在对象类型上给予95%的靴子间隔.

blocks.en: A loose estimator as reference. How well should a model that follows the number only loosely order its crowds? We simulate a loose estimator , whose count is the request times a log-normal factor with a log standard deviation s s of 0.30 to 0.45. It is exact in only 5–7% of images at 12–30, as rarely as most of the models ( Tab. 2 ). We read its counts through a model of people’s counting noise, fitted to 5,360 single counts of 2,240 pictures, so that it is judged exactly as the models are. The noise model lets a picture be easy or hard to count, more often hard when the crowd is large, and a single count of a hard picture be off by a few objects or, rarely, zero; it reproduces where a third count falls when the first two differ, and how often recounts agree (supp. Secs. A.5 and B.4 ). So read, it orders crowds of 12 to 25 at 0.72–0.80. A model’s effective scatter on a range of requests is the s s at which the estimator would order that range as well as the model does; once the order falls to one half, it has no finite value. Past ten, a model’s reach covers a range when its effective scatter there is at most 0.45: the model then orders the range at least as well as an estimator that is exact as rarely as the models are.
blocks.zh: 一个松散的估算器作为参考. 一个跟随数字的模型应该多好 只能松散地排列它的人群? 我们模拟一个松散的估测器,它的计数是请求次数是一个日志正常因子,日志标准偏差为0.30到0.45。 12–30年的图像只有5–7 % , 与大多数模型(Tab 2 ) 一样少见。 我们通过一个人们计数噪音的模型来读取其计数,该模型配有5,360张2,240张图片,从而判断其准确无误。 噪音模型让图片容易或难以统计,在人群大的时候更难统计,一个硬图的单数被几个对象或很少为零关闭;它复制了前两个差异时第三个数落下的地方,以及重新计票的一致程度(supp. (第A.5和B.4节)。 所以读,它命令12到25的人群在0.72–0.80. 一个模型在一系列请求上的有效散射是估计者会像模型那样命令这个范围;一旦顺序降到一半,它就没有有限价值。 过去10年,当一个模型的有效散射达到0.45时,其影响范围包括:该模型至少命令范围,以及一个精确的模型。

We compare a new number with four changes that leave the number’s value alone: a new seed, the same number in digits (“12” for “twelve”), an unrelated edit (“a photograph of” for “a photo of”), and a fine-scale redraw , which keeps the coarse part of the starting noise and takes only its fine part from the type’s second seed. With F 1 F_{1} and F 2 F_{2} the 2D Fourier transforms of the two noises over the spatial axes and r r the spatial frequency in cycles per image, z f = ℱ − 1 [ 1 [ r ≤ f ] F 1 + 𝟏 [ r > f ] F 2 ] z_{f}=\mathcal{F}^{-1}\big[\,\mathbf{1}[r\leq f]\,F_{1}+\mathbf{1}[r>f]\,F_{2}\,\big] (2) is again white Gaussian noise, equal to the first seed’s noise in all structure coarser than about 1 / f 1/f of the image (supp. Sec. D.8 ). Above eight cycles, the redraw replaces 98% of the variance of SD3.5-M’s starting noise, yet keeps its coarse structure. How much of the layout a change keeps is the correlation of 24 × 24 24{\times}24 grayscale thumbnails of the two images: it measures where the large light and dark regions fall, the picture’s coarse composition. The order of the number change says whether it moves the crowd toward the request.

blocks.en: 4 Each Model Follows the Number Only So Far
blocks.zh: 4 每个模型只遵循数字

blocks.en: Table 2 : Within and past ten (people’s counts of 16 types, one seed; “with 30”: the four pairs that include thirty). a The loose estimator’s scatter at which it would order crowds of 12–25 as the model does, with a 95% interval; the reach covers 12–25 when it is at most 0.45 ( Sec. 3 ).

blocks.en: Every model follows small numbers. From two to eight objects, the larger request gives more objects in 80–99% of the same-noise pairs whose counts differ ( Tab. 2 ), and the median crowd grows with the request ( Fig. 3 a).
blocks.zh: 每个模型都遵循小数字. 从2到8个对象,较大的请求给出了80–99%的相同噪声的对数不同(Tab.2)的更多对象,中位群随请求(图3 a)而增长.

blocks.en: Past ten, two groups. From twelve to twenty-five ( Fig. 3 b), SD3.5-M and FLUX.1-dev stop following the number and order their crowds worse than either reference estimator would (0.57 and 0.47). SD3.5-M’s median crowd stays between 4.5 and 8.5 objects whatever the request, and FLUX.1-dev’s even shrinks, to one or two objects at thirty. FLUX.2 [klein] and Qwen-Image keep following the number up to twenty-five about as loosely as the reference does (0.73 and 0.78), and their crowds grow to 16–20 objects. Paired on the same types, each of these two orders its crowds better than SD3.5-M and FLUX.1-dev do (supp. Sec. C.9 ). SDXL lies in between on our unscreened objects (0.65), but on types screened for isolated objects its crowd keeps growing up to thirty as a loose estimator’s would. How far a number reaches depends on the objects as well as on the model.
blocks.zh: 10点,两组 从12到25(图3b)、SD3.5-M和FLUX.1-dev停靠在数字之后并排出比参考估计器更糟糕的人群(0.57和0.47)。 SD3.5-M的中位数人群无论要求什么都会停留在4.5到8.5之间, 1 -dev的甚至缩水, 到一两个物体在30。 FLUX.2 [klein] 和 Quen-Image 一直跟随数字高达25,大约与参考数字一样松散(0.73和0.78),他们的人群增长到16–20物体. 同一型号的Paired,这两个型号中的每个型号都比SD3.5-M和FLUX.1-dev do(supp. 第C.9节。 SDXL位于我们未经筛选的物体(0.65)之间, 数字达到多少取决于物体和模型。

blocks.en: The trouble with thirty. The pairs that include thirty are ordered clearly worse than those up to twenty-five in FLUX.1-dev, FLUX.2 [klein] and Qwen-Image, and in five of the seven tests that asked for both, the median crowd at thirty is smaller than at twenty-five (supp. Sec. C.9 ). We can place the end of FLUX.2 [klein]’s and Qwen-Image’s reach only somewhere past twenty-five.
blocks.zh: 烦恼与三十. 包含30个的配对在FLUX.1-dev,FLUX.2[klein]和Quen-Image中被订得明显差于25个的配对,在要求两者的7个测试中的5个中,30个的中位群比25个(supp. 第C.9节。 FLUX.2[Klein]和Quen-Image的接触范围只有二十五点左右。

blocks.en: What the usual scores miss. Past ten, the usual scores cannot say whether a model follows the number. Exact rates of 0–21% ( Tab. 2 ) rank the two groups, but a model that misses may still follow the number loosely. SD3.5-M, which does not follow it past ten, is exact in 4% of images, about as often as a loose estimator that does (5–7%); their orders, 0.57 against 0.72–0.80, tell them apart. From twenty to thirty, a loose estimator draws the requested count only 1–3 percentage points more often than a neighbouring count, and on 16 types a lift that small cannot be told from that of a model that ignores the number. A graded score is no better: a model that always draws sixteen objects has a mean relative error past ten of 0.27, lower than the looser of our two reference estimators (0.38) and close to the tighter one (0.25). Detectors add a bias of their own, since they undercount dense crowds and can reverse a model’s direction: Grounding DINO reads fewer objects in FLUX.2 [klein]’s images when twenty-five are asked for than when twelve are, while people find the crowd growing (supp. Secs. A.5 , B.4 , C.1 , D.8 and E.4 ). Past ten, a model can miss nearly every count and still follow the number; its order against a reference counted the same way shows whether it does.
blocks.zh: 通常的分数都少了 过去10年,通常的分数不能说一个模型是否跟随数字. 0–21 % (Tab. 2) 的精确率将这两类人排在首位,但漏掉的模型可能仍然松散地跟随数字。 SD3.5-M, 它没有超过10, 在4%的图像中是准确的, 大约经常是一个松散的估算器( 5–7 % ) ; 他们的订单, 0.57对 0. 72– 0. 80, 告诉他们。 从20到30岁,一个松散的估测员比邻居的计数次数多出1到3个百分点,在16个类型中,一个小的升降机不能从一个忽略数字的模型中得知。 分级的分数并不更好:总是画十六个对象的模型比我们两个参考估计器(0.38)的松散度(0.25)低10倍的平均值相对误差,接近更紧的(0.25). 探测器会增加自己的偏差,因为它们低估了密集的人群,并能扭转模型的方向: DINO在FLUX.2[Klein]的图像中读取的物体比12时要少, 第A.5、B.4、C.1、D.8和E.4节。 过去10年,一个模型可能错过了几乎每一个计数,并且仍然跟随数字;它相对于一个参考的顺序计算时,也显示了它是否这样做.

From the noise of the image asked for twenty: thirty asked from the same noise; the noise above eight cycles per image redrawn from the type’s second seed, still asked for twenty; twenty from the second seed. People’s counts, and r r , the correlation of 24 × 24 24{\times}24 thumbnails with the first image. In these four, thirty gives as many objects as twenty or more; across all types, the larger request gives more objects in only about half of the pairs ( Sec. 5 ).

blocks.en: If the starting noise fixed a large crowd’s count, a new number from the same noise would leave the count where it was. In SD3.5-M it does not, but it does not steer the count either.
blocks.zh: 如果开始的噪音固定了大批人群的计数,来自同一噪音的新数字就会离开计数地点。 在SD3.5-M中,它没有,但它也没有引导计数。

blocks.en: The layout stays. A new number keeps most of the picture ( a, Tab. 3 ). Past the reach, maps of the objects’ boxes correlate at 0.58 between two images from the same noise under a new number, against 0.32 under a new seed (supp. Sec. D.4 ). The noise decides where things go, as Zhao et al . found [ 68 ] .
blocks.zh: 布局不变. 新数字保存了大部分图片(a, Tab. 3 ). 在到达范围之后,物体盒的地图在一个新数字下来自同一噪音的两个图像之间以0.58的比例相联,在一个新的种子下以0.32的比例相联。 D.4节。 噪音决定了事情的走向,如赵等人发现 [68].

blocks.en: The count moves as under a new seed. Past the reach, a new number moves SD3.5-M’s count about as far as a new seed or the same number written in digits, and only 1.2–1.5 times as far as an unrelated edit ( Tabs. 3 and 4 ). It does not push the count toward the request: over all nine requests past ten and both seeds, the larger request gives more objects in only half of the pairs whose counts differ, and the number moves the crowd 0.89 times as far as a seed. People’s counts of 16 types agree. A loose estimator counted the same way would move its crowd 1.4–1.7 times as far as a seed and order it at 0.80–0.88; the model’s order is below 0.54 with 95% confidence, one-sided (supp. Secs. B.4 , C.9 and D ). Within the reach, by contrast, a new number moves the count further than a new seed, and toward the request. Past it, the number moves the crowd but no longer steers it.
blocks.zh: 数动如新种下. 新数字移动SD3.5-M的计数, 大约为新种子或用数字写成的相同数字, 它没有将计数推向请求:在所有9个请求中,过去10个种子和两个种子中,较大的请求只给出了一半的计数有差异的对数中更多的对象,数字将人群移动0.89倍于一个种子. 16种人的计数一致。 一个松散的估测员计算出同样的方式可以移动其人群1.4–1.7倍于种子,并在0.80–0.88订购;模型的顺序低于0.54,置信率为95%,单侧(supp). B.4、C.9和D等秘书。 相对而言,一个新的数字在力所能及的范围内,使计数比一个新的种子移动得更远,并朝着请求的方向移动. 过它,数字移动 人群但不再引导它。

blocks.en: A seed that keeps the layout. The count of a large crowd depends on details finer than the layout. A new seed redraws the whole picture, so it is a generous yardstick; a stricter one keeps the coarse noise and redraws only the noise finer than f f cycles per image ( Eq. 2 ). Redrawn above eight cycles, the picture keeps its layout as well as under a new number ( Tabs. 3 and 6 ). Yet past the reach its count moves two-thirds as far as under a new number. By people’s counts of 16 types the ratio is 0.69 [0.38, 1.20], and the change is two and a half times the difference between two countings of the same picture. Even redrawn above sixteen cycles, where the thumbnails correlate at 0.86, a large crowd’s count moves 0.71 times as far as under a new number (16 types; supp. Sec. D.8 ).
blocks.zh: 保持布局的种子. 大量人群的计数取决于比布局更精细的细节. 新的种子重新绘制整个画面,所以这是一个宽宏大量的标准;更严格的种子保留粗糙的噪音,只比每个图像的f f 周期(Eq. 2 )更细细重绘噪音. 重新绘制在八个周期以上,图片保持其布局以及新的数字(Tabs 3和6 )下. 然而,在达到这个目标之后,它的数目却移动了三分之二,甚至低于一个新的数字。 根据16种类型的人计算,比例为0.69[0.38,1.20],变化是同一画面两个计数的2.5倍。 连16个周期以上(缩略图关联0.86), 第D.8号决定。

blocks.en: What changes at the reach is the number. It is not that noise starts to matter: fine-scale noise moves small crowds too, two-thirds to nine-tenths as far as a new seed does. Within the reach, a new number moves the count 2.5 to 3.2 times as far as a redraw above two to eight cycles, and toward the request. Past it, only 1.0 to 1.5 times as far, and in no direction. The number loses its direction and most of its margin over noise.
blocks.zh: 影响范围的变化是数字。 噪音并不重要:细微的噪音也使小群人移动,就新种子而言,只有三分之二到九分之十。 在可以达到的范围内,一个新的数字将计数移动2.5至3.2倍,以重划到2至8个周期,然后向请求方向移动。 通过它,只有1.0到1.5倍远,没有方向。 数字失去方向和大部分比噪声差.

blocks.en: Other models. The redraws behave the same way in the two models that follow the number furthest. By people’s counts of 16 types (SAM 3 reads many of FLUX.2 [klein]’s crowds as empty), a redraw above four or eight cycles moves FLUX.2 [klein]’s count about half as far as a new number within its reach and about four-fifths as far at its edge. In Qwen-Image, by SAM 3, the redraw moves the count less than half as far as a new number at four and twelve, and four-fifths as far at twenty and thirty (supp. Sec. D.8 ). In both models, the number’s margin over fine-scale noise shrinks toward the edge of the reach. In FLUX.1-dev, past its reach, a new number moves the crowd further than a new seed, without a reliable direction (supp. Sec. D.7 ).
blocks.zh: 其他型号。 重新绘制在两个模式中表现相同,它们跟随最远的数字. 根据16种(SAM 3读取FLUX.2[klein]的众多人群为空)的计数法,4或8个周期以上的重划将FLUX.2[klein]的计数移动到其所能达到的新数字的一半左右,边缘的计数则达到五分之四左右. 在Quen-Image中,通过SAM 3,重新绘制的计数移动不到一半,以4号和12号为新数,四分之五为20号和30号(supp. 第D.8号决定。 在两种模型中,数字相对于细尺度噪声的比值都缩小到伸手边。 在FLUX.1-dev中,新数字超越了它的覆盖范围,将人群移动得比新种子更远,没有可靠的方向(supp. (第D.7节)。

blocks.en: 6 The Number Arrives, Without a Direction
blocks.zh: 6 数字到达,没有方向

blocks.en: Past the reach, is the large number lost before the denoiser, too weak, too late, or simply without a direction? We follow it through SD3.5-M, timing it also in SDXL and FLUX.2 [klein].
blocks.zh: 过了这段路程, 损失的很多是在德诺瓦人之前, 太软弱,太迟, 还是只是没有方向? 我们通过SD3.5-M跟踪它,在SDXL和FLUX.2中也进行计时[klein].

blocks.en: It is encoded. From SD3.5-M’s pooled CLIP vector, a ridge regression trained on the other number words puts a held-out large number in the right order in 0.89 of same-object pairs, nearly as often as a small one (0.98; supp. Sec. E.1 ).
blocks.zh: 这是编码的。 从SD3.5-M集合的CLIP向量中,在其他数字词上训练的脊回归使一个被搁置的相同对象对0.89的排列顺序相当大,几乎与小对象(0.98;supp)一样频繁. E.1节。

blocks.en: It acts early, where small numbers act. Swapping the other request of a pair into the prompt for a window of five or six steps shows when a number word acts ( Fig. 5 ). In all three models we timed, small number words move the count toward themselves only in the first windows, while the same number respelled in digits changes fewer counts and in no direction. The large word acts in the first window too, but without a clear direction in SD3.5-M: it changes 64% of the counts there, about as many as its respelling does, and only 46% of those changes go its way. Later windows and people’s counts of the swaps are in supp. Secs. E.3 and E.4 .
blocks.zh: 它的动作很早,数量很少。 将一对的另一个请求冲入一个五或六个步骤的窗口的提示中,当一个数字单词发生时显示(图5 ). 在我们计时的所有三个模型中,小数字的单词只在第一个窗口中将计数移动到自己身上,而用数字重新拼写的数字变化较少,没有方向. 大型的词在第一个窗口中也有作用,但是SD3.5-M没有明确的方向:它改变了那里64%的计数,大约是它的重写数量,只有46%的修改是往前走的。 之后的窗口和人们的互换数据都在等待中。 E.3和E.4节。

blocks.en: Table 4 : What we tried, to make SD3.5-M follow a large number. Same-noise order at 2–8 and at 12–30 (in parentheses: by Grounding DINO); for the amplified word and the streams, two against four and twelve against twenty-five. Baselines: the amplified word’s own unsteered pairs order .94 and .52; for the LoRAs and the cue, seed 1’s plain prompt orders .89 and .46. By people’s counts the count LoRA orders large crowds no better than the shuffled one ( + + 0.08 [ − - 0.12, 0.27]; by SAM 3 + + 0.14 [0.01, 0.27]). a 512 2 512^{2} , screened types, base model .88 and .49. Details: supp. Secs. E.6 , E.7 , E.8 , E.10 , C.7 and C.4 .
blocks.zh: 表4:我们试图使SD3.5-M跟随大量数据。 2–8和12–30(括号内为Grounding DINO)的同声命令;对于放大的单词和溪流,2对4和12对25. 基线:扩大后的单词本身的未提单词顺序为.94和.52;对于LORA和标点,种子1的纯速单词顺序为.89和.46。 根据人们的计算,LORA伯爵订购的人群并不比被洗牌的人群(+ + 0.08 [− - - 0.12, 0.27];由SAM 3 + + 0.14 [0.01, 0.27])更好). a 512 2 512^{2}, 筛选类型, 基模 .88和.49. 详情:Supp. Secs. E.6, E.7, E.8, E.10, C.7和C.4 .

blocks.en: Nothing we tried gives it a clear direction. We pushed on the word, the text streams, the weights and the prompt, all in SD3.5-M ( Tab. 4 ). Amplifying the difference between the two requests’ velocities in the first ten steps [ 59 , 52 ] keeps small pairs ordered and leaves large pairs unordered. Adding the velocity difference between “four” and “two” to a request for twelve shrinks the crowd instead of growing it. Given different numbers in its CLIP and T5 streams, SD3.5-M follows either stream’s small number and neither stream’s large one, and checkpoints rewarded on small counts do not order large crowds either. A LoRA trained on 1,653 of SD3.5-M’s own counted crowds of 12 to 30 learns counts up to about twelve, its most common training count. Past that, it orders crowds somewhat better than the same LoRA trained on shuffled counts by SAM 3, but not by people’s counts. The shuffled LoRA draws 33 to 36 objects at every request from twelve to twenty-five by people’s counts, so the model can draw large crowds; what it lacks is a mapping from a large number to one. The one cue that moves the order partway is the word “tiny”, under SAM 3 and OWLv2 but not under Grounding DINO. The large number reaches the denoiser in time, but nothing we tried ties it to a change of count.
blocks.zh: 我们没有试过给它一个明确的方向。 我们用SD3.5-M(TAB 4)来推动文字、文字流、重量和速率。 在前十步[59,52]中放大两个请求速度的差异,使小对子保持订购,使大对子没有顺序. 将“四”和“二”之间的速度差加到要求十二“缩小人群而不是增加人群。 SD3.5-M在CLIP和T5流中的数量不同, SD3.5-M的1,653名人数为12至30人, 过去,它订购的人群比SAM 3对洗牌计数训练的同一个LORA要好一些,但并非由人们计数。 洗牌的LORA根据人们的计数从12到25个请求抽取33到36个物体,因此模型可以吸引大量的人群;它缺少的是从大量到一个的地图. SAM 3 和 OWLv2 下, 数量之多及时到达了德诺瓦人, 但我们没有尝试过把它与改变的伯爵联系起来。

blocks.en: 7 A Large Count Can Be Shown Instead
blocks.zh: 7 大伯爵可以显示

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Saying against showing. (a) SD3.5-M, same noise, 58 types, exact at 12, 20 and 30 by SAM 3: three ways of saying the count, and three contents of a noised grid in the starting latent ( σ = 0.909 \sigma{=}0.909 ), which the sentence describes. (b) People’s counts, 16 types, at 12, 16, 20, 25 and 30: exact (bars, 95% intervals), within 10% (light) and exact with a recognisable object (diamonds), for prompts, SDXL with Gu et al . ’s noise re-layout, the self-planted start, FLUX.2 [klein] from the same grids (hatched: its render keeps much of the supplied composite), and two layout models given the grid as boxes.
blocks.zh: 图7:反对显示。 (a) SD3.5-M,同一种噪音,58种,精确在12、20和30,由SAM 3表示计数的三种方式,以及起始时的3个网格内容(= 0.909\sigma\0.909),这句话对此作了说明。 (b) 个人计数,16种,在12、16、20、25和30点:精确(巴,95%间隔),在10%(轻)以可识别物体(钻石)为精确度,对于提示,SDXL与Gu等人的噪音重排,自植起始,FLUX.2[克林]从同一网格(厚:其精度保留了所提供的复合材料的大部分),以及两种布局模式,将网格作为盒。

blocks.en: If the number word has no direction past the reach, can the model draw a large crowd at all? We give it the count in another form: as a layout in the starting latent.
blocks.zh: 如果数字单词没有过伸展方向,模型可以画出一大群人吗? 我们以另一种形式进行计算:作为开始潜伏的布局。

blocks.en: Saying against showing, from the same noise. In SD3.5-M, from the noise of each type’s image, we either say the count (as a word, in digits, or in a sentence naming the rows and columns of a grid, “twelve X X s arranged in three rows of four”) or show it. To show it, we start from a grid of the requested count, noised to σ = 0.909 \sigma{=}0.909 , and let the unchanged model run its last 31 of 40 steps with the plain prompt (supp. Sec. F.2 ). Every way of saying the count is exact in at most 6.9% of images (SAM 3, on the 58 types with a cut-out). Even a grid of plain ellipses in the object’s mean colour is exact in 24%. A grid of the object itself, cut out of the model’s own image of two to four objects, is exact in 52%, and a grid of another object lies in between ( Fig. 7 a): the more the grid looks like the object, the more it helps.
blocks.zh: 说反对显示, 从同样的噪音。 在SD3.5-M中,从每个类型图像的噪音来看,我们要么说计数(作为单词,以数字表示,要么在命名网格的行和列的句子中, " 十二XXs排列为三行四 " ),要么显示。 为了显示这一点,我们从要求的计数的网格开始,通知为: = 0.909\sigma\0.909, 让未改变的模型运行其最后的31步 40 步, 并使用普通的快捷键(supp. F.2节。 每一种说计数的方法都精确地出现在最多6.9%的图像中(SAM 3,在58个类型中带有剪切). 即使物体的正色中有一道网格的平面椭圆也精确到24%。 对象本身的网格,从模型本身的2到4个对象的图像中切出,精确度为52%,另一个对象的网格位于(图7 a)之间:网格越像对象,帮助越大.

blocks.en: By people’s counts. People find the asked count in 4% of SD3.5-M’s images from the prompt and in 59% from a grid of its own object ( Fig. 7 b). Layout models given the grid as boxes, GLIGEN [ 33 ] and InstanceAssemble [ 62 ] , reach 46% and 68%.
blocks.zh: 根据人们的计数。 人们在SD3.5-M的4%的图像和59%的自身物体的网格(图7b)中发现了要求的点数。 网格为框的布局模型,GLIGEN[33]和实例组合[62],达到46%和68%。

blocks.en: A planted count holds against the number word, not the object word. Started from a noised grid of N N objects and asked for a different count M M , SD3.5-M, SDXL and FLUX.1-dev draw M M in only 0.7–3.5% of images and keep N N in 50–64% net of chance (screened types; supp. Sec. F.3 ). In SD3.5-M these starts come at the end of the steps in which number words act, so the planted count survives the rest of sampling rather than beating the word head on; started earlier, from a crowd between the two requests, a large word still barely pulls the count (supp. Sec. E.9 ). Asked instead for twenty of another object of similar shape, SD3.5-M repaints most of the planted grid as the named object in 75% of images (screened types). The layout carries the count; the word decides what is drawn.
blocks.zh: 一个植入的计数与数字单词相对,而不是对象单词. 从N对象的噪声网格开始,要求用不同的计数M M,SD3.5-M,SDXL和FLUX1-dev在只有0.7–3.5%的图像中绘制M M,并将N N保持在50–64%的机会净额(筛选类型;supp). F.3节。 在SD3.5-M中,这些开始于数字词动作的步法的结尾,所以植入的计数在其余的采样中幸存下来,而不是击打词头;开始时间更早,从两个请求之间的人群中,一个大字仍然勉强拉起计数(supp. (英文) Sec. E.9. 取而代之的是,SD3.5-M在75%的图像(屏幕类型)中将大部分被植入的网格作为命名对象重新涂抹出另外20个类似形状的物体. 布局带有计数符;由单词决定画什么.

blocks.en: Relation to count-aware noise. The planted start is SDEdit [ 42 ] from a tiled composite of the model’s own object [ 27 ] , close to the count-aware noise prior of Zhao et al . [ 68 ] , who showed that such a prior raises exact counts. We use it as a probe of where a large count can enter the model, not as a method: it costs image quality (PickScore [ 28 ] 0.57–0.85 lower) and is no more accurate than InstanceAssemble (supp. Secs. F.1 , F.4 and F.5 ). Together with the redraws of Sec. 5 , it shows where a large count can come from: a grid written into the noise carries it, while the random noise’s own layout does not.
blocks.zh: 与数觉声相应. 植入的起始点是SDedit [42],来自模型自身物体的平板复合体[27],靠近赵等人之前的计数知觉噪声. [68],这些噪声表明这种先前的计数产生准确的计数. 我们用它来探究一个大伯爵可以进入模型的哪些地方,而不是作为一种方法:它花费了图像质量(PickScore [28] 0.57–0.85 更低),并且并不比EctoryAssemble(supple)更准确. (第F.1、F.4和F.5号决定)。 加上Sec. 5的重新绘制,它显示了一个大数可以来自何处:写进噪音的网格会携带它,而随机噪音本身的布局则不会.

blocks.en: 8 Discussion
blocks.zh: 8 讨论情况

blocks.en: Table 5 : A same-noise test for counting past ten.
blocks.zh: 表5:计算过去10年的相同噪音测试。

blocks.en: Layout and count. In SD3.5-M the layout of a picture is set early, by the coarse part of the noise, while the count of a large crowd depends on finer details. The number word acts while the layout forms, and within the reach it points the count toward the request. Past the reach it still arrives in time, but we found nothing that ties its value to a count, and the count is left to the finer details of the noise.
blocks.zh: 布局与计数. 在SD3.5-M中,一个图片的布局是提前设定的,由噪音的粗糙部分决定,而大群的计数则取决于更细细的细节. 数字单词在布局形成时作用,在到达范围内,它将计数指向请求. 在到达之前,它仍然及时到达,但是我们发现没有任何东西能将它的价值与一个伯爵联系起来,而伯爵则留给更细细的噪音细节.

blocks.en: For benchmarks. Past ten, we suggest a same-noise test instead of an exact rate ( Tab. 5 ). It needs no access to a model’s internals, only to its starting noise. We will release the code, the images, people’s counts and their answers.
blocks.zh: 用于基准。 过去10年,我们建议进行同样的噪音测试,而不是精确的费率(Tab.5)。 它不需要进入模型的内部,只需要进入其开始的噪音。 我们将公布密码、图像、人们的计数和答案。

blocks.en: For control. Past the reach, digits, a sentence naming the grid, the native resolution, other guidance scales and the best of four samples are each exact in at most 6.2% of SD3.5-M’s images (64 types), and steering the word and small-count rewards do not order its large crowds (supp. Secs. C.3 , C.4 and E.6 ), while a layout in the latent or as boxes draws the count far more often. For these models, a large count is better given as a layout than as a word, at some cost in image quality.
blocks.zh: 为了控制。 过去,数字,一个命名网格的句子,原生分辨率,其他指导尺度和四个样本中最好的,每个样本在SD3.5-M的图像(64种类型)中最多为6.2%,而制导单词和小数奖励并不命令其大群(supp). C.3、C.4和E.6节),而潜在或箱中的布局更经常地进行计数。 对于这些模型来说,一个大数作为布局比作为单词更好,在图像质量上会付出一定的代价.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Scope. Five open models, single-object prompts asking for up to thirty objects (up to forty in two side tests), and one prompt template. Qwen-Image ran with a 4-bit transformer at 1024 2 1024^{2} , below its model card’s 1328 2 1328^{2} , and SD3.5-M and FLUX.1-dev at 768 2 768^{2} , below their native size; closed models were not tested, though benchmarks find them failing past ten as well [ 18 , 56 ] . Evidence. The equivalence of a new number and a new seed is clean in SD3.5-M; in FLUX.1-dev the number moves the crowd further than a seed, and in FLUX.2 [klein] and Qwen-Image we could test it only at the edge of their reach, where it separates little. People counted the redraws of 16 types; on these types the number’s margin over the redraws within the reach is smaller than on all 64, and some of FLUX.2 [klein]’s large crowds are ambiguous to people.
The analysis inside the model is in SD3.5-M (timing also in SDXL and FLUX.2 [klein]). People counted 16 types per model and agree only moderately on dense crowds, so most rankings between models remain unresolved, and requests stop at thirty, before the two longest reaches end. The count LoRA is only one training recipe.
blocks.zh:
范围。 5个开放模型,单对象提示请求最多30个对象(两个侧测试中最多40个),以及1个快速模板. Quen-Image在1024 2 1024^{2},低于其型号卡的1328 2 1328^{2},以及SD3.5-M和FLUX.1-dev在768 2 768^{2},低于其本土体积;闭塞型号没有经过测试,不过基准发现它们也失败了过去10年[18,56]. 证义曰. 新编号和新种子的等值在SD3.5-M;FLUX中是干净的. 1-dev 数字移动人群比种子更远,在FLUX.2 [klein]和Quen-Image中,我们只能在它们到达的边缘测试它,在那里它几乎没有分开. 人们统计了16种类型的重划;在这些类型上,数字相对于所有64种的重划的比值都小,一些FLUX.2[klein]的大规模人群对人们来说模棱两可.
该模型内部的分析用SD3.5-M(同样在SDXL和FLUX.2[klein]中计时). 人们计算每个模型有16种类型,对密集的人群只持中度一致,因此模型之间的大多数排名仍未得到解决,请求在两个最长的到达终点之前止步于30. 洛拉伯爵只是一种训练方法

blocks.en: LLM Usage Statement
blocks.zh: LLM 语言 用法声明

blocks.en: We used Claude (Anthropic), an LLM-based assistant, as a coding and writing assistant. It helped write and run code for image generation, counting, analysis and figures; helped plan and run experiments, including the crowdsourced counting studies; helped search related work and check numbers and references; and helped draft and revise the text. The images we analyse are outputs of the models under study, and every count attributed to people comes from human annotators. The authors directed the work, made all research decisions and take full responsibility for the paper.
blocks.zh: 我们用克劳德(英语:Anthropic),一个基于LLM的助理,作为编码和写作助理. 它帮助编写和运行图像生成、计数、分析和数字的代码;帮助规划和进行实验,包括多方来源的计数研究;帮助搜索相关工作,检查数字和参考文献;帮助起草和修订文本。 我们分析的图像是正在研究的模型的输出物,每一个归结于人的计数都来自人类的注释者. 作者指导作品,作出所有研究决定,并对论文承担全部责任.

blocks.en: A Design and measures
blocks.zh: A. 设计和措施

blocks.en: A.1 The tests
blocks.zh: A.1 联合国 测试

blocks.en: Starts. Instead of pure noise, a rectified-flow sampler can start at noise level σ \sigma from z σ = ( 1 − σ ) ​ E ​ ( y ) + σ ​ ϵ j ​ s , z_{\sigma}=(1-\sigma)\,E(y)+\sigma\,\epsilon_{js}, (3) with E E the model’s encoder, y y an image and ϵ j ​ s \epsilon_{js} the type and seed’s own noise; the remaining steps run unchanged. Planted starts of SD3.5-M use σ = 0.909 \sigma{=}0.909 (step 9 of 40) unless stated.
blocks.zh: 开始 校正的流程采样器不是纯噪声,而是可以在噪声级别\\sigma从z = (1 - σ) E (y) + j → j s, z = (1 -\sigma)\, E (y) = sigma\,\epsilon\js}, (3) E E 模式的编码器, y 图像和 j = s\epsilon\js} 类型和种子的噪音开始; 其余步骤运行不变。 SD3.5-M的预定开始使用量 = 0.909\sigma\0.909(第9步为40),除非说明。

blocks.en: Same noise. A type and a seed fix the starting noise, and sampling is deterministic: runs that repeat cells of earlier runs (the sweep’s agreeing cells, the content test’s own cut-outs, the probes’ trajectories) reproduce those images exactly. Table 6 lists the tests.
blocks.zh: 同样的噪音。 一种类型和一种种子会固定开始的噪音,而采样是决定性的:重复先前运行的细胞的运行(扫描的商定细胞,内容测试本身的断层,探测器的轨迹)正是复制这些图像的。 表6列出了测试情况。

blocks.en: Models and settings. SD3.5-M: 40 steps, guidance 4.5, 768 2 768^{2} unless stated; SDXL base 1.0: 40 Euler steps, guidance 5, 1024 2 1024^{2} ; FLUX.1-dev: 28 steps, distilled guidance 3.5, 768 2 768^{2} ; FLUX.2 [klein] base 4B: 50 steps, guidance 4.0, 1024 2 1024^{2} ( Sec. C.5 ); Qwen-Image: the pipeline’s defaults, 50 steps, guidance 4.0, 1024 2 1024^{2} , with the transformer in 4-bit NF4 ( Sec. C.6 ). Prompts give the number in words (“a photo of twelve cribs”).

blocks.en: SAM 3, Grounding DINO and OWLv2 count every evaluation image; the consensus is their two-of-three majority and leaves images without a majority uncounted. Near-blank images (at most 2.1% of a run) are counted like any other image. Against people, SAM 3 undercounts generated crowds ( Tab. 8 ), so models are compared by people’s counts.

blocks.en: Clean composites. On S2’s clean grids, SAM 3 is exact in 0.90, 0.83 and 0.83 of composites at 12, 20 and 30 objects, Grounding DINO in 0.85, 0.75 and 0.40, and OWLv2 in 0.69, 0.60 and 0.40; on S1’s, in 0.83, 0.83 and 0.81, 0.73, 0.58 and 0.44, and 0.65, 0.46 and 0.27. On the clean grids at 12–30, the ranges are 0.79–0.88, 0.47–0.77 and 0.35–0.58 on U1, 0.76–0.79, 0.45–0.78 and 0.36–0.59 on U2, and 0.66–0.77, 0.39–0.71 and 0.34–0.59 on U3. Most of SAM 3’s misses are empty readings: it counts zero on 16%, 20% and 23% of the unscreened sets’ composites (no box at all on 11%, 16% and 16%), concentrated in a few object types. OWLv2, which counts only 36–59% of U2’s clean composites exactly, gives the grid a smaller advantage over the scatter at 12, 20 and 30 (0.10) and the word a larger exact lift at native resolution (0.13 of its small-count value).

blocks.en: Within-type scatter. Because a type’s shared offset cancels in same-noise pairs, the order of an estimate depends only on its scatter within a type; the loose estimator’s band therefore describes within-type scatter, and an estimator with errors correlated across requests reaches the same order with a larger total scatter, and lower exact and within-10% rates.
blocks.zh: 内型散射. 由于一个类型共享的抵消以相同噪音的对对方式取消,所以一个估计数的顺序只取决于它在一个类型内的散射;因此,松散的估计带描述的是类型内的散射,而请求之间有相关误差的估计器则以更大的总散射率和较低的准确率和10%的率达到同一顺序。

blocks.en: The loose estimator as the counters read it. People counted all 32 composites of 12–30 known objects exactly, so on clean images they would read a loose estimator as it is (their disagreement on dense generated crowds lowers its order a little, Sec. B.4 ); on 16 types, as in the people-counted sets, its order by people ranges over 0.77–0.89 (scatter 0.30) and 0.68–0.83 (0.45) in 95% of 4,000 simulated sets. Read through SAM 3’s errors on the people-counted pictures (each simulated type takes one real type’s SAM 3 errors, log ⁡ ( 1 + n sam ) − log ⁡ ( 1 + h ) \log(1{+}n_{\textsc{sam}})-\log(1{+}h) , at the five requests, so that a type SAM 3 misses is missed at every request), its order falls to 0.74 [0.63, 0.83] and 0.69 [0.59, 0.79], and its slope spreads from 0.2 to 1.6. SAM 3’s orders thus understate an estimate’s by about 0.06–0.10, which is why models are ranked by people’s counts.
blocks.zh: 柜台上的松散估计器读出来 人们精确地计算了所有32个已知物体的合成物,因此在干净的图像上,他们会读出一个松散的估算器(他们对密集产生的人群的分歧略微降低了其顺序,第B.4节);在16种类型上,如在人计算组中,人们的排序在0.77-0.89(碎片0.30)和0.68-0.83(0.45)之间,在4000套模拟组中的95%。 通过SAM 3在人计算的图片上的错误读取(每个模拟类型都取了一个真实类型的SAM 3错误,log QQ (1 + n sam) – log QQ (1 + h)\log (1{+}n_{\textsc{sam}})-\log (1{+}h)),应5个请求,这样每一次都错过一个类型的SAM 3,它的顺序下降到0.74 [0.63,0.83]和0.69 [0.59,0.79],其坡度从0.2至1.6. SAM 3的订单因此低估了估计的0.06-0.10左右,这就是为什么模型按人数排名的原因.

blocks.en: B People’s counts
blocks.zh: B. 人的计数

blocks.en: B.1 Protocol
blocks.zh: B.1 议定书

blocks.en: Task. CloudResearch Connect, one picture per task ($0.10; under a minute), desktop only, at most 40 pictures per person and round. A task shows the picture ( 1024 2 1024^{2} , re-encoded, under a random file name), the object’s plural, name and LVIS definition, and short instructions with a worked example. People click once on each object of the named kind (numbered dots; a click on a dot removes it) or press “There are none”, may zoom up to three times and may tick “Unsure”. After the first dot they answer “Do the things you marked look like X X s?” (yes, clearly; partly, or hard to tell; no, they look like something else). They never see the request, the model, the method or the stratum. A pilot of 40 pictures from outside the sample confirmed the pay and led to the look-alike question and to harder checks, because people counted some GLIGEN box fills as the named object although they did not look like it. A picture is recognisable when its human count equals the request and the majority look-alike answer is “yes, clearly”.
blocks.zh: 任务 CloudResearch Connect,每个任务一张图片(0.10美元;在一分钟内),只桌面,每人最多40张图片和圆形. 任务显示图片( 1024 2 1024 \\ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \  人们点击命名类型中的每个对象一次(数字点;点击一个点将其删除)或按“没有”,可以放大最多三次,并勾选“不确定”。 在第一个点之后,他们回答“你标记的东西看起来像XXs吗?”(是的,显然;部分;或很难说;不是的,它们看起来像别的东西)。 他们从来没有看到请求,模型,方法或层。 一个来自样本外的40幅图片的飞行员证实了报酬,并导致一个外观相似的问题和更严格的检查,因为人们把一些GLIGEN盒填充作为命名对象,尽管看起来并不像. 当人的计数与请求相等,而大多数看起来相似的答案是“是的,显然”时,画面是可以辨认的。

blocks.en: Rounds and checks. R1: every picture once, in random order, mixed with checks (clean composites of known count from types outside the sample, indistinguishable from the rest). R2: the same tasks in another order, with every R1 participant excluded. R3: every picture whose R1 and R2 counts differ, with further checks, and every R1 and R2 participant excluded. The human count is the R1 count where R1 and R2 agree, and otherwise the median of the three; the look-alike judgement is the majority of the answers behind the human count (no majority: “partly”). All of a person’s answers in a round are set aside if more than half of at least two checks are off by more than two, or if their median time is under 3 s; set-aside pictures are counted again in a top-up of the same round, open only to new people. The eight studies collected no personal data; they were run as paid annotation of generated images ($0.10 per picture, about $12–38 per hour) and were not submitted for IRB review.
blocks.zh: 轮回和检查。 R1:每张图片一次,按随机顺序,与检查混合(从样本以外的类型中得出已知计数的清洁复合材料,与其他的无法区分). R2:按另一个顺序相同的任务,不包括每个R1参与者. R3:每张R1和R2分数不一的图片,加上进一步的检查,每个R1和R2的参与者都排除在外. 人类的计数是R1和R2同意的R1计数,否则为三者的中位数;外观相似的判断是人类计数背后的大多数答案(没有多数:"部分"). 如果至少两张支票的半数以上超过两张, 或中位时间低于3s; 预留的照片在同一轮的顶部再次计算, 这8项研究没有收集个人数据;这些研究是按对生成的图像(每张照片0.10美元,大约每小时12-38美元)的付费说明进行的,没有提交IRB审查。

blocks.en: B.2 The eight studies
blocks.zh: B.2 联合国 八项研究

blocks.en: First count. A1: SD3.5-M 512 2 512^{2} plain images, 16 of S1’s 48 types, requests 2, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 20, 25 and 30, seed 1 (144 images); A2: SDXL, 16 of S2’s types, the same requests (144); A3: FLUX.1-dev, the same 16 types, the same requests without 25 (128); A4: SD3.5-M 768 2 768^{2} plain images of 16 of the 58 types of U2 that have a cut-out, requests as A1 (144); B: self-planted images of the same 16 types at the set’s nine counts (144); C: GLIGEN (grounded at every step) at 12, 16, 20, 25 and 30 (80); D: InstanceAssemble at the nine counts (144); E: 32 self-planted images of U1 and U3 that SAM 3 counted below half the asked count; F: 32 clean composites of known count from other types. 992 pictures; A1–A4 hold every request of each type and seed, so the summaries of Sec. 3 can be computed from human counts, and A4, B, C and D share their types and counts. R1 held the 992 pictures and 80 checks (clean composites of known count 12–25), R3 20 further checks. One R1 participant was set aside (three of five checks off by more than two); their 27 pictures were counted again. Nobody took part in two rounds.
blocks.zh: 初数. A1:SD3.5-M 512 2 512^{2}平面图像,S1的48型中的16型,请求2,4,6,8,12,16,20,25和30型,种子1(144型);A2:SDXL,16型S2型,相同请求(144);A3:FLUX.1-dev,相同请求16型,没有请求25型(128);A4:SD3.5-M 768 2 768^{2}58型U2中16型的平面图像,有截断面,请求为A1(144);B:自种16型的平面图像,请求为A1(144);C:GLIGEN(按每步计),12,16,20,25和30(80);D:9种计(144);E:32幅自植的U1和U3的图像,SAM 3低于要求的半数;F:32幅已知其他类型计数的清洁复合体。 992张图片; A1-A4 持有每种类型和种子的每一个请求,因此Sec 3的概要可以从人数中计算出来, A4, B, C和D 分享它们的类型和计数. R1持有992张照片和80张支票(已知第12-25条的清洁复合材料),R3 20张进一步支票。 1名R1参与者被搁置(5次检查中有3次超过2次);他们的27张图片再次被计数. 没有人参加两轮比赛。

blocks.en: Second count. N, FLUX.2 [klein]’s plain images of the same 16 U2 types at all nine requests (144); P, FLUX.2 [klein] from the planted grids at 12, 16, 20, 25 and 30 (80); G and O, the noise re-layout’s output and its own first pass at the same counts (80 each); T, SD3.5-M with the word amplified at L = 10 L{=}10 (80). With them came 30 checks drawn from the first study’s. That makes 464 pictures besides the checks, with 65 people in R1, 49 in R2 and 29 in R3 (180 pictures). Nobody took part in two rounds or was set aside, and 90–97% of single answers on the checks were exact in each round. T shares types, counts and noise with the first study’s A4 and B, and P shares types, counts and grids with B, so both are compared with them cell by cell.
blocks.zh: 第二计. N, FLUX.2 [klein] 的平面图像,在所有9个请求中都是相同的16种U2型(144);P, FLUX.2 [klein]从植入的网格中以12,16,20,25和30(80);G和O,噪声重播的输出和它自己的第一次通过相同计数(80个各);T, SD3.5-M,单词放大为L=10 L{=}10(80). 从第一次研究中抽取了30张支票。 除了支票之外,还有464张图片,其中65人为R1、49人为R2、29人为R3(180张图片)。 没有人参加两轮或被搁置,每轮90-97%的单项检查答案是准确的。 T与第一个研究的A4和B分享类型,计数和噪音,P与B分享类型,计数和网格,因此两者都按单元格比较.

blocks.en: Third count. The timing test’s swap images of the 16 people-counted types at windows 0–4, 10–14 and 20–24, both pairs (96 pictures), with 20 checks drawn from the first study’s. 41 people in R1, 39 in R2 and 17 in R3 (the 38 pictures whose first two counts differ, with the 20 checks); nobody took part in two rounds or was set aside, no picture failed to load, and 90–95% of single answers on the checks were exact in each round. Its baselines are the first study’s human counts of the same plain images (stratum A4). Participants of earlier studies were not excluded, as the analysed pictures were new (the 20 checks came from the first study).
blocks.zh: 第三计. 计时测试在0–4、10–14和20–24号窗口对16种人计数的图像进行互换,两者都是对(96张图片),其中20张来自第一研究的支票。 R1、39张来自R2和17张来自R3的支票(38张图片的前两张不同,有20张);没有人参加两轮或被搁置,没有一张图片没有加载,每轮90–95%的支票单答都是准确的。 它的基线是第一个研究中同一平原图像(图A4)的人类计数. 早期研究的参与者没有被排除在外,因为分析的照片是新的(20份检查来自第一次研究)。

blocks.en: Fourth count. Qwen-Image’s plain images of the same 16 U2 types at all nine requests (stratum Q, 144 pictures), with 20 checks drawn from the first study’s; its baselines are the first study’s A4 (SD3.5-M) and the second’s N (FLUX.2 [klein]), of the same types and requests. 37 people took part in R1, 34 in R2 and 7 in R3 (the 26 pictures whose first two counts differ, with the 20 checks); one R2 participant was set aside by the check criterion, and their 16 pictures were counted again in a top-up of R2 open only to new people (with one check at each known count). Nobody took part in two rounds, no picture failed to load, and 83–100% of single answers on the checks were exact in each round (83% in R2, counting the participant set aside). The first two counts agree on 82% of the pictures (89% at 2–8, 66% at 25–30), against 57% in the first three studies.
blocks.zh: 第四数. Quen-Image的平面图象,在所有9个请求中都是相同的16个U2型(层Q,144幅图片),其中20幅来自第1个研究的检查;其基线是第1个研究的A4(SD3.5-M)和2个相同类型和请求的N(FLUX.2[klein]). 37人参加了R1,34人参加R2,7人参加R3(前两次计数不一的26张图片,共20张支票);1张R2的参与者按照检查标准被搁置,他们的16张图片被再次计算在只向新人开放的R2的顶级上(每张已知的计数都有一个支票). 没有人参加两轮比赛,没有照片无法装入,而且每轮支票上83-100%的单项答案都准确无误(在R2中为83%,计算了被搁置的参与者 ) 。 头两项考虑同意82%的图片(89%为2-8,66%为25-30),而前三项研究则同意57%。

blocks.en: Fifth count. X, SDXL’s plain images of the same 16 U2 types at all nine requests (the timing test’s baselines; 144 pictures); LC and LS, SD3.5-M with the count and the shuffled LoRA of Sec. E.10 (144 each); FD, FLUX.1-dev’s plain images of the same types and requests, drawn with the sampler of its word test (144). Two batches (X, LC, LS; FD), each with 20 checks drawn from the first study’s. 91, 72 and 31 people took part in the three rounds of the first batch and 43, 35 and 9 in the second; nobody took part in two rounds of a batch or was set aside, no picture failed to load, and 95–100% of single answers on the checks were exact in each round. The first two counts agree on 65% of the pictures (24% of SDXL’s at 12–30). Its baselines are the first study’s A4 (SD3.5-M), the second’s N (FLUX.2 [klein]) and the fourth’s Q (Qwen-Image), of the same types and requests.
blocks.zh: 第五计. X,SDXL在所有9个请求中相同的16种U2型的平面图像(计时测试的基线;144幅图片);LC和LS,SD3.5-M与计数以及Sec. E.10(各144幅);FD,FLUX.1-dev的平面图像,与其单词测试的采样器(144幅)一起绘制. 两批(X,LC,LS;FD),每批20张支票来自第一期研究。 91、72和31人参加了第一批的三轮,43、35和9人参加了第二批;没有人参加了两轮批次或被搁置,没有图片无法装入,每轮95-100%的单次支票答案准确无误。 SDXL的24 % 在12–30。 其基线是第一个研究的A4(SD3.5-M)、第二个研究的N(FLUX.2[klein])和第四个研究的Q(Quen-Image),它们类型和要求相同。

blocks.en: Sixth count. On the 16 people-counted U2 types: SD3.5-M’s plain images of seeds 1 and 2 at 2, 4, 8, 12, 20 and 30, and the number in digits (seed 1) at 12, 20 and 30 (240 pictures; the 96 of seed 1 are those of stratum A4 of the first count, counted again), with 20 checks per round. 31, 30 and 12 people took part in R1, R2 and R3 (the 84 pictures whose first two counts differ); nobody took part in two rounds or was set aside, no picture failed to load, and 95–100% of the checks were exact. The first two counts agree on 65% of the pictures (seeds 1 and 2: 83% and 77% at 2–8, 52% and 60% at 12–30; digits 52%), and the human count of a seed-1 picture equals the first study’s count of the same picture in 71% [59, 82]. A second batch, under the same protocol, counted FLUX.1-dev’s plain images of the same 16 types at seeds 1 and 2, at requests 2, 4, 12 and 25 (the plain cells of the stream test; Sec. D.7 ).
blocks.zh: 第六数. 在16种人统计的U2型中:SD3.5-M的种子1和2的平面图像为2,4,8,12,20和30,数字(种子1)为12,20和30(240幅图片;种子1的96幅是第一位计数的A4层图,再次计数),每轮检查20次. R1、R2、R3(前两张不同照片)中共有31、30和12人参赛;没有人参加两轮比赛或被搁置,没有照片未能加载,95-100%的支票准确无误。 前两项统计同意65%的图片(种子1和2:83%和77%在2–8,52%和60 %在12–30;数字52%),而人类对种子-1图片的计数等于第一项研究对同一图片的计数71%[59,82]. 第二批,根据同一协议,计为FLUX. 1-dev在种子1和2的普通图像相同16种,应请求2、4、12和25(溪流试验的普通细胞;Sec.D.7)。

blocks.en: Seventh count. The four changes past the reach in FLUX.2 [klein] (batch K) and Qwen-Image (batch Q) on the 16 people-counted U2 types at 20, 25 and 30: the plain image of seed 1 (the word test’s, counted again; strata N and Q of the second and fourth counts), the plain image of seed 2, the number in digits and the edit “a photograph of” (192 pictures per model, 288 of them new), each batch with 20 checks drawn from the first study’s. Batch K: 74, 45 and 24 people took part in R1, R2 and R3 (the 96 pictures whose first two counts differ); 90–95% of the checks were exact in each round, and the first two counts agree on 50% of the pictures. Batch Q: 54, 42 and 10 people took part in R1, R2 and R3 (the 39 pictures whose first two counts differ, and two whose R2 answer was still outstanding); 90–100% of the checks were exact in each round, and the first two counts agree on 80% of the pictures. Nobody took part in two rounds of a batch or was set aside, and no picture failed to load ( Sec. D.6 ).
blocks.zh: 第七计. 16种U2在20、25和30时分别用FLUX.2[klein](batch K)和Quen-Image(batch Q)表示:种子1的平面图像(单词测试,再次计算;第二和第三点的N级和Q级)、种子2的平面图像、数字和编辑 " 照片 " (每个模型192张照片,其中288张是新照片),每批有20张来自第一次研究的检查。 批次K:74,45和24人参加了R1,R2和R3(前两项统计不同的96幅图片);每轮90–95%的支票是准确的,前两项统计同意50%的图片. Batch Q:54,42和10人参加了R1,R2和R3的比赛(前两场计数不尽相同,两场的R2答题仍悬而未决的39场);每场的检查有90–100%准确,前两场计数都同意80%的图片. 没有人参加两轮批次或被搁置,没有照片未能装入(Sec.D.6 )。

blocks.en: Eighth count. The fine-scale redraws above four and eight cycles on the 16 people-counted U2 types: SD3.5-M’s at 4, 8, 12, 20 and 30 (batch S, 160 pictures) and FLUX.2 [klein]’s at 4, 8, 12, 20, 25 and 30 (batch K, 192), each batch with 20 checks drawn from the first study’s. Batch S: 84, 72 and 38 people took part in R1, R2 and R3 (the 72 pictures whose first two counts differ). One picture failed to load in R2 and was counted again in a top-up of R2, where one person answered only checks, all three off by more than two, and was set aside; in R3 one person was set aside by the same rule, and their four pictures were counted again in a top-up of R3. The first two counts agree on 55% of the pictures. Batch K: 106, 86 and 34 people took part in R1, R2 and R3 (the 63 pictures whose first two counts differ, and one whose R2 answer was still outstanding); nobody was set aside and no picture failed to load, and the first two counts agree on 67% of the pictures. In the main rounds of both batches 85–100% of the checks were exact, and nobody took part in two rounds of a batch, top-ups included ( Sec. D.8 ).
blocks.zh: 第八计. 16种人计算的U2型的精细比例重划在4和8个周期以上:SD3.5-M的4,8,12,20和30(批S,160张图片)和FLUX.2[克林]的4,8,12,20,25和30(批K,192),每批20张支票来自第一次研究. 批次S:84,72和38人参加了R1,R2和R3(72幅其前两项计数不同的照片). 一张图片没有在R2中加载,再次被计算在R2的顶级上,其中一人只回答支票,三张全部扣掉超过两张,被搁置;在R3中,一人被同样的规则搁置,他们的四张图片被再次计算在R3的顶级上. 前两项罪名同意55%的图片. 批次K:106,86和34人参加了R1,R2和R3(前两条计数不一的63张照片,还有一条R2的答案仍未完成);没有人被搁置,没有照片未能加载,前两条计数同意了67%的图片. 在两批的主要轮次中,85-100%的检查是准确的,没有人参加两批次的检查,包括上调(Sec.D.8)。

blocks.en: B.3 Agreement
blocks.zh: B.3 协定

blocks.en: Single answers disagree most on dense crowds and on occasional misreadings of the object; the third count settles every picture where the first two differ ( Tabs. 7 and 8 ).
blocks.zh: 单一的答案在密集的人群和偶尔误读对象上分歧最大;第三个计数在前两幅不同的图片(Tab. 7和8)中解决每一个图片.

blocks.en: Table 7 : Agreement of the two first counts (single answers of R1 and R2, different people; generated pictures only, without the first study’s 32 clean composites). Exact: equal counts; within 10%: differ by at most 10% of the larger; ICC(A,1) on log ⁡ ( 1 + n ) \log(1{+}n) with a bootstrap interval over pictures. Third study: requests 2 and 4 (“2–8”) and 12 and 25. Single answers disagree most on dense crowds and on occasional misreadings of the object (a 0 against a 20), which lower the ICC; the analysed count is settled by a third count wherever the first two differ.

Table 8 : Agreement. ∗ U2. R1 = R2: the two first counts agree exactly (all requests; 12–30 only). SAM 3 = people: SAM 3’s count equals the human count; bias: mean SAM 3 minus human count. People: R1 77, R2 78, R3 55 (top-ups included), and in the second count 65, 49 and 29; single answers on clean composites .969 exact, final human count 1.00 (32 pictures). Of 32 self-planted images that SAM 3 counted below half of the request, people count 15 below half. At the five counts whose grids have complete rows (12, 16, 20, 25, 30), the two first counts agree on 59% of the self-planted pictures (47 of 80) and on 44% of the plain ones of the same types (35 of 80).
blocks.zh: 表8:协议。 * U2.R1=R2:头两项罪状完全一致(所有请求;只有12-30项)。 SAM 3=人:SAM 3的计数等于人数;偏差:指SAM 3减去人数. 人:R1 77,R2 78,R3 55(包括顶级),第二众65,49和29;清洁复合材料单答969精确,最终人类计数1.00(32张图片). 在SAM 3所统计的32幅自植图像中,低于请求的一半,而人们则低于一半的15幅。 在网格有完整行数(12,16,20,25,30)的5个计数中,前两个计数同意59%的自植图片(47张80)和44%的同类型平原图(35张80).

blocks.en: B.4 People’s counting noise and a noise-matched reference
blocks.zh: B.4 人对噪音的计数和与噪音相称的参考

blocks.en: A model of the noise. A picture has a true count T T , what careful counting finds, and is easy or hard to count: hard with probability logistic ⁡ ( g + 0.76 ​ x + u ) \mathrm{logistic}(g+0.76\,x+u) , where x = log ⁡ ( 1 + T ) − log ⁡ 11 x=\log(1{+}T)-\log 11 , g g is the stratum’s difficulty and u ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , 1.28 2 ) u\sim\mathcal{N}(0,1.28^{2}) the object type’s, shared across strata. Each single count r r , by a different person, is independently exact, zero (the object misread), off by one, or further off, with log ⁡ ( 1 + r ) − log ⁡ ( 1 + T ) \log(1{+}r)-\log(1{+}T) a Student- t t with 0.60 degrees of freedom (a sharp centre and very heavy tails). At T = 12 T{=}12 , an easy picture’s single count is exact with probability 0.85 and zero with 0.06; a hard picture’s is exact with 0.21, off by one with 0.33 and further off with 0.43. For a type of median difficulty, a picture of twelve objects is hard with probability 0.86 in SDXL, 0.60 in SD3.5-M, 0.40 in FLUX.1-dev, 0.11 in FLUX.2 [klein] and 0.02 in Qwen-Image. The final count is the median of three single counts, as in the protocol (where the first two agree, they fix the median). The 34 parameters and a nonparametric prior on T T (0–180) are fitted by maximum likelihood to the 5,360 single counts of the 2,240 generated pictures of the first five counts (19 strata); simpler versions fit worse (AIC + + 575 with one class, + + 316 with one difficulty for all strata, + + 81 without the type effect).

blocks.en: Checks. Where the first two counts differ (880 pictures), the model predicts where the third falls: on one of them in 0.497 of pictures (observed 0.507), between them in 0.167 (0.160), below both in 0.157 (0.152), above both in 0.180 (0.181). Recounted by new people in the sixth count, SD3.5-M’s 96 pictures of A4 keep their final count in 0.71 [0.59, 0.82] of cases (predicted 0.69), and the two final counts differ by a mean | Δ ​ log ⁡ ( 1 + n ) | |\Delta\log(1{+}n)| of 0.10 [0.05, 0.17], 0.12 [0.05, 0.21] on the 48 crowds of 12–30 (0.65 of them unchanged) and 0.12 [0.05, 0.20] on the 32 pictures of four and eight objects; FLUX.1-dev’s 64 recounted pictures keep theirs in 0.875 [0.80, 0.95] of cases (predicted 0.870). The model reproduces how often the first two counts agree to within 0.04 in eleven strata, A1–A4, N and X among them; it is noisier than the data for Qwen-Image and FLUX.1-dev (agreement 0.73 and 0.66, against 0.82 and 0.75 observed) and has too few large disagreements on SDXL’s crowds at 12–30 (first two counts apart by a factor of 1.5 or more, zeros excluded: 0.24 of pictures, against 0.32 observed), which the single-count bound below covers. On the 32 clean composites of 12–30 objects, 64 of 66 single answers and all 32 final counts are exact: the noise belongs to generated crowds, not to counting itself. On pictures of 12–30 objects the final count is exact in 42–94% and within 10% in 78–96% of pictures, depending on the model’s crowds (a single count is exact in 30–82%), with a mean | Δ ​ log ⁡ ( 1 + n ) | |\Delta\log(1{+}n)| of 0.04–0.11: its errors are mostly a few objects.
blocks.zh: 检查 在前两项统计不同(880幅图片)的地方,模型预测了第三项的落差:在其中的0.497幅图片上(观测到的0.507幅图片),在0.167幅(0.160幅)之间,低于0.157幅(0.152幅),在0.180幅(0.181幅)以上。 SD3.5-M的96张A4照片在第六次计数中被新人重新计算,最终计数以0.71 [0.59, 0.82](预测为0.69)为例, 两项最终计数则与4个和8个物体的32张照片的0.10 [0.05, 017], 0.12 [0.05, 0.21] 和0.12 [0.05, 0.2] 的平均值不同; FLUX. 维基百科中的相关条目: 维基百科中的相关条目: 维基语录链接:名人名言 模式转载了前两项计数在0.04年的11个等级,即A1-A4、N和X;它比Quen-Image和FLUX.1-Dev的数据(协议0.73和0.66,观测到0.82和0.75)要多多少少,对SDXL在12-30的人群存在很大的分歧(前两项计数相差1.5或更多,不包括0:0.24图片,观测到的0.32),下面的单一计数覆盖了这一点。 在12–30物体的32个清洁复合材料上,66个单项答案中的64个和所有32个最终计数都是准确的:噪音属于产生的人群,而不是自己计数. 在12–30个物体的照片上,最终计数精确于42–94 %,在78–96 % 的图片中计数精确于10 %,这取决于模型的人群(单一计数精确于30–82 %),其平均值为 QQ log QQ(1+n) QQ Delta\log(1+{+}n) 0.04–0.11 :其错误大多是少数物体.

blocks.en: The loose estimator, counted by people. We simulate the loose estimator of Sec. A.5 on the people-counted design (16 types, one seed, the nine requests; 4,000 sets), take each of its counts as a picture’s true count and replace it by a final count drawn from this model, with the counting difficulty of the compared model’s own pictures ( matched ; a type’s difficulty is shared by its requests and seeds), and summarize each set with the models’ estimators; a reference’s brackets give the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of its sets. So counted, with the difficulty of the word test’s pictures pooled, its order at 12–30 falls only from 0.835 to 0.810 at s = 0.30 s{=}0.30 and from 0.755 to 0.739 at s = 0.45 s{=}0.45 ([0.73, 0.87] and [0.65, 0.82]); with each model’s own difficulty it is the same within 0.01, and so under every fitted variant of the noise model (0.806–0.816 and 0.736–0.744). Its slope falls from 0.945 to 0.91, and its exact rate at 12–30 from 7.2% to 6.8% and from 4.7% to 4.6%. Its exact lift is 4.0 and 1.8 points at 12–30, and 2.7 [ − - 3.1, 9.9] and 1.2 [ − - 3.6, 7.3] points at 20–30. On 16 types and two seeds, a new number moves its count 1.70 [1.32, 2.19] and 1.39 [1.11, 1.77] times as far as a new seed among 12, 20 and 30 (1.96 and 1.48 without the noise; SD3.5-M’s difficulty), with an order of the number change of 0.88 and 0.80, and 1.93 and 1.51 times between 12 and 25 (FLUX.1-dev’s difficulty). Counted once by one person instead, a deliberately generous bound far noisier than the final counts, it orders at 0.750 and 0.696 with a slope of 0.83, and its ratio among 12, 20 and 30 is 1.32 and 1.21. Read through SAM 3’s errors (a model of SAM 3’s misses and errors fitted against people’s final counts, or each simulated type borrowing one real type’s errors as in Sec. A.5 ), its order at 12–30 is 0.64–0.73 and its number/seed ratio among 12, 20 and 30 1.05–1.20: SAM 3’s ratio for SD3.5-M over the nine requests still lies below it (0.89 [0.80, 0.99], against 1.05 [0.98, 1.12]), the ratios of the four changes in SD3.5-M and FLUX.1-dev do not (1.03–1.59, Sec. D.5 ), and their SAM 3 orders of the number change past ten (0.41–0.53) do. At 20–30 (FLUX.2 [klein] and Qwen-Image, Sec. D.6 ) the estimator read by SAM 3 orders at 0.59–0.60 with a ratio of 1.03–1.04; FLUX.2 [klein]’s SAM 3 order lies below it, Qwen-Image’s (0.65) inside it.

blocks.en: Adjacent requests and an operational reach. Taking the requests in adjacent pairs (one pair per type; a pair passes when the 2.5% quantile of its order’s type bootstrap, computed exactly, is above 0.5), the largest request whose pair with the next request passes is 6 for FLUX.1-dev, 4 for SD3.5-M, 6 for SDXL, 16 for Qwen-Image and 8 for FLUX.2 [klein], the same in only 28–68% of type resamples, while a loose estimator counted by people stops by this rule at a median of 8 at s = 0.45 s{=}0.45 and of 16 at s = 0.30 s{=}0.30 : with 16 types, this operational reach separates no model from a loose estimator at s = 0.45 s{=}0.45 (at s = 0.30 s{=}0.30 only SD3.5-M’s reach of 4 is unusual: 2% of the reference’s sets stop as early). The adjacent orders separate more: from 25 to 30, four models order their crowds below the matched s = 0.45 s{=}0.45 reference’s 2.5th percentile (FLUX.1-dev 0.12, SD3.5-M 0.27, FLUX.2 [klein] 0.33 and Qwen-Image 0.36, against 0.38), and FLUX.1-dev also from 8 to 12 (0.42 against 0.50), five of 40 pair tests where one is expected by chance.

blocks.en: Orders from single counts. People’s orders at 12–30 do not hinge on the third count: computed from the first count alone and from the second alone, they are 0.72 and 0.70 for SDXL (final 0.77), 0.68 and 0.67 for Qwen-Image (0.70), 0.66 and 0.63 for FLUX.2 [klein] (0.62), 0.54 and 0.49, 0.48 and 0.55 for SD3.5-M at 512 2 512^{2} and 768 2 768^{2} (0.49, 0.54), and 0.41 and 0.53 for FLUX.1-dev (0.52). Single counts of crowds are noisy: the two first counts’ log difference has an SD of 0.94–1.13 at 12–30 in SDXL, FLUX.2 [klein] and Qwen-Image and 0.66–0.77 in the others, so a single count’s own scatter in log ⁡ ( 1 + n ) \log(1{+}n) is about 0.47–0.80; the final counts, medians of three where the first two differ, are steadier, which is why the main text uses them.

blocks.en: Ties and zeros. Among same-type request pairs at 12–30, people’s final counts tie in 17% (SD3.5-M 512 2 512^{2} ), 21% (SD3.5-M 768 2 768^{2} ), 4% (SDXL), 30% (FLUX.1-dev; 96 pairs, no request of 25) and 9% (FLUX.2 [klein]) of pairs, which the order leaves out; at 2–8 in 16%, 21%, 4%, 5% and 14%. People counted no object in 1–9% of these pictures at 12–30 (SD3.5-M 768 2 768^{2} : 9%). Qwen-Image’s final counts tie in 23% of pairs at 12–30 and 4% at 2–8. Counting a tie as half a pair that follows the request instead of setting it aside, people’s orders at 12–30 become 0.49 and 0.53 (SD3.5-M 512 2 512^{2} , 768 2 768^{2} ), 0.52 (FLUX.1-dev), 0.76 (SDXL), 0.61 (FLUX.2 [klein]) and 0.66 (Qwen-Image), within 0.05 of those in Tabs. 12 and 15 . (SDXL and FLUX.1-dev here are the first count’s, on S2.)

C.2 Where the crowd stops growing

blocks.en: Model. With y = log ⁡ ( 1 + n ) y=\log(1{+}n) and a type intercept a j a_{j} , the cap model is y = a j + log ⁡ ( 1 + min ⁡ ( c , K ) ) + ε y=a_{j}+\log(1{+}\min(c,K))+\varepsilon : the crowd follows the request up to the request K K and stays flat above it. K K is fitted by least squares on 500 log-spaced values from 2 to 60; K ≥ 30 K\geq 30 means no ceiling within the requests. Intervals: 95% bootstrap over object types (2,000 resamples), with K K refitted in every resample; paired ratios use the same resampled types for both models. As alternatives we fit a power law y = a j + log ⁡ ( 1 + c β ) y=a_{j}+\log(1{+}c^{\beta}) and a broken stick with a profiled knee. Fitted again with other resamples, SD3.5-M, FLUX.2 [klein] and Qwen-Image keep their point estimates, and their intervals differ by at most 0.7 ( Tab. 13 gives one fit for all U2 models).

KK在2至60个对数的500个对数空格上安装至少方形;K 30 K\geq 30表示请求中无上限。 间距:95%的靴子夹在对象类型之上(2,000个复刻版),每复刻版中K重刻版;配对比率对两种模型都使用相同的复刻版类型. 作为替代品,我们符合权力定律 y = a j + log → (1 + c β ) y = a _{j → log (1 + {+}c ^{\beta }) 和一条有膝盖特征的断棍. 与其它复标再次装配,SD3.5-M,FLUX.2[klein]和Quen-Image保留它们的点估计,它们的间隔最多以0.7(Tab.13给出了一个适合所有U2模型).

C.4 Reward-tuned checkpoints
blocks.zh: C.4 奖励调整检查站

blocks.en: Flow-GRPO [ 37 ] (GenEval reward, counts of two to four) and DiffusionNFT [ 69 ] (a multi-reward checkpoint) are run like the base model on S1. Relative to the base model on the same cells, Flow-GRPO raises the exact lift by 0.323 [0.255, 0.388] at 2–4 objects and by 0.017 [ − - 0.002, 0.035] at 10–16 ( + + 0.012 at 10–30). Two further checkpoints, Flow-GRPO without its KL term (rewarded at two to four) and a GenEval2-rewarded LoRA [ 49 , 25 ] (rewarded at two to seven, at 1024 2 1024^{2} against a 1024 2 1024^{2} base), raise the exact lift by + 0.16 +0.16 and + 0.11 +0.11 where they are rewarded and move it by − 0.005 -0.005 [ − - 0.018, 0.007] and + 0.009 +0.009 [ − - 0.029, 0.045] at 10–30; under Grounding DINO the second moves it by + 0.044 +0.044 [0.016, 0.070]. The second checkpoint’s own lift at 10–30 is + 0.034 +0.034 [0.007, 0.061] under SAM 3, the largest we measured above ten: it draws the exact count in 11.2% of images at 10–30 against 5.7% for its base, most of them at requests of ten and eleven (31% and 38%), and in 3.5% at 12–30. Two Flow-GRPO checkpoints tuned for other rewards (PickScore and text rendering) move it by + 0.22 +0.22 and + 0.05 +0.05 at two to four and by + 0.012 +0.012 [ − - 0.012, 0.040] and − 0.003 -0.003 [ − - 0.016, 0.009] at 10–30. Rewards on small counts raise the exact lift where they reward it and barely above ten, and the largest lift above ten comes mostly from requests of ten and eleven.

blocks.en: C.6 A current large model: Qwen-Image
blocks.zh: 第6条 当前大型模型 : 文-图像

blocks.en: Design. Qwen-Image [ 60 ] , a 20B transformer whose text encoder is the vision-language model Qwen2.5-VL-7B [ 1 ] , from the official weights (revision 75e0b4b ) in diffusers 0.41 with the pipeline’s defaults: 1024 2 1024^{2} , 50 steps, true classifier-free guidance 4.0 with the negative prompt “ ”. To fit a 24 GB L4 GPU, the transformer is quantized to 4-bit NF4 with bitsandbytes (compute in bf16); the text encoder, VAE and scheduler are unchanged, and the sampler passes the text encoder’s padding mask as the pipeline returns it. Prompts are U2’s (“a photo of twelve cribs”), requests 2, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 20, 25 and 30, seed 1; one starting latent per type, drawn on the CPU from the type’s seed, is shared by the nine requests. Qwen-Image was run on the 16 people-counted types of U2 (144 images), which people counted in the fourth study ( Sec. B ). An image takes about 173 s.
blocks.zh: 设计. Wen-Image [60],是一台20B型变压器,其文本编码器为视觉语言型号Quen2.5-VL-7B [1],从输油管默认值为1024 2 1024^{2},50步,真实的无分级制导4.0与负速". 为了装配24GB L4 GPU,变压器被量化为4位的NF4,并配有比特和字节(compute in bf16);文本编码器,VAE和调度器没有变化,样品通过文本编码器的垫面罩时,管道返回. 提示是U2 ' s ( " 十二个婴儿床的照片 " ),请求2、4、6、8、12、16、20、25和30,种子1;从该类型种子抽取的CPU上抽取的每类潜伏物由9项请求分享。 Quen-Image运行在16种人统计的U2型(144幅图像)上,人们在第四期研究(Sec. 一个图像大约需要173s.
