Qwen-Image minus SD3.5-M by people: order at 12–30 + + .16 [.02, .31], exact + + .18 [.11, .24], within 10% + + .18 [.08, .28], recognisable + + .15 [.09, .21]; minus FLUX.2 [klein]: + + .08 [ − - .09, .24], + + .09 [ − - .01, .19], + + .05 [ − - .05, .15], + + .11 [.01, .21]. Under SAM 3, Qwen-Image minus SD3.5-M: order + + .22 [.06, .39], exact + + .10 [.04, .16].

Results. By people, Qwen-Image is exact in 100%, 94%, 94% and 50% of images at 2, 4, 6 and 8, and in 63%, 25%, 13%, 6% and 0% at 12, 16, 20, 25 and 30 (within 10%: 75%, 31%, 25%, 6% and 0%); its median count is 12, 12, 15.5, 16 and 15. People’s order at 12–30 is 0.70 [0.57, 0.82] (0.70 without pictures marked unsure) and their exact rate 0.21: Qwen-Image’s word orders large crowds partly and rarely gives their exact count. People tie on 23% of same-type pairs at 12–30, and judge the marked objects to look like the named one in 75% of the 142 pictures with marked objects (“partly” in the rest). Counters miss the larger grids: against people, SAM 3 is exact on 55% of Qwen-Image’s pictures and undercounts by 2.5 objects on average (by 3.0 at 25–30); it finds no object in 24% of Qwen-Image’s images, most often at requests of 4 to 12.
blocks.zh: 结果。 在人们看来,在2、4、6和8的图像中,文-伊玛目准确比例为100%、94%、94%和50%;在12、16、20、25和30的图像中,63%、25%、13%、6%和0%(在10%之内:75%、31%、25%、6%和0%);其中位数为12、12、15.5、16和15。 12–30时人民订单为0.70 [0.57,0.82] (0.70没有图片标记不确定),其精确率0.21: Qwen-Image的言语命令大量人群部分地, 人们在12–30时将23%的同型对打平,并判断标有标记的物体在142张标有标记物体的图片(其余的为“部分”)的75%中看起来像一个。 计数器错失了更大的网格:对人而言,SAM 3精确在55 %的Quen-Image图片上,平均低估了2.5个对象(在25–30时为3.0;在Quen-Image图像的24%中找不到任何对象,最常见的是4–12的请求.

blocks.en: Grids and object scale. SAM 3’s boxes form a complete grid (at least two rows and two columns, every row holding the same number of objects, the count equal to rows times columns; rows and columns found from gaps of half the median box size) in 34% of Qwen-Image’s images at 12–30, against 9%, 14% and 0% for SD3.5-M, FLUX.2 [klein] and SDXL on the same types; people find the requested count in 37% of Qwen-Image’s complete grids and in 13% of its other images (SD3.5-M: 29% of its 7 complete grids against 1%; FLUX.2 [klein]: 18% of 11 against 12%), and 10 of Qwen-Image’s 17 exact images at 12–30 are complete grids. Qwen-Image’s objects shrink with the request at 2–8 (scale slope − - 1.03 [ − - 1.41, − - 0.77]) and not at 12–30 ( − - 0.12 [ − - 0.33, 0.09]).
blocks.zh: 网格和对象尺度。 SAM 3的盒子组成一个完整的网格(至少两行和两列,每列持有相同数目的物体,计数等于列数;从中位框大小一半的空隙中发现的行和列),在12–30时为34%的Quen-Imag的图像,而SD3.5-M、FLUX.2[KLIN]和SDXL为9 %、14 %和0 %;在12–30时为37%的Quen-Imag的完整网格和13%的其他图像(SD3.5-M:其7个完整网格的29%对1%;FLUX.2[KLIN]:其11对12%的18%)中,以及Quen-Imag的17个精确网格中的10个是完整的网格。 Wen-Image的物体随请求而缩水在2–8(比例坡度−1.03 [−−1.41,−−-0.77]),而不是12–30(−0.12 [−−-0.33,0.09]).

blocks.en: C.7 The room test
blocks.zh: 第7条 房间测试

blocks.en: Design. SD3.5-M at 768 2 768^{2} , 40 steps, guidance 4.5, U2’s 64 types, seed 1, the plain sampler; every image copies the task of U2’s plain image of its type and request (same noise) and changes only the prompt: “a photo of twelve cribs, seen from far away” ( far ) or “a photo of twelve tiny cribs” ( tiny ), at 2, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 20, 25 and 30 (1,152 images), counted by SAM 3, Grounding DINO and OWLv2. If the frame’s room limited the count, a cue that makes the objects smaller should let the crowd follow the request; how much a cue shrinks the objects is measured by the area ratio of Tab. 16 .
blocks.zh: 设计. SD3.5-M at 768 2 768^{2},40步,向导4.5,U2的64型,种子1,平原采样器;每幅图像复制U2的平原图像的任务,其类型和请求(相同的噪音),只改变提示: " 从远处看到的十二个婴儿床的照片"(远处)或"十二个小婴儿床的照片"(很小),在2,4,6,8,12,16,20,25和30(1,152个图像),由SAM 3,Grounding DINO和OWLv2计算. 如果帧的空间限制计数, 使对象较小的提示应该让人群听从请求; 以 Tab 16 的面积比测量对象的提示缩小了多少 。

blocks.en: Results. far shrinks the objects to 0.47 times the plain area [0.35, 0.61]; they cover 29–36% of the median image at 12–30, against 50–64% without the cue. Its order at 12–30 is 0.54 [0.46, 0.61], against 0.46 [0.38, 0.53] for the plain prompt from the same noise (difference 0.08 [ − - 0.02, 0.19]); the median count rises to 9–10 but stays flat across requests. tiny shrinks the objects less (0.72 [0.60, 0.87]), yet raises the order to 0.648 [0.57, 0.72] (difference 0.19 [0.11, 0.28]); under OWLv2 it raises it too (0.62, difference 0.16 [0.07, 0.25]), but not under Grounding DINO (0.46, difference 0.07 [ − - 0.04, 0.18]). Neither cue changes the exact rate at 12–30 (2.2% and 2.5%, against 2.5%) or the order at 2–8 (0.88 and 0.85, against 0.89). Halving the objects’ area does not make the crowd follow the request, so room does not limit the count; “tiny” moves the order partway under SAM 3 and OWLv2 but not under Grounding DINO.
blocks.zh: 结果:物体远缩小到平原面积的0.47倍[0.35,0.61];它们覆盖了12-30的中位图像的29-36%,而没有提示的则占50-64%。 它在12–30的顺序是0.54 [0.46, 0.61],相对于0.46 [0.38, 0.53] 平原来自同一噪声的迅速音(差数0.08 [− - 0.02, 0.19]);中位数上升至9–10,但在请求中保持平整. 微小的物体缩小(0.72 [0.60,0.87]),但将序数提高到0.648 [0.57,0.72] (差数为0.19 [0.11,0.28]);在OWLv2下,它也提高(0.62,差数为0.16 [0.07,0.25]),但不在Grounding DINO下(0.46,差数为0.07 [−0.04,0.18])。 无论是12–30(2.2%和2.5%,对2.5%)还是2–8(0.88和0.85,对0.89)的顺序,都没有改变确切的比率。 将物体的面积缩小不会使人群遵从请求,所以房间不会限制计数; " tiny " 移动SAM 3和OWLv2的指令部分,但不会在地面DINO下。

blocks.en: C.8 Object size
blocks.zh: C.8 联合国 对象大小

blocks.en: Figure 9 : A word that moves the count also shrinks the objects (the word asked at every step against the base request’s image, SAM 3, 64 types). Shift in object size toward the word (log median box area, smaller for the larger number) against shift in count, per model and pair, with 95% intervals; dotted: equal shifts. Past SD3.5-M’s reach, “twelve” against “twenty-five” does neither.
blocks.zh: 图9:移动计数的单词也会缩小对象(每一步询问的单词与基础请求的图像,SAM 3,64类型). 对象大小向单词(log中位框区域,小于较大数字)方向移动,相对于计数变化,每个模型和对对,间隔95%;点:等位移. 过去,SD3.5-M的“12”和“25”的“范围”都不是。

blocks.en: With the word swapped in for the whole trajectory (the timing test’s full-swap cells, SAM 3; Fig. 9 ), wherever the word moves the count toward itself it also moves the objects’ size: for “two” against “four” in all three models of the timing test, and for “twelve” against “twenty-five” in SDXL and FLUX.2 [klein], a larger number gives more and smaller objects, with a shift of the log median box area 0.9–1.5 times the shift of log ⁡ ( 1 + n ) \log(1{+}n) ( Fig. 9 ). Past SD3.5-M’s reach the same swap shifts neither on average (size + + 0.01 [ − - 0.32, 0.35], count 0.00), although it changes the crowd nearly as much as a new seed: the model makes room for more objects by shrinking them, as long as the word points it there. How a model fits a larger crowd into the same frame shows in its object sizes ( Tab. 17 ; SAM 3 boxes of the plain images with at least one object found). SD3.5-M’s objects shrink with the request up to about ten and then stop: past ten its median box covers 6–11% of the image whatever the request, and the boxes together cover a similar share of the image (54–62% in the median image at 12–30; two seeds). FLUX.2 [klein]’s objects keep shrinking past ten, to about 2% of the image at 25 and 30. SDXL’s objects keep shrinking past ten on U2 (to 2.0% of the image at thirty); on its screened set they are already small at twelve and shrink less by SAM 3, which misses the smallest objects of its densest crowds ( Tab. 8 ) and finds none of the object in 23–27% of SDXL’s U2 images at 12–30 (left out of the box medians). Qwen-Image’s objects (16 types of U2) shrink with the request up to about twelve and then stop, as its crowd does.
blocks.zh: 将整个轨迹(计时测试的全扫描单元格SAM 3;图9)换成单词,无论该单词将计数推向自己,它也会移动对象的大小:对于所有三种计时测试模型中的 " 2 " 相对 " 4 " ,对于SDXL和FLUX.2[klein]中的 " 25 " 对应 " 12 " ,一个较大的数字给出了更多、更小的物体,对数的中位数区位移为0.9 -1.5倍的对数(1+n)\log(1{+}n) (图9). 过去SD3.5-M的同一种互换变化既不是平均的(大小++0.01 [−−−−0.32,0.35],计数0.00),虽然它几乎像一个新种子一样改变人群:模型通过缩小它们而为更多的对象留有空间,只要字指在那里即可. 一个模型如何将更大的群合到它的对象大小(Tab. 17; SAM 3盒的平面图像中,至少找到一个对象)的同一帧中. SD3.5-M的物体随请求缩水到大约10个,然后停下来:过去10个它的中位框覆盖了图像的6-11%,不管请求是什么,盒子一起覆盖了图像的类似份额(在12-30的中位影像中54-62%;两个种子). FLUX.2[Klein]的物体不断缩小,超过10个,在25和30时达到图像的2%左右. SDXL的物体在U2上持续缩小超过10个(到30时的图像的2.0%);在其筛选的套装上,它们已经小到12个,而小于SAM 3,它错过了最密集的物体(Tab.8),在SDXL的U2图像中,有23到27 % 在12到30时没有发现任何物体(从框中位数中选择)。 Quen-Image的物体(16种U2)随着请求缩水到12个左右,然后像人群那样停止。

blocks.en: Table 17 : Object size against the request (SAM 3, plain images). Slope: per type, the least-squares slope of the log median box area on the log request (images with at least one object; types with at least three such requests), averaged over types with a 95% bootstrap interval (Qwen-Image: 9 types at 2–8 and 13 at 12–30); − 1 -1 means objects shrink just enough for the requested number to fit, 0 that their size ignores the request.

blocks.en: C.9 Orders by window, effective scatter and an operational reach
blocks.zh: C.9 联合国 按窗口、有效分散和可操作范围订购

blocks.en: Design. A descriptive re-analysis of existing counts (no new images): the annotators’ final counts of the word tests, 16 types per set and seed 1, and SAM 3’s counts of all types of each set. The order is that of Eq. 1 , pooled over types as a ratio of sums with ties dropped; intervals use the fixed type-bootstrap indices of the other tests (20,000 resamples, all seeds of a type resampled together). Windows: 2–8; 12–30; 12–25, exactly the pairs of 12–30 without thirty; the four pairs with thirty; adjacent requests; and sliding windows of three consecutive requests. Effective scatter : the loose estimator of Sec. A.5 , n = round ⁡ ( c ​ e s ​ z ) n=\mathrm{round}(c\,e^{sz}) , is simulated for s = 0.05 , 0.10 , … , 3.00 s=0.05,0.10,\dots,3.00 and read through the annotators’ noise model ( Sec. B.4 ) with the counting difficulty of the model’s own pictures; its expected order on the window (100,000 simulated types per s s , made non-increasing in s s ) is inverted at the model’s order, and the order’s interval is mapped through the same curve. Matched to the models’ pictures, the estimator orders 12–25 at 0.79–0.80 ( s = 0.30 s{=}0.30 ) and 0.72 ( s = 0.45 s{=}0.45 ), and 2–8 at about 0.92 and 0.85. Reach (sliding): the middle request of the first window of three consecutive requests whose effective scatter exceeds s ∗ s^{*} , or 30 if none; we use s ∗ = 1 s^{*}{=}1 , a typical factor of 2.7, about twice the loosest reference scatter ( Tab. 20 ). Alternatives: s ∗ = 0.75 s^{*}{=}0.75 , and the first adjacent pair whose order lies below the 2.5th percentile of the s = 0.45 s{=}0.45 estimator.
blocks.zh: 设计. 对现有计数(无新图像)的描述性重新分析:注释者对单词测试的最终计数,每集16种和种子1,以及SAM 3对每集各类计数. 顺序为Eq. 1, 集合在类型上, 以总和比例表示, 连结下降; 间隔使用其他测试的固定类型- bootstrap指数( 20,000 复标, 所有类型复标的种子) 。 Windows: 2–8; 12–30; 12–25,确切的对数为12–30不包含30;四对不包含30;相邻请求;以及连续三个请求的滑动窗口. 有效散射:Sec. A.5, n = 圆_(ce s z) n=\mathrm{round}(c\,e^{sz})的松散估计器,为s = 0.05,0.10,.,3.00 s = 0.05,0.10,\dots,3.00,通过注音器的噪声模型(Sec. B.4)读取,并带有模型自己照片的计数困难;其窗口的预期顺序(每秒100 000个模拟类型,在ss 中不增加)按模型的顺序倒置,命令的间隔通过同一曲线映射。 与模型照片相匹配的是,估计器订购了12–25,0.79–0.80(s = 0.30 s{=}0.30)和0.72(s = 0.45 s{=}0.45),2–8约0.92和0.85. 到达(滑动):三个连续请求的第一个窗口的中间请求,其有效散射数超过s * s ,如果无,则为30;我们使用s = 1 s = 1,典型系数为2.7,约为最宽的参考散射数的两倍(Tab. 20)。 替代品: s = 0.75 s = 0.75 s = 0.75,以及第一对相邻的配对,其顺序低于 s = 0.45 s = 0.45 估计器。

Effective scatter: the s s at which a loose estimator, counted with the annotators’ noise at the model’s own counting difficulty, has the model’s expected order; interval: the order’s interval mapped through the same curve; > > 3: the order lies below the curve at s = 3 s{=}3 (an order at or below 0.5 has no finite s s ). Reach, sliding: the middle request of the first window of three consecutive requests whose effective scatter exceeds s ∗ s^{*} (30 if none); adjacent pairs: the lower request of the first adjacent pair whose order lies below the 2.5th percentile of the s = 0.45 s{=}0.45 estimator; intervals: 2.5th–97.5th percentiles over type resamples. Cap K K : the cap model of Sec. C.2 .

blocks.en: The pairs with thirty. FLUX.2 [klein] and Qwen-Image order 12–25 as a loose estimator would (effective scatters 0.42 and 0.33) and lose order on the pairs with thirty (differences − - 0.30 [ − - 0.54, − - 0.04] and − - 0.19 [ − - 0.37, − - 0.02]; Tab. 18 ). SAM 3 on all 64 of FLUX.2 [klein]’s types agrees (12–25: 0.75 [0.67, 0.83]; pairs with 30: 0.55 [0.44, 0.65]); on Qwen-Image’s 16 types it shows no thirty effect ( + + 0.01 [ − - 0.20, + + 0.24]). FLUX.1-dev’s reversal at 12–30 (0.36) comes from its largest requests: at 12–25 its order is 0.47, on the pairs with thirty 0.17. SD3.5-M at 768 2 768^{2} and SDXL show no thirty effect, SD3.5-M at 512 2 512^{2} (S1) does. SD3.5-M’s word test on all 64 U2 types, which also asked 14, 19, 22 and 27, gives by SAM 3: pairs ( c , 25 ) (c,25) with c c from 12 to 22, 0.54 [0.45, 0.63]; ( c , 27 ) (c,27) 0.54; ( c , 30 ) (c,30) 0.48; 25/27 0.47 and 27/30 0.43; its median for “nineteen” (4) is as low as for “thirty”. Annotators’ median at thirty lies below that at twenty-five in five of the seven sets that asked both (SD3.5-M on U2 8.5 to 4.5 and on S1 9.5 to 7.5, FLUX.1-dev 2 to 1.5, FLUX.2 [klein] 20 to 9, Qwen-Image 16 to 15; SDXL 18 to 18 on U2 and 33 to 43.5 on S2). Single number words past the reach carry their own crowd sizes, so a verdict over 12–30 can hinge on one word.
blocks.zh: 以三十为对. FLUX.2 [Klein]和Quen-Image定单12-25作为松散的估测符(有效散开0.42和0.33),在30对对对对对对(差数−−-0.30[−0.54,−0.04]和−0.19[−0.37,−0.02];Tab.18)上失去定单。 FLUX.2[Klein]所有64类中的SAM 3同意(12-25:0.75 [0.67,0.83];30:0.55 [0.44,0.65]);在Quen-Image的16类上,它没有显示30种效果(++0.01[−0.20,+++0.24)]。 FLUX.1-dev在12–30(0.36)时的逆转来自其最大的请求:在12–25时,它的订单为0.47,在对对上为300.17. SD3.5-M at 768 2 768^{2}和 SDXL 显示无三十种效果, SD3.5-M 显示为 512 2 512^{2} (S1). SD3.5-M对所有64种U2型的单词试验,也要求14、19、22和27, SAM3给出:对(c, 25)(c, 25),c从12到22, 0.54 [0.45, 0.63]; (c, 27)(c, 27) 0.54; (c, 30)(c, 30) 048; 25/27 0.47和27/30 0.43; " 十九 " (4)的中位数低于 " 三十 " 。 标注员的中位数为30,低于要求两者的7套中25套(SD3.5-M在U2 8.5至4.5和S1 9.5至7.5、FLUX.1-dev 2至1.5、FLUX.2[klein] 20至9、Quen-Image 16至15;SDXL 18至18在U2和S2的33至43.5)。 单数单词在到达范围后会带有自己的人群大小,因此超过12–30的判断可以依赖于一个词.

blocks.en: Between 20 and 30 in FLUX.2 [klein] and Qwen-Image. The seventh count’s per-pair orders cannot be computed from its stored pooled values; its seed-2 order follows exactly from them (Qwen-Image 28 of 38 differing pairs, 0.74; FLUX.2 [klein] 15 of 41, 0.37). On the same seed-1 pictures, the earlier annotators’ count gives 20/25, 20/30 and 25/30 orders of 0.50 (8/8/0), 0.25 and 0.33 for FLUX.2 [klein] and 0.45, 0.45 and 0.36 for Qwen-Image; SAM 3 on both seeds gives 0.52 [0.32, 0.72], 0.20 [0.00, 0.44] and 0.27 [0.09, 0.47] for FLUX.2 [klein] and 0.74 [0.53, 0.91], 0.78 [0.62, 0.92] and 0.57 [0.33, 0.80] for Qwen-Image. FLUX.2 [klein]’s missing direction between 20 and 30 is thus no direction between twenty and twenty-five and a reversal for thirty; taken alone, its 20/25 order (0.50 over 16 pairs) is above the 2.5th percentile of the matched s = 0.45 s{=}0.45 estimator for that pair (0.38). Qwen-Image’s two seeds disagree (0.46 and 0.74), which 16 types per seed cannot resolve.
blocks.zh: FLUX.2[klein]和Quen-Image中的20到30之间. 第七个伯爵的每帕订单不能从其储存的集合值中计算出来;它的种子-2顺序完全按照它们来计算(38对不同配对中的Quen-Image 28,0.74;41的FLUX.2 [klein] 15,0.37). 在同一种子-1图片上,较早的注释者计数给出了20/25,20/30和25/30的订单,FLUX.2[klein]为0.50,0.25和0.33,Quen-Image为0.45,0.45和0.36;SAM 3在两个种子上给出了0.52 [0.32,0.72],0.20 [0.00,0.44]和0.27 [0.09,0.47] FLUX.2[klein]为0.74 [0.53,0.91],0.78 [0.62,0.92]和0.57 [0.33,0.80]为Quen-Image. FLUX.2 [Klein]在20至30之间的缺失方向因此在25至25之间不是方向,在30之间是倒转;仅取其20/25顺序(0.50对16对)高于对应S=0.45s=0.45的2.5百分位数。 Quen-Image的两个种子有分歧(0.46和0.74),每个种子有16种无法解决.

blocks.en: Models compared. Paired on the 16 shared U2 types at 12–25, FLUX.2 [klein] and Qwen-Image order their crowds more than SD3.5-M ( + + 0.16 [ + + 0.02, + + 0.32] and + + 0.21 [ + + 0.03, + + 0.40]) and than FLUX.1-dev ( + + 0.26 [ + + 0.04, + + 0.48] and + + 0.31 [ + + 0.09, + + 0.52]); SDXL cannot be separated from either group, nor SD3.5-M from FLUX.1-dev ( + + 0.10 [ − - 0.03, + + 0.22]). By the sliding reach ( s ∗ = 1 s^{*}{=}1 ) the models rank FLUX.1-dev 8, SDXL 12, SD3.5-M 16, FLUX.2 [klein] and Qwen-Image 25, but only FLUX.1-dev and Qwen-Image are separated (difference − - 4 request steps [ − - 4, − - 1]); the adjacent-pair reach separates none. A loose estimator itself is assigned a sliding reach below 30 in 34–41% of 16-type sets at s = 0.45 s{=}0.45 and in 3–7% at s = 0.30 s{=}0.30 , so with 16 types the reach is located coarsely. The cap K K separates FLUX.1-dev and SD3.5-M from SDXL, FLUX.2 [klein] and Qwen-Image (all six paired ratios across the two groups exclude 1, none within them).
blocks.zh: 模型比较。 Paired在12–25,FLUX.2 [klein]和Quen-Image的16种共享U2型上排列的人群数量超过SD3.5-M(++0.16 [++0.02,++0.32])和FLUX.1-dev(++0.26 [+0.04,++0.48]和++0.31 [+0.09,+++0.52]);SDXL不能从FLUX.1-dev(+0.10 [+-03,+++0.22])中分离出来;SDXL不能从两个组中分离出来,也不能从SD3.5-M分离出来。 通过滑行到达(s * = 1 s^{*}{=}1),模型排名为FLUX.1-dev 8,SDXL 12,SD3.5-M 16,FLUX.2 [klein]和Quen-Image 25,但只有FLUX.1-dev和Quen-Image被分离(偏差− - 4请求步骤− - 4− - 1]);相邻-pair到达没有分离. 在S = 04.5 s 0.45 的16种类型中的34-41%和S = 0.30 s 0.30 的 3-7% 的16种类型中,松散的估算器本身被分配到30以下,因此,在16种类型中,测量的距离是粗的。 上限KK将FLUX.1-dev和SD3.5-M与SDXL,FLUX.2[klein]和Quen-Image相分离(两个组的所有6对比均不包括1,其中没有1对).

blocks.en: Does a number’s change repeat across seeds? In SD3.5-M on U2 (64 types, two seeds, nine requests; SAM 3), the change of log ⁡ ( 1 + n ) \log(1{+}n) from one request to another on seed 1 correlates with the same change on seed 2 at + + 0.16 [0.03, 0.27] past ten (Spearman + + 0.23 [0.11, 0.34]; 33 of the 36 pairs of requests above zero), and + + 0.21 [0.03, 0.39] without the types SAM 3 ever reads as empty. In a variance split of log ⁡ ( 1 + n ) \log(1{+}n) at 12–30, the object type takes 66%, the noise 8%, the request 0.2% [0, 1.3], type by request 4.4% [0.9, 8.2] and the residual 22%: 16% [4, 27] of a same-noise change repeats on the other seed (39% [16, 57] at 12, 20 and 30; 30% within 2–8). The repeated part differs in sign between types and has no common direction. Errors of SAM 3 that depend on the type and the request together could mimic part of it.
blocks.zh: 数字的变化是否在种子中重复? 在U2上的SD3.5-M(64种,2个种子,9个请求;SAM 3)中,1号种子的对数(1+n)\log(1+n)从1号种子的请求改为1号种子的对数(1+0.16 [0.03,0.27] 10号种子的对数(Spearman + + 0.23 [0.11,0.34];36对请求中33对0以上)和+ + 0.21 [0.03,0.39],而SAM 3型从未读为空. 在12–30时的对数(1+n)\log(1+n)的偏差分割中,对象类型为66%,噪声8%,请求为0.2%[0,1.3],按请求键为4.4%[0.9,8.2],其余22%:16%[4,27]的相同噪声变化重复在其他种子上(39%[16,57],在12,20和30时;30%在2-8内). 重复的部分在类型之间的符号上有所不同,没有共同的方向. SAM 3的误差取决于类型和请求一起可能模仿其中的一部分.

blocks.en: How much direction is ruled out? Over the nine requests from 12 to 30 and two seeds (SAM 3, 64 types), SD3.5-M’s order is 0.502 with a 90% interval of [0.461, 0.543], so an order above 0.54 is ruled out at the 5% level; a loose estimator with a scatter up to 2.47 as drawn (2.14 read by SAM 3) would order these crowds above it. The number/seed ratio is 0.888 with a 90% interval of [0.814, 0.975]. Paired and unpaired orders (requests compared across the two seeds) agree within 0.04; past ten the unpaired interval is even slightly narrower, since same-noise pairs tie more often.
blocks.zh: 有多少方向被排除? 在12到30和2个种子(SAM 3,64型)的9个请求中,SD3.5-M的顺序为0.502,间隔为[0.461,0.543]90%,因此在5%的级别上排除了0.54以上的命令;一个散射量高达2.47的松散估计器(SAM 3读为2.14)将命令这些人群居上方。 数量/种子比例为0.888,间隔为[0.814,0.975]90%. 受保和未受保的订单(两种子之间的请求比较)在0.04年内达成协议;过去10年未受保的间隔甚至略微缩小,因为同噪音的对领带更常见.

blocks.en: D A new number against a new seed
blocks.zh: D级 一个新数字对新种子

blocks.en: D.1 SD3.5-M, by SAM 3
blocks.zh: D.1 SD3.5-M, SAM 3号机

blocks.en: The test reuses the word test’s plain U2 images of SD3.5-M (64 types, seeds 1 and 2) at 768 2 768^{2} (requests 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 and the nine requests 12, 14, 16, 19, 20, 22, 25, 27, 30) and at 1024 2 1024^{2} (2, 4, 8 and 12, 20, 30). For a range of requests, the number change is the mean | Δ ​ log ⁡ ( 1 + n ) | |\Delta\log(1{+}n)| over all pairs of the range’s requests from the same noise (both seeds), the seed change the mean between seeds 1 and 2 at the same request, the order the share of differing pairs in which the larger request gives more objects, and the signed shift the mean Δ ​ log ⁡ ( 1 + n ) \Delta\log(1{+}n) from the smaller to the larger request. Intervals: type-cluster bootstrap; the ratio’s replicates divide the two means of the same resample. The loose estimator’s ratios and orders on the same requests are in Sec. A.5 .

Number, seed and object type. Over the nine requests at 768 2 768^{2} the number change is 0.46 against a seed change of 0.52; over 12, 20 and 30 at 1024 2 1024^{2} , 0.49 against 0.57. Across 12–30 the request explains 0.004 of the variance of log ⁡ ( 1 + n ) \log(1{+}n) at 768 2 768^{2} and 0.012 at 1024 2 1024^{2} (between-request variance over total), the object type 0.71 and 0.72.

Table 21 : Number change against seed change (SD3.5-M, U2, 64 types, two seeds). 384 number and 192 seed comparisons per row of three requests, 1,280 and 320 for five, 4,608 and 576 for nine; fewer under the consensus (cons.), which leaves images without a majority uncounted. The spelling control at 12, 20 and 30 is in Tab. 23 .

blocks.en: Within the reach a new number moves the crowd about twice as far as a new seed, toward the number; past it, about as far as a new seed and not toward the number: at 1024 2 1024^{2} and under the other counters the orders past ten are reversals ( Tab. 21 ).
blocks.zh: 在可以达到的范围内,一个新数字将人群移动到大约两倍于新种子的距离,向着数字;通过它,向着新种子的方向移动,而不是向数字的方向移动:在1024 2 1024^{2}在其他计数器下,过去10个订单是倒置(Tab. 21)。

blocks.en: D.2 People’s check
blocks.zh: D.2 人民支票

blocks.en: People counted the plain images of the 16 people-counted U2 types at both seeds, at 2, 4, 8, 12, 20 and 30, and the number in digits (seed 1) at 12, 20 and 30 (sixth count, Sec. B.2 ). The noise-free ratio uses the two independent first counts: with d 1 d_{1} and d 2 d_{2} the same difference of log ⁡ ( 1 + n ) \log(1{+}n) computed from R1’s and from R2’s counts, E ⁡ [ d 1 ​ d 2 ] E[d_{1}d_{2}] is the squared difference of the pictures’ true counts, and the ratio is d 1 ​ d 2 ¯ number / d 1 ​ d 2 ¯ seed \sqrt{\overline{d_{1}d_{2}}_{\text{number}}/\overline{d_{1}d_{2}}_{\text{seed}}} . People agree with SAM 3 ( Tab. 22 ): within the reach the ratio’s interval lies above 1, toward the number; past it, the intervals of both the ratio and the noise-free ratio lie below the loose estimator’s ratio at these requests (1.47 at the larger scatter, Sec. A.5 ), and the order is near one half.

Mean | Δ ​ log ⁡ ( 1 + n ) | |\Delta\log(1{+}n)| when the number changes and when the seed changes; small over large ratio: people 3.07 [1.80, 5.10], SAM 3 2.25 [1.29, 4.71]. Digits against words at 12, 20 and 30 (seed 1): people .52, SAM 3.50.

blocks.en: D.3 Value, spelling and seed
blocks.zh: D.3 联合国 价值、拼写和种子

blocks.en: From the same noise (seed 1) at requests 12, 20 and 30, the mean | Δ ​ log ⁡ ( 1 + n ) | |\Delta\log(1{+}n)| when the number word changes (the three pairs of “twelve”, “twenty”, “thirty”), when only its spelling changes (“twelve” against “12”, and likewise for twenty and thirty), and when the seed changes (seeds 1 and 2, same request); value order: among value changes that alter the count, the share in which the larger request gives more objects. Past the reach, a new number, a new spelling and a new seed move SD3.5-M’s crowd about equally far under every counter, and every value order is below one half, a reversal ( Tab. 23 ).
blocks.zh: 在请求12、20和30下,当数字单词变化(三对“十二”、“二十”、“三十”)时,仅其拼写变化(“十二”)相对于“十二”,同样对二十和三十)时,以及当种子发生变化(种子1和2,同样请求); 数值顺序:在改变计数值变化中,较大请求给予更多对象的份额。 新数字、新拼写和新种子将SD3.5-M的人群移动到每个柜台下,

blocks.en: Table 23 : Value, spelling and seed (mean change of log ⁡ ( 1 + n ) \log(1{+}n) ; 192 comparisons per entry, 74–81 under the consensus, which leaves images without a majority uncounted; value order over 133, 131, 149 and 32 differing pairs).
blocks.zh: 表23:数值、拼写和种子(对数的平均值为+x(1+n)\log(1+n);每条目192个比较,共识下为74-81个,这使得图像没有多数没有计算;数值顺序超过133、131、149和32个不同的对)。

blocks.en: D.4 Layout from the same noise
blocks.zh: D.4 来自同一噪音的布局

blocks.en: The layout comparison uses the plain images of Sec. D.1 at 768 2 768^{2} (64 types; requests 2, 4, 8, 12, 20 and 30; seeds 1 and 2) and the number in digits of Sec. D.3 (12, 20 and 30; seed 1), 960 images in all. Each image is reduced to two 24 × 24 24{\times}24 maps: a grayscale thumbnail, each cell the mean gray level of a 32 × 32 32{\times}32 block of pixels, and a map of the objects’ boxes, each cell the share of it covered by SAM 3’s boxes (score ≥ 0.6 \geq 0.6 ). Two images are compared by the Pearson correlation of their thumbnails, or of their box maps, over the 576 cells. The pairs are: a new number, every pair of requests within 2, 4, 8 and within 12, 20, 30 from the same noise (both seeds; 384 pairs per range); a new seed, seeds 1 and 2 at the same request (192); digits, the number in words against the same number in digits from the same noise (seed 1; 192); and, as a floor, each type against the next type of the list at the same request and seed (seed 1; 192). Box-map pairs in which either map is constant are left out (at 12, 20, 30, 270 of the 384 number pairs and 133 of the 192 seed pairs remain). Each entry is the mean correlation over its pairs, with a 95% interval from the type bootstrap (20,000 resamples of the 64 types, the same indices for every entry); the paired difference takes, for each type, the mean over its number pairs minus the mean over its seed pairs.
blocks.zh: 版面比较采用 Sec. D.1 at 768 2 768^{2}(64型;请求2,4,8,12,20和30型;种子1和2型)的平面图像以及Sec. D.3(12,20和30型;种子1型)的数位数字,共计960幅图像. 每个图像缩小为两个 24× 24 24× 24}} 24 地图: 一个灰度缩略图, 每个单元格32× 32 × 32}% 32 个像素区块的平均灰度, 以及一个物体盒的地图, 每个单元格它由 SAM 3 的盒子覆盖的份额( 0. 6\ geq 0. 6) 。 在576个单元格上,用皮尔逊的缩略图或盒子图的相对关系来比较两个图像。 配对为:新编号,2,4,8内和12,20,30内每对请求来自同一噪音(均为种子;每范围384对);新种子,1和2应同一请求(192);数位数,以字数比对同一噪音的数位数(种子1;192);作为底片,每类请求和种子(种子1;192)对应下一类列表. 两种图中两种图都恒定的框图对被忽略(在384个数对中的12,20,30,270个数对和192个种子对中的133个仍保留着). 每个条目是其对子的平均值,与型靴的间隔为95%(每条条目的64种重复20 000个,指数相同);对子的差值为每类,其对数的平均值减去其种子对的平均值。

blocks.en: From the same noise, a new number keeps the picture’s layout and much of the objects’ placement ( Tab. 24 ): past the reach the thumbnails correlate at 0.71 [0.68, 0.75] for a new number and 0.76 for digits, against 0.10 [0.04, 0.17] for a new seed and 0.02 between types, and the box maps at 0.58 for a new number against 0.32 for a new seed. Yet past the reach a new number changes the count about as much as a new seed does ( Tab. 21 ).
blocks.zh: 从同样的噪音中,一个新的数字将图片的布局和大部分物体的放置(Tab. 24):一个新数字的缩略图过去与一个数字的0.71[0.68,0.75]和数字的0.76相关,新种子的0.10[0.04,0.17]和类型之间的0.02,新数字的框图0.58和新种子的0.32。 然而,在到达之后,一个新的数字会像一个新的种子一样改变数量(Tab.21)。

blocks.en: Table 24 : Layout from the same noise (SD3.5-M, 768 2 768^{2} , U2, 64 types; Pearson correlation of two images’ 24 × 24 24{\times}24 grayscale thumbnails or SAM 3 box maps, mean over pairs with 95% intervals over types). A new number: two requests from the same noise; digits: the same noise and number, in words and in digits (seed 1); a new seed: the same request at seeds 1 and 2; another type: the next type of the list, same request and seed (a floor). Number − - seed: per type, the mean over its number pairs minus the mean over its seed pairs (box maps: the 50 and 54 types with both kinds of pairs).
blocks.zh: 表24:来自相同噪音的布局(SD3.5-M,768 2 768^{2}),U2,64类型;两幅图像的皮尔逊相关性24×24 24{\24}24 灰度缩略图或 SAM 3 盒式地图,指在类型间间隔95%的对子之上. 一个新编号:来自相同噪音的两个请求; 数字:相同的噪音和数字,以文字和数字表示(种子1); 新种子:在种子1和2上相同的请求; 另一种类型:下一类列表,相同的请求和种子(一层). 编号 - - 种子:每类,平均数乘以对数减去平均数乘以对数(框图:50型和54型都有两种对数)。

blocks.en: D.5 A new number against a new seed, digits and an edit
blocks.zh: D.5 联合国 新的数字与新种子、 数字和编辑

blocks.en: Design. From the noise of each type’s plain image (seed 1), four changes are compared: a new number (pairs of different requests of the range, plain prompts), a new seed (seed 1 against seed 2, same request), the same number in digits (“a photo of 12 X X s”) and an edit elsewhere in the prompt (“a photograph of twelve X X s”); each change is the mean | Δ ​ log ⁡ ( 1 + n ) | |\Delta\log(1{+}n)| against the plain image of the same type and request. SD3.5-M: 64 types at 768 2 768^{2} (40 steps, guidance 4.5), within the reach 2, 4, 8 and past it 12, 20, 30 (the digits at 12, 20, 30 are those of Tab. 23 ); FLUX.1-dev: the stream test’s 32 types and settings, within 2, 4 and past 12, 25 (832 new images). The main quantity is the ratio of a new number’s change to the edit’s (SAM 3), within and past the reach.
blocks.zh: 设计. 从每种类型的平面图像(种子1)的噪声中可以比较出四个变化:一个新的数字(射程的不同请求的页码,平面提示),一个新的种子(种子1对种子2,同样的请求),数字中的相同数字(“一张12 X X s的照片”),以及提示中的别处的编辑(“一张12 X s的照片”);每个变化是平均值的QQX log (1+ n) QX Delta\log (1{+}n) 相对于同一类型和请求的平面图像. SD3.5-M:64型在768 2 768^{2}(40步, 指针4.5),在范围2,4,8之内,经过它12,20,30(数字为12,20,30是Tab.23的);FLUX.1-dev:流测试的32型和设置,在2,4和过去12,25之内(832新图像). 主要数量是新数字与编辑(SAM 3)在所及范围内的变动比例。

blocks.en: Table 25 : Four changes from the same noise (seed 1; the seed change compares seeds 1 and 2; 95% intervals over types). Number: a new request of the range; digits: “a photo of 12 X X s”; edit: “a photograph of twelve X X s”. Order: share of differing pairs in which the larger request gives more objects.
blocks.zh: 表25:同一噪音产生的4个变化(种子1;种子变化比较种子1和2;不同类型间距95%). 数字:范围的新要求;数字:“12X X s的照片”;编辑:“12X X s的照片”。 顺序: 不同对子中较大请求给出更多对象的共享 。

blocks.en: Results. Within the reach, a new number moves the crowd 1.80–3.54 times as far as a new seed and 2.56–5.53 times as far as the edit under the four counters, toward the number (orders 0.75–0.91). Past the reach, in SD3.5-M a new number moves it about as far as a new seed (0.84–1.03 under the four counters) and 1.22–1.49 times as far as the edit, without direction (order .41 [.32, .51] by SAM 3; the larger request gives slightly fewer objects on average, signed shift − - 0.16 [ − - 0.30, − - 0.02]). In FLUX.1-dev, on 32 types, it moves it 1.40 [0.87, 2.09] times as far as a new seed and 1.59 [0.81, 3.22] times as far as the edit, also without direction (order .45 [.23, .67]; .26 by Grounding DINO). The edit alone moves a crowd past the reach 0.57–0.85 times as far as a new seed in SD3.5-M and 0.74–1.23 times in FLUX.1-dev. Shares of counts left unchanged by a new number, a new seed, digits and the edit (SAM 3): SD3.5-M within the reach 17%, 49%, 56%, 66%, past it 31%, 26%, 35%, 36%; FLUX.1-dev within 22%, 73%, 77%, 75%, past 38%, 45%, 52%, 61%. Signed shifts past the reach (SAM 3): digits − - 0.20 [ − - 0.33, − - 0.04] and the edit + + 0.10 [ − - 0.02, + + 0.22] in SD3.5-M; digits + + 0.10 [ − - 0.11, + + 0.32] and the edit + + 0.20 [ + + 0.00, + + 0.45] in FLUX.1-dev.
blocks.zh: 结果。 在可以达到的范围内,一个新的数字将人群移动1.80-3.54倍于新种子,2.56-5.53倍于四个计数器下的编辑,向数字移动(命令0.75-0.91)。 在SD3.5-M中,一个新的数字移动到一个新种子(四个计数器下的0.84-1.03)和编辑的1.22-1.49倍,没有方向(SAM 3命令41[32,51];较大的请求平均给的物体略少一点,签名的班次为−-0.16[−-0.30]−-0.02]). 在FLUX.1-dev中,在32种类型上,它移动它1.40[0.87,2.09]倍于新种子,1.59[0.81,3.22]倍于编辑,同样没有方向(命令45[23,.67];26通过Grounding DINO). 仅编辑就让一群人在SD3.5-M和FLUX.1-dev的0.74-1.23次的种子中超过0.57-0.85倍。 由新数字、新种子、数字和编辑(SAM 3)留下的总数份额不变:SD3.5-M在17%、49%、56%、66%、31%、26%、35%、36%;FLUX.1-Dev在22%、73%、77%、75%、过去38%、45%、52%、61%。 已签名的移位超过到达(SAM 3):数字− - 0.20 [− - 0.33,− - 0.04] 和编辑+ + 0.10 [− - 0.02,+ + 0.22] SD3.5-M;数字+ + 0.10 [− - 0.11,+ + 0.32] 和编辑+ + 0.20 [+ 0.30,+ + 0.45] FLUX 1- dev.

blocks.en: D.6 The four changes in FLUX.2 [klein] and Qwen-Image, counted by people
blocks.zh: D.6 联合国 FLUX.2 [klein] 和 Quen-Image 的四个变化,按人计算

blocks.en: Design. The four changes of Sec. D.5 , from the noise of each type’s plain image of the word test (seed 1), with each model’s word-test sampler: FLUX.2 [klein] base 4B at 1024 2 1024^{2} (50 steps, guidance 4.0) on the 32 types of FLUX.1-dev’s four-change set (the 16 people-counted U2 types and 16 drawn from the other 48), within its reach at 4, 8 and 12 and at its edge at 20, 25 and 30 (576 new images); Qwen-Image (transformer in NF4, 1024 2 1024^{2} , 50 steps, true guidance 4.0) on the 16 people-counted types at the edge of its reach, at 20, 25 and 30 (144 new images). Both models’ crowds stop growing at about 13–15 objects (cap K K , Tab. 13 ), while their orders follow the request up to twenty-five ( Sec. 4 ), so twelve lies inside their reach and 20–30 at its edge. Every new seed-1 image starts from the plain image’s own latent (checked on its logged start: 384 of 384 for FLUX.2 [klein]; Qwen-Image’s 144 noise seeds as logged), and each host first reproduced two stored word-test images pixel for pixel. People counted the 16 people-counted types at 20–30, all four images per cell (seventh count, Sec. B.2 ).
blocks.zh: 设计. Sec. D.5的4个变化,从每个类型单词测试的平面图像(种子1)的噪声,每个模型的单词测试采样器:FLUX.2 [klein] Base 4B在1024 2 1024^{2}(50步,指导4.0)在32种FLUX上. 1-dev的四变组合(16个人计的U2型和16个人计的U2型,另48个人计的16个人计的),在它所能达到的4,8和12,在它的边缘有20,25和30(576新图像); Quen-Image(在NF4, 1024 2 1024^{2},50步,真实的指导4.0),在它的极限有16个人计的U2型,在20,25和30(144新图像). 两个模型的人群在大约13–15个物体(Cap K K, Tab. 13)上停止增长,而他们的订单跟随请求最高达25个(sec. 4),因此有12个位于它们的能及范围内,20–30位于它的边缘. 每个新种子-1的图像都是从平面图像本身的潜伏点开始的(记录的起始点为:FLUX.2[klein]384中的384;Quen-Image的144个噪声种子作为记录),每个主机首先复制了两个存储的文字测试图像像素,用于像素. 人们在20–30年统计了16种人种,每个细胞全部4个图像(第7次统计,Sec. B.2.).

blocks.en: Table 26 : Four changes in FLUX.2 [klein] and Qwen-Image (as Tab. 25 ; FLUX.2 [klein] 32 types, Qwen-Image 16; 95% intervals over types). b People’s final counts of the 16 people-counted types (the seventh count), on the same pictures as SAM 3’s 16-type values in the text.
blocks.zh: 表26:FLUX.2 [klein]和Quen-Image的4个变化(作为Tab.25;FLUX.2 [klein] 32类型,Quen-Image 16;不同类型间隔95%). b 在文字中与SAM 3的16类数值相同的图片上,对16种人计算类型(第7类)的人的最终计数。

blocks.en: FLUX.2 [klein]. Within its reach, a new number moves the crowd 1.08–2.11 times as far as a new seed and 1.90–3.90 times as far as the edit under the four counters, toward the number (orders 0.75–0.93); it leaves 36% of the counts unchanged, the edit 70% (SAM 3). At the edge of its reach (20–30), a new number moves the crowd 0.58–1.14 times as far as a new seed and 0.34–1.16 times as far as the edit, and not toward the number (orders 0.45–0.47 by SAM 3, Grounding DINO and OWLv2; 0.71 by the consensus, which counts few of these crowds); the signed shift of a new number is − - 0.003 [ − - 0.19, 0.21]. Written in digits, the number gives fewer objects at 20–30 (signed shift − - 0.27 [ − - 0.53, − - 0.01]; people’s medians 5.5–7.5 objects against 12.5–20 for the words). On the 16 people-counted types, people find a new number moving the crowd 0.72 [0.37, 1.21] times as far as a new seed and 0.77 [0.52, 1.08] times as far as the edit, with an order of 0.43 [0.28, 0.58] (0.40 [0.27, 0.53] over both seeds, where the number change compares the requests of either seed), and SAM 3 on the same pictures 0.86, 1.13 and 0.38 [0.26, 0.49]. The first two people’s counts agree on 48–52% of these pictures, so the ratio with the raters’ disagreement removed is too imprecise to report (0.52 [0.00, 3.25]).
blocks.zh: FLUX.2 [鸣叫]. 在其力所能及的范围内,一个新数字将人群移动1.08-2.11倍以至新种子,将1.90-3.90倍以至四个计数器下的编辑,向数字移动(命令0.75-0.93);它留下36%的计数不变,编辑70%(SAM3)。 在其到达的边缘(20–30),一个新数字将人群移动0.58–1.14倍于新种子,0.34–1.16倍于编辑,而不是向数字移动(SAM 3,Grounding DINO和OWLv2的0.45–0.47令;共识的0.71令,这些人群中数不多);新数字的签名转换为−-0.003[−−−0.19,0.21]. 用数字写成,数字在20–30时给出的物体较少(签名的移位−-0.27 [− -0.53,− -0.01];人们的中位数5.5–7.5对象相对于12.5–20的单词). 在16种人数类型上,人们发现一个新的数字移动人群0.72 [0.37,1.21] 倍于新种子,0.77 [0.52,1.08] 倍于编辑,两者种子的顺序为0.43 [0.28,0.58] (0.40 [0.27,0.53],数字变化比较任一种子的请求),SAM 3在同一图片上为0.86,1.13和0.38 [0.26,0.49]. 前两人的计数都同意48-52%的图片, 因此删除的评比太不准确,

blocks.en: Qwen-Image. At the edge of its reach (20–30), a new number moves the crowd 0.52–1.08 times as far as a new seed and 0.84–3.07 times as far as the edit under the four counters, which disagree on its direction: by SAM 3 the larger request gives more objects in 0.65 [0.48, 0.81] of the differing pairs (signed shift + + 0.30 [0.03, 0.61]), by Grounding DINO in 0.31 and by OWLv2 in 0.45. By people (16 types), a new number moves the crowd 0.76 [0.30, 1.54] times as far as a new seed and 1.46 [0.54, 4.32] times as far as the edit (0.67 [0.28, 1.04] and 1.20 with the raters’ disagreement removed), with an order of 0.46 [0.27, 0.64] on seed 1 and 0.60 [0.48, 0.72] over both seeds, and a signed shift of − - 0.01 [ − - 0.08, 0.06]; the first two people’s counts agree on 75–83% of these pictures.
blocks.zh: 腾讯影视. 在其到达的边缘(20–30),一个新的数字将人群移动0.52–1.08倍于新种子,0.84–3.07倍于四个计数器下的编辑,这四个计数器对它的方向有分歧:通过SAM 3,较大的请求给出了不同对数中0.65 [0.48,0.81]中的更多对象(签名班次+ 0.30 [0.03,0.61]),0.31中的Grounding DINO和0.45中的OWLv2. 按人(16类),新数字将人群移动0.76 [0.30,1.54]倍于新种子,1.46 [0.54,4.32]倍于编辑(0.67 [0.28,1.04] 和1.20,同时删除了测评员的不同意见),种子1和0.60[0.27,0.64]的顺序超过两个种子,签名的移位为−-0.01[−0.08,0.06];前两人的计数同意这些图片的75-83%.

blocks.en: A loose estimator at 20, 25 and 30. Between requests that differ by at most 1.5 times, the number/seed ratio cannot separate estimating from ignoring: the loose estimator of Sec. A.5 , simulated on this design (16 types; seed-1 number pairs, a new seed, and an edit that redraws the estimate at the same request; 4,000 sets, Sec. B.4 ), moves its count 1.10–1.22 times as far as a new seed as drawn, 1.08–1.16 times counted by people with the difficulty of FLUX.2 [klein]’s or Qwen-Image’s pictures (2.5th percentiles 0.74–0.76), 1.05–1.08 counted once by one person, and 1.03–1.04 read by SAM 3. Its order separates it: 0.66–0.74 as drawn, 0.65–0.72 counted by people (2.5th percentiles 0.50 and 0.58 at s = 0.45 s{=}0.45 and 0.30), 0.63–0.68 counted once (0.47–0.48 and 0.53), and 0.59–0.60 read by SAM 3 (0.43; on 32 types 0.47–0.48). FLUX.2 [klein]’s people’s order (0.43) lies below the 2.5th percentile of every people-counted reference, the single-count bound included, and its SAM 3 order on 32 types (0.46) below the SAM 3 reference’s; its people’s ratio (0.72) lies below the people-counted references’ 2.5th percentiles but not below the single-count bound. Over both seeds, the people-counted estimator orders these crowds at 0.65 [0.54, 0.76] and 0.72 [0.62, 0.82] ( s = 0.45 s{=}0.45 and 0.30): FLUX.2 [klein]’s 0.40 lies below both, Qwen-Image’s 0.60 inside the first (with FLUX.2 [klein]’s counting difficulty: 0.66 [0.55, 0.76] and 0.72 [0.62, 0.81]). Qwen-Image’s seed-1 order (0.46) lies below the people-counted references’ 2.5th percentiles and its SAM 3 order (0.65) inside the SAM 3 reference’s range; its ratio with the raters’ disagreement removed (0.67) lies below the estimator’s ratio as drawn (2.5th percentiles 0.82 and 0.91).
blocks.zh: 20岁、25岁和30岁 一个松散的估算器 在最多1.5次不同的请求之间,数字/种子比率不能将估计和忽略分开:Sec. A.5的松散估计器,在这个设计上模拟了(16种;种子-1数对,一个新种子,以及根据同一请求重新绘制估计数的编辑;4,000套,Sec. B.4),将其计数移动1.10至1.22倍于新种子,1.08至1.16倍于FLUX.2 [克林]或Quen-Image照片困难的人(2.5百分位数0.74-0.76),1.05至1.08倍。 一人计算一次,SAM读为1.03-1.04 3个 其顺序为:抽取0.66-0.74,0.65-0.72,按人计算(2.5百分位数0.50和0.58,按0.45和0.30,0.63-0.68计算一次(0.47-0.48和0.53),由SAM 3(0.43;32类0.47-0.48)读取0.59-0.60。 FLUX.2 [Klein]的人民顺序(0.43)低于每个被统计的参照数的2.5%,包括单一的参照数,而其SAM 3的顺序为32种(0.46),低于SAM 3的参照数;其人民比率(0.72)低于被统计的参照数的2.5%,但不低于单一的参照数。 在两种种子上,由人计数的估测者订购这些群数为0.65[0.54,0.76]和0.72[0.62,0.82](s=0.45 s{=}0.45和0.30):FLUX.2 [克林]的0.40位于两者下方,Quen-Image的0.60位于第一种(与FLUX.2 [克林]的计数难度为:0.66 [0.55,0.76]和0.72 [0.62,0.81]). Quen-Image的种子-1顺序(0.46)在SAM 3参考范围内低于人计算的参考物2.5百分位数及其SAM 3顺序(0.65);其与被删除的测评人分歧的比例(0.67)在所提取的测算者比例(2.5百分位数0.82和0.91)以下.

blocks.en: D.7 FLUX.1-dev
blocks.zh: D.7 FLUX.1-dev

blocks.en: By SAM 3. On the plain cells of the stream test ( Sec. E.8 ; the plain images of the smaller and the larger request from the same noise, and seed 1 against seed 2 in the same cell; 32 types), a new number moves FLUX.1-dev’s crowd 2.51 [1.78, 4.27] times as far as a new seed between two and four (order 0.83 [0.69, 0.94]) and 1.25 [0.87, 1.81] times between twelve and twenty-five (order 0.53 [0.33, 0.71], mean shift − - 0.17 [ − - 0.41, 0.07]); by Grounding DINO, OWLv2 and the consensus the ratios past ten are 0.99, 1.22 and 1.87 and the orders 0.25 [0.11, 0.41], 0.51 and 0.35, under Grounding DINO and the consensus a reversal. On the same cells, SD3.5-M’s ratios are 1.70 [1.27, 2.44] (order 0.91) and 1.07 [0.85, 1.33] (order 0.53).
blocks.zh: 由萨姆 3个 在溪流试验的平面细胞上(Sec. E.8;同一噪声中大小请求的平面图像,以及种子1对种子2在同一细胞中;32类),一个新的数字将FLUX.1-dev的群动2.51 [1.78,4.27]倍于2至4之间的新种子(命令0.83 [0.69,0.94])和1.25 [0.87, 1.81]倍于12至25(命令0.53 [0.33,0.71],中位移−0.17 [−0.41,0.07]);通过Grounding DINO, OWLv2和共识,过去10的比例为0.99,1.22和1.87,根据DINO的平面和共识,命令为0.25 [0.11,0.41,0.51和0.35。 在同一单元格中,SD3.5-M的比例为1.70 [1.27, 2.44] (命令0.91)和1.07 [0.85, 1.33] (命令0.53)。

blocks.en: By people. People counted the same plain cells of the 16 people-counted types at both seeds (sixth count, Sec. B.2 ): a new number moves FLUX.1-dev’s crowd 1.64 [1.13, 2.52] times as far as a new seed between twelve and twenty-five (2.35 [1.51, 4.84] between two and four), but not consistently toward the number (people’s order 0.66 [0.43, 0.86]).
blocks.zh: 由众生故. 在两种种子中,人们都统计了16种人种的相同平原细胞(第6次计数,B.2节): 一个新数字将FLUX.1-dev的人群 1.64 [1.13,2.52] 移动到12到25之间的新种子的两倍(2.35 [1.51,4.84] 在2到4之间),但并非一致地向数字移动(人民订单0.66 [0.43,0.86])。

blocks.en: Past its reach, a new number moves FLUX.1-dev’s crowd further than a new seed does by people’s counts (by SAM 3, about as far or further), with no reliable direction.
blocks.zh: 新数字将FLUX.1-dev的人群移动得比新种子更远,

blocks.en: D.8 Redrawing only the fine-scale noise
blocks.zh: D.8 联合国 只重画细度的噪音

blocks.en: Design. From the starting noise of a type’s seed-1 image, z 1 z_{1} , and of its seed-2 image, z 2 z_{2} , we form a start that keeps z 1 z_{1} below f f cycles per image and takes z 2 z_{2} above it: with F 1 F_{1} , F 2 F_{2} the 2D Fourier transforms of the two noises over the spatial axes, r = k x 2 + k y 2 r=\sqrt{k_{x}^{2}+k_{y}^{2}} the radial frequency in cycles per image, and M = 𝟏 [ r ≤ f ] M=\mathbf{1}[r\leq f] , z f = ℱ − 1 ​ [ M ​ F 1 + ( 1 − M ) ​ F 2 ] , z_{f}=\mathcal{F}^{-1}\big[MF_{1}+(1-M)F_{2}\big], (4) computed in double precision and cast back to the sampler’s type. The two masks are complementary, so z f z_{f} is again white Gaussian noise. With f f above the highest frequency the start equals z 1 z_{1} bit for bit, and with f < 0 f<0 it equals z 2 z_{2} ; on every host and model, both settings reproduced the stored seed-1 and seed-2 images pixel for pixel before any new image was drawn. Everything else is the word test’s unchanged sampler and plain prompt. Cells: SD3.5-M (U2, 768 2 768^{2} ) at requests 2, 4, 8, 12, 20 and 30 with f f = 2, 4 and 8 on all 64 types and f f = 16 on the 16 annotated types (1,248 images); FLUX.2 [klein] at 4, 8, 12, 20, 25 and 30 with f f = 2, 4 and 8 on the 16 annotated types (288); Qwen-Image at 4, 12, 20 and 30 with f f = 4 on the 16 annotated types (64); and FLUX.2 [klein]’s plain prompt from the word test’s noise at “twenty-two”, “twenty-seven”, “thirty-five” and “forty” (64). Every image is counted by SAM 3, Grounding DINO and OWLv2. Measures, over types: the count change of the redraw against the seed-1 image at the same request, of a new seed (seed 2 against seed 1), and of a new number (seed 1; over the neighbouring requests for a single request, and over all pairs of a range’s requests for a range), each as the mean | Δ ​ log ⁡ ( 1 + n ) | |\Delta\log(1{+}n)| , their ratios, and the correlation of 24 × 24 24{\times}24 grayscale thumbnails with the seed-1 image.

blocks.en: SD3.5-M. Past the reach (12, 20, 30) a new number moves the count by 0.51 and a new seed by 0.49 (SAM 3). Redrawing above f f = 2, 4 and 8 cycles moves it 0.97 [0.79, 1.21], 0.67 [0.51, 0.89] and 0.66 [0.51, 0.83] times as far as a new number, while keeping the layout at a thumbnail correlation of 0.40, 0.54 and 0.74 (new number 0.70 [0.65, 0.74], new seed 0.10). Grounding DINO and OWLv2 agree (0.69 and 0.74 at f f = 8). Within the reach (2, 4, 8) the redraws move the count only 0.31–0.40 times as far as a new number, though 0.67–0.87 times as far as a new seed, which moves small crowds little. On the 16 annotated types, a redraw above 16 cycles still moves a large crowd 0.71 [0.49, 0.98] times as far as a new number and 0.60 [0.35, 0.95] times as far as a new seed, with a thumbnail correlation of 0.86 ( Fig. 10 ). Without the 26 types that SAM 3 ever reads as empty, the ratios past the reach are 0.98, 0.79 and 0.68. The ratio to a new number rises with the request, as the number’s own effect fades; the ratio to a new seed does not.
blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2019-05-30). SD3.5-M. 过了到达(12,20,30),一个新的数字将计数移动0.51,一个新的种子移动0.49(SAM 3). 重划上f=2,4和8个周期将其移动0.97 [0.79, 1.21],0.67 [0.51,0.89]和0.66 [0.51,0.83] 倍于新数字,同时将布局保持缩略图相关性为0.40,0.54和0.74(新编号0.70 [0.65,0.74],新种子0.10). 地基DINO和OWLv2同意(0.69和0.74, f = 8). 在力所能及范围内(2,4,8),重划只移动计数器的0.31–0.40倍于新计数器,虽然0.67–0.87倍于新计数器,而新计数器则很少移动小群. 在16种注解型上,16个周期以上的重划仍然移动着大群0.71[0.49,0.98]倍于新数,0.60[0.35,0.95]倍于新种子,缩略图相关性为0.86(图10). 没有SAM 3曾经读作空空的26种类型,超过范围的比例为0.98,0.79和0.68. 随着数字本身的效果逐渐消退,与新种子的比率随请求而上升。

blocks.en: Figure 10 : Fine-scale redraws next to a new number and a new seed (SD3.5-M, 768 2 768^{2} ; four of the 16 people-counted types, drawn at random). From the noise of the image asked for twenty (first column): thirty asked from the same noise; the noise above 4, 8 and 16 cycles per image redrawn from the type’s second seed, still asked for twenty; and twenty from the second seed. Below each image: people’s final count (people did not count the 16-cycle redraws) and the correlation of its 24 × 24 24{\times}24 grayscale thumbnail with the first column’s.
blocks.zh: 图10:新编号和新种子旁边的精细比例重划(SD3.5-M,768 2 768^{2});16人计数类型中的4个,随机抽取). 从图像的噪声要求为二十(第一栏):从同一个噪声中要求为三十;从该类型第二种子中重新绘制的每个图像超过4,8和16个周期的噪声仍然要求为二十;从第二种子中要求为二十. 以及其24×24 24}24 灰色缩略图与第一列的相对关系。

blocks.en: FLUX.2 [klein] and Qwen-Image. SAM 3 reads many of FLUX.2 [klein]’s crowds as empty (10 of the 16 types, up to half of the images of a cell), which blurs its readings. By Grounding DINO and OWLv2, the redraws move FLUX.2 [klein]’s count 0.43–0.75 times as far as a new number within its reach (4, 8, 12) and 0.74–1.10 times at its edge (20, 25, 30), the pattern of SD3.5-M. In Qwen-Image, a redraw above 4 cycles moves the count 0.44 [0.20, 0.63] times as far as a new number at 4 and 12 and 0.82 [0.59, 1.38] times at 20 and 30 (SAM 3), keeping the layout at 0.59 against 0.70 for a new number. FLUX.2 [klein]’s plain prompt at the new number words: by SAM 3 and OWLv2, “thirty” draws fewer objects than the mean of “twenty-seven” and “thirty-five” (differences in log ⁡ ( 1 + n ) \log(1{+}n) − - 0.29 [ − - 0.86, 0.22] and − - 0.34 [ − - 0.76, 0.03]; by OWLv2, twenty-seven and thirty-five draw about as many as twenty-five), and “forty” draws fewer than “twenty-five” ( − - 0.74 [ − - 1.41, − - 0.15] and − - 0.40 [ − - 0.86, − - 0.02]); Grounding DINO shows no drop at thirty. Part of the drop at thirty may thus belong to the word itself, and these 16 types cannot settle how much; SAM 3 reads half of the “forty” crowds as empty.
blocks.zh: FLUX.2 [klein] 和 Quen-Image. (原始内容存档于2019-09-22). SAM 3将FLUX.2[klein]的许多人群读为空(16种中的10种,高达细胞图像的一半),这模糊了其读数. 通过地面DINO和OWLv2,重画移动了FLUX.2[klein]的计数0.43–0.75倍于其所能达到的新数(4,8,12)和边缘0.74–1.10倍(20,25,30),图案为SD3.5-M. 在Quen-Image中,4个周期以上的重画将计数0.44 [0.20,0.63]移动到4和12,0.82 [0.59,1.38]乘以20和30 (SAM 3),将布局保持在0.59对0.70换到新数字. FLUX.2 [克林]在新数字词上的简单提示:用SAM 3和OWLv2, " 三十 " 绘制的对象少于 " 二十七 " 和 " 三十五 " 的平均值(对数 −(1+n)\log(1+n)−0.29 [−-0.86,0.22]和−0.34 [−0.76,0.03];用OWLv2, 二十七和三十五图绘制的数值约为25), " 四十五 " 绘制的对象少于 " 二十五 " (−0.74 [−1.41,−−−0.15]和−0.40 [−0.86,−0.02]);地面DINO显示在30时没有下降。 因此,30时的下降部分可能属于这个词本身,这16种类型无法解决多少问题;SAM 3将"40"人群的一半读作空.

blocks.en: People’s counts. People counted the redraws above four and eight cycles on the 16 people-counted types: SD3.5-M’s at 4, 8, 12, 20 and 30 and FLUX.2 [klein]’s at 4, 8, 12, 20, 25 and 30 (352 pictures; eighth count, Sec. B.2 ). The plain images they are compared with were counted earlier under the same protocol: SD3.5-M’s seeds 1 and 2 in the sixth count, FLUX.2 [klein]’s seed 1 in the second count and its seed 2 (at 20, 25 and 30) in the seventh. The measures are those above, over the requests people counted (for SD3.5-M within the reach, four and eight only). In SD3.5-M the mean changes of log ⁡ ( 1 + n ) \log(1{+}n) are, within the reach and past it, 0.37 and 0.43 for a new number, 0.25 and 0.53 for a new seed, 0.29 and 0.32 for a redraw above four cycles, and 0.19 and 0.30 above eight cycles; two final counts of the same picture from different studies differ by 0.12 at both ( Sec. B.4 ). In SD3.5-M, past the reach, a redraw above eight cycles moves the count 0.69 [0.38, 1.20] times as far as a new number and 0.57 [0.35, 0.91] times as far as a new seed, and a redraw above four cycles 0.73 [0.42, 1.31] and 0.60 [0.41, 0.87] times; SAM 3 on the same pictures gives 0.51 and 0.66 times a new number. At four and eight objects the redraws move the count 0.52 [0.27, 0.99] ( f f = 8) and 0.81 [0.50, 1.37] ( f f = 4) times as far as a new number, against 0.48 and 0.51 by SAM 3, 0.54 and 0.85 by Grounding DINO, and 0.44 and 0.82 by OWLv2 on the same pictures; request by request, the ratio for f f = 8 rises from 0.34 at four objects to 0.96–0.97 at twenty and thirty. In FLUX.2 [klein], the redraws move the count 0.41 [0.19, 0.70] ( f f = 8) and 0.52 [0.29, 0.89] ( f f = 4) times as far as a new number within its reach (4, 8, 12), and 0.74 [0.44, 1.14] and 0.85 [0.63, 1.19] times at its edge (20, 25, 30), where they move it about as far as a new seed (0.99 and 1.12 times). People disagree on whether some of FLUX.2 [klein]’s large crowds show the object at all: of the 48 seed-1 pictures at 20–30 that both the second and the seventh count include, 29 get the same count and 6 get zero in one count and five or more in the other. With the seventh count’s seed-1 counts, the ratios at 20–30 become 1.15 and 1.47. Without the eight types that have any count of zero (a check we added after seeing the counts), they are 0.18 and 0.21 within the reach and 0.71 and 0.96 at its edge; in SD3.5-M, which loses two types, the ratios change by at most 0.08. The first two counts agree on 55% of SD3.5-M’s redraws and 67% of FLUX.2 [klein]’s. Noise-free ratios from the two independent first counts ( Sec. D ) are too uncertain here to add anything: half of their intervals reach zero, and the others are wide.
blocks.zh: 民计. 人们计算了在16种人计数类型上4和8个周期以上的重画:SD3.5-M在4,8,12,20和30,FLUX.2[klein]在4,8,12,20,25和30(352张图片;8张计数,Sec.B.2.). 与平面图像相比, SD3.5-M的种子1和2在第六计中,FLUX.2[克林]的种子1在第二计中,其种子2(20,25和30)在第七计中. 以上是衡量要求的措施(就SD3.5-M可及范围而言,只有4个和8个)。 在SD3.5-M中,log +(1+n)\log(1+n)的平均变化在所及范围内并经过它,新编号为0.37和0.43,新种子为0.25和0.53,重划为4个周期以上,0.29和0.32,8个周期以上为0.19和0.30;不同研究得出的相同情况的两个最终数在两个周期内均差0.12(Sec.B.4)。 在SD3.5-M中,经过距离,8个周期以上的重画移动计数0.69 [0.38,1.20]倍于新数,0.57 [0.35,0.91]倍于新种子,重画超过4个周期的0.73 [0.42,1.31]和0.60 [0.41,0.87]倍;同一图片上的SAM 3给出0.51和0.66倍于新数. 在4个和8个物体上,重新绘制将计数0.52 [0.27, 0.99] (f f = 8) 和0.81 [0.50, 1.37] (f = 4) 乘以新数字,而SAM 3, 0.54 和 0.51 乘以 Grounding DINO, OWLv2 乘以 0.44 和 0.82 乘以相同图片;根据请求,f = 8 乘以 0.34 乘以4 乘以 0, 乘以 0.96 – 0.97 乘以 乘以 20 和 30 乘以 0.96– 0.97 乘以 0。 在FLUX.2 [klein]中,重新绘制的计数器移动0.41 [0.19, 0.70] (f f = 8)和0.52 [0.29, 0.89] (f f = 4)是它所能达到的新数的两倍(4, 8, 12),在它的边缘则移动0.74 [0.44, 1.14] 和 0.85 [0.63, 1.19] , 在它的边缘则移动大约为新种子(0.99和1.12). 人们对于FLUX.2[klein]的部分大群是否完全显示此天体有分歧:在第二和第七计数均包括的48张种子-1图片中,29张得到相同的计数,6张得到一个计数中的0,另外5张或更多. 随着第七个伯爵的种子1的计数,20-30的比率变为1.15和1.47。 没有8种有零的计数(在看到计数后我们加上的检查),它们就达到0.18和0.21,其边缘为0.71和0.96;在SD3.5-M中,损失了2种类型,比率变化最多为0.08。 前两项罪名同意了SD3.5-M重划的55%和FLUX.2[klein]的67%。 从两个独立的第一计数(Sec.D.)得到的无噪声比率在此太不确定,无法添加任何东西:它们间隔的一半达到零,其他的则很宽.

blocks.en: E The number at the denoiser, and what fails to give it a direction
blocks.zh: 英 数字在Denoiser, 什么没有给它一个方向

blocks.en: E.1 Probes of the conditioning and of the velocity
blocks.zh: E.1 条件和速度的探测器

blocks.en: SD3.5-M, U2, seed 1. For U2’s 64 types and 23 number words, a ridge regression trained on the other words orders a held-out word in 0.89 of same-object pairs at 12–30 and 0.98 at 2–8 from SD3.5-M’s pooled CLIP vector, and in 0.85–0.97 from every text stream: the number word is decodable, in order, from the conditioning. Along U2’s plain trajectories, from σ = 1 \sigma{=}1 to 0.909, changing the object word moves the conditional velocity 1.18–1.57 times as far as the guidance direction of the trajectory’s own prompt, “two” to “four” 0.37–0.70 times, “twelve” to “twenty-five” 0.37–0.42 times and “twenty” to “thirty” 0.21–0.26 times. These probes are descriptive.
blocks.zh: SD3.5-M, U2, 种子 1. 对于U2的64种和23个数字字,在SD3.5-M集合式CLIP矢量的0.89和0.98的同对象对中,以及0.85-0.97的每条文字流中,经过其他文字训练的山脊回归命令一个搁置的单词:数字单词按顺序从调值中解码。 沿着U2的平坦轨迹,从 =1\sigma{=}1到0.909, 改变对象字将条件速度1.18-1.57倍移动到轨道本身的导线方向, " 2 " 到 " 4 " 0.37-0.70倍, " 12 " 到 " 25 " 0.37-0.42倍, " 20 " 到 " 30 " 021-0.26倍。 这些探测器是描述性的。

A change of word is the difference of two such velocities; its size is given relative to the guidance direction v ⁡ ( own prompt ) − v ⁡ ( empty ) v(\text{own prompt})-v(\text{empty}) . Quantities are averaged over the first ten steps ( σ ≥ 0.909 \sigma\geq 0.909 ) per trajectory; 95% intervals over types. blocks.en: Table 27 : Value and spelling at the denoiser (SD3.5-M). By step, the large pair’s value / spelling ratio is 1.79 and 1.76 at the first two steps and 1.17–1.38 at later steps; the small pair’s 2.3–3.4. Trajectories asked for four and for twenty give the same picture (1.30 and 1.38).

blocks.en: Results. The large number’s value moves the velocity only 1.34 times as far as its spelling, where a small number’s value moves it 2.8 times as far. The velocity norms shared with the probe of Sec. E.1 agree with it (median relative difference 0.7%). The denoiser receives a large number mostly as a different word, not as a larger value.
blocks.zh: 结果。 大数字的数值移动速度仅为其拼写速度的1.34倍,其中小数字的数值移动速度为2.8倍. 与 Sec 探测器共享的速度规范. E.1 同意它(中间相对差异0.7%). denoiser接收了大量,大多是作为一个不同的词,而不是一个更大的值.

blocks.en: E.3 The timing test
blocks.zh: E.3 联合国 计时测试

blocks.en: Design. SD3.5-M at 768 2 768^{2} , 40 steps, guidance 4.5, U2’s 64 types, seed 1. Every image shares prompt, noise and size with U2’s plain image of its base request, which is its baseline. Pairs: 2 vs. 4 (control) and 12 vs. 25. Direction alternates over the sorted 16 people-counted types and over the sorted other 48, starting with “up” (32 types each): up, the base request is the lower count and the window’s word the higher; down, the reverse. Swap : the prompt asks the base request at every step except one window of five steps, where it asks the window’s word; windows start at steps 0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25 and 30 ( σ \sigma 1.000–0.963, 0.953–0.909, 0.897–0.843, 0.828–0.760, 0.741–0.653, 0.628–0.509, 0.475–0.308); 896 images. Amplified (large pair): the prompt asks the window word’s side throughout and receives the amplification contrast + L ⁡ ( c ⁡ ( asked ) − c ⁡ ( partner ) ) +L\,(c(\text{asked})-c(\text{partner})) , L = 5 L{=}5 , only inside a window starting at step 10, 15 or 20; baseline, the plain image of the asked request; 192 images. Floor : the amplified arm’s tasks for the 16 people-counted types at L = 10 − 6 L{=}10^{-6} (48 images). The sampler is the amplification test’s ( Sec. E.6 ). Per pair and window, over types ( s = + 1 s{=}{+}1 up, − 1 -1 down): shift, the mean of s ⁡ [ log ⁡ ( 1 + n W ) − log ⁡ ( 1 + n 0 ) ] s\,[\log(1{+}n_{W})-\log(1{+}n_{0})] ; toward, among types whose count changed, the share that moved toward the window’s word; changed, the share of types whose count changed. Counters and bootstrap as elsewhere. Images swapped in the first window differ from both the base request’s and the window word’s plain image (median pixel distance 26–46 and 16–20; none identical); images swapped in the last window are near their base (median about 1).

SD3.5-M在768 2 768^{2},40步,向导4.5,U2的64型,种子1. 每一个图像都与U2的平面图像分享其基础请求, 平分:2对4(控制),12对25. 在排序的16种人和排序的其他48种人之间,方向替代,从“上”开始(每类32种):上,基数请求是下数,窗口的字数是上数;下,倒数。 换乘:提示在每一步都询问基本要求,除了一个窗口的五个步骤,它询问窗口的字;窗口从0,5,10,15,20,25和30步开始(\sigma 1.000–0.963,0.953–0.909,0.897–0.843,0.828–0.760,0.741-0.653,0.628–0.509,0.475–0.308);896图像. 放大( 大对): 提示询问窗口单词的侧面, 并接收放大对比 + L + + + + + + + + + + + , (c (\ text{ asked})- c (\ text{ partner})), L = 5 L + 5 , 仅从步骤 10, 15 或 20 开始; 基线, 被请求的平面图像; 192 图像 。 楼层:在L = 10 - 6 L = 10 = 6 = (48幅图像)的16个人计算类型中, 取样员是放大试验(E.6节)。 每对和窗口,类型(S=+) 1 s{=}{+}1 向上, - 1 - 1 向下) : 移位, s 的平均值 [log ⁡ (1 + n W ) - log ⁡ (1 + n + 0 )] s , [\log (1{+}n_{ W}) -\log (1{+}n_{ 0})] ; 在计数改变的类别中,向着窗口单词移动的份额; 变化, 计数改变的类别的份额. 柜台和靴子跟别的地方一样 第一个窗口中互换的图像与基准请求和窗口单词的普通图像(中间像素距离26-46和16-20;没有相同);最后一个窗口中互换的图像接近其基准(中间约1).

blocks.en: Results ( Tab. 28 ). The small word acts early: its shift intervals lie above zero at windows 0 and 5, with most changes toward the word, and its shift is near zero from window 15 on. At window 0 the word changes the count of 0.58 (small pair) and 0.64 (large pair) of the types, but no large-pair window has a shift interval above zero, at window 0 only 0.46 of the large word’s changes go its way, and the amplified windows have no effect either. People’s share toward the word is within 0.15 of SAM 3’s on the same pictures at three of the six windows (the small pair at steps 0–4 and 10–14, the large pair at 0–4), but not at the small pair’s steps 20–24 (one changed type) or the large pair’s 10–14 and 20–24 ( Tab. 29 ). People’s counts show one later shift toward the large word, at steps 20–24 ( + + 0.20 [0.01, 0.53]; four changed types, all toward the word), which no automatic counter shows (SAM 3 on the same pictures: + + 0.02 [ − - 0.02, 0.08]); it rests on pictures that people count inconsistently (below). The large word thus changes many counts in the first window, without a direction, and does not act later under any automatic counter.
blocks.zh: 结果(表28)。 小字的动作很早:它的转动间隔位于0和5窗口上方的零以上,大多数变化都朝着单词,从15窗口上,它的转动接近零. 在窗口0上,单词会改变类型中的0.58(小对)和0.64(大对)的计数,但是没有大pair窗口的转折间隔超过0,在窗口0上,大单词的改变只有0.46个,而放大的窗口也没有效果. 在6个窗口中的3个窗口(0至4步和10至14步的小一对,0至4步的大一对)上,人们对这个词的占比在SAM 3的0.15以内,但小一对的占比在20至24步(一个改变了类型)或大一对的10至14和20至24步(标签29)。 人们的计数显示一个后来转向大字,在20–24(+ 0.20 [0.01, 0.53] ; 四种变化类型,都朝着字面),没有自动计数器显示(SAM 3在同一幅图片上:+ + 0.02 [− - 0.02, 0.08] ) ; 它依赖于人们不统一统计的图片(以下) 。 因此,大字会改变第一个窗口中的许多计数,没有方向,并且不会在任何自动计数器下事后行动.

Under Grounding DINO the large pair’s shift is negative at every window (window 10–14: − - 0.11 [ − - 0.19, − - 0.03]) and its toward at most 0.42; under OWLv2 the large pair’s toward lies between 0.40 and 0.61; the consensus changes few large-pair counts after window 0–4. Floor: 87.5% of counts equal the plain image’s (Grounding DINO 95.8%, OWLv2 66.7%, consensus 95.8%). The consensus counts only images with a two-of-three majority, so its large-pair summaries rest on 23–36 of the 64 types (small pair 43–51). The two first counts agree exactly on 60% of the 96 pictures; checks .95, .95 and .90 exact per round.

blocks.en: The large pair’s later windows, picture by picture. People’s later changes on the large pair come mostly from pictures they count inconsistently: the first two counts agree on 5 of the 16 pictures at window 10–14 and 6 of 16 at window 20–24 (small pair 10–13 of 16 at every window; large pair at window 0–4, 12 of 16). The four changes at window 20–24: jewels (plain image 24 by people; the window picture’s three counts 26, 1 and 1, so 1; SAM 3 1 on both), ironing boards (27; 0, 20 and 29, so 20; SAM 3 0 on both), candy bars (21; 18, 8 and 17, so 17; SAM 3 24 and 25) and spice racks (4; 5, 20 and 5, so 5; SAM 3 1 on both). The jewels’ change from 24 to 1 is also one of the six changes toward the word at window 10–14 (counts 27, 1 and 1).
blocks.zh: 大对子后来的窗户,按图片排列. 人们后来在大一对上的变化大多来自他们计算不一致的图片:前两个计数在窗口10-14的16张图片中同意5张,在窗口20-24的16张图片中同意6张(每个窗口16张的小一对10-13;窗口0-4,12张16张). 窗口20至24的4个变化:珠宝(由人制作的平面图24;窗口图片的3个计数为26、1和1,所以1;SAM 3 1在两边),熨斗板(27;0、20和29,所以20;SAM 3 0在两边),糖果栏(21、18、8和17,所以17;SAM 3 24和25)和香料架(4、5、20和5,所以5;SAM 3 1在两边)。 珠宝从24个改为1个,也是窗口10-14(第27、第1和第1项)的六个字变化之一。

blocks.en: E.4 The timing test in two more models
blocks.zh: E.4 联合国 另外两个模型的计时测试

blocks.en: Design. U2’s 64 types, seed 1, the pairs and the direction per type of the timing test ( Sec. E.3 ). SDXL: the sampler of the word test (40 Euler steps, guidance 5, 1024 2 1024^{2} ) with a prompt switch that replaces the text embeddings and the pooled embedding inside the window; plain images at 2, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 20, 25 and 30 (576; the baselines, and SDXL’s word test on U2); windows of five steps starting at steps 0, 5, …, 30 (896); the base number respelled in digits (“a photo of 12 cribs” inside “a photo of twelve cribs”) at windows 0 and 5 (256); the window’s word from step 0 up to step 10 or 20 (256). FLUX.2 [klein]: the word test’s sampler (50 steps, guidance 4, 1024 2 1024^{2} ), every prompt encoded once by the pipeline and switched by its step callback; baselines are the word test’s images; windows of six steps (12% of sampling, as five of 40) starting at steps 0, 6, …, 36 for the large pair and 0, 6, 12 for the small one (640); respelled at windows 0 and 6 (large) and 0 (small; 192); the window’s word up to step 12 or 24 (large; 128). SD3.5-M: the base number respelled in digits inside the timing test’s windows 0–4 and 5–9, both pairs (256), with its sampler. In every model the unconditional branch is unchanged. 3,200 images, counted by SAM 3, Grounding DINO and OWLv2. A window acts when its shift interval lies above 0 and toward is at least 0.75 (small pair) or 0.65 (large pair); full : the window’s word asked at every step (its plain image); prefix share : prefix shift over full shift. In every model the first window’s images differ from both plain images, while the last window’s lie near the base request’s plain image ( Tabs. 30 and 31 ).
blocks.zh: 设计. U2的64种,种子1,配对和每种计时试验的方向(Sec. E.3. SDXL:字形测试的采样器(40 Euler steps, 指导 5, 1024 2 1024^{2} ),带有一个即时开关,可以替换文本嵌入和集合嵌入在窗口内;平面图像为2,4,6,8,12,16,20,25和30(576;基线,以及SDXL在U2上的字形测试);从0,5,.,30(896)步开始的5步窗口,基数在窗口0和5(256)重新拼写成数字(“12个婴儿床的照片”内有“12个婴儿床的照片);窗口的字从0步上到10或20步(256). FLUX.2 [klein]:单词测试的采样器(50步,引导 4, 1024 2 1024^{2}),每一次通过管道编码并按步骤调回;基线是单词测试的图像;从0,6,.,36对大对和0,6,12对小对开始的6步窗口(640);在0和6(大)和0(小;192)重新拼写;窗口的单词高达12或24步(大;128)。 SD3.5-M:基数在计时测试的窗口0–4和5–9内以数字重新拼写,两者均配对(256),其采样器. 每个模型中无条件的分支不变. 3200幅图像,由SAM 3,Grounding DINO和OWLv2计算. 当窗口的转折间隔在 0 以上, 并朝着 0 以上时, 窗口至少 0. 75 (小对) 或 0. 65 (大对); 完整 : 窗口的单词在每一步( 其平面图像) 中被问到 ; 前缀 : 前缀转折 而不是全转 。 每个模型中,第一个窗口的图像与两个平面图像不同,而最后一个窗口的图像则位于基础请求的平面图像(Tabs. 30和31)附近。

blocks.en: Results (SAM 3). In SDXL the large word moves the count over the whole trajectory ( + + 0.30) and its first ten steps carry all of it (share 1.03); at its first window the small word changes more types than the respelling ( + + 0.28 [0.14, 0.42]), and all four SDXL respelling intervals contain 0. The small word’s first window shifts the count (0.17 [0.02, 0.31]) with 74% of the changes toward the word, and its windows at steps 5–9 and 10–14 act; no single large window acts. In FLUX.2 [klein] the large word moves the count over the whole trajectory ( + + 0.45); the small word acts at steps 0–5 and 6–11, the large word’s first window acts, and its first twelve steps carry the whole effect (share 1.00); in that first window the large word changes no more types than its respelling ( + + 0.03 [ − - 0.08, 0.14]), although only the word’s changes have a direction (82% against 58% toward). In SD3.5-M the large word’s first window changes about as many types as its respelling ( + + 0.05), while the small word’s changes 0.33 more. Late windows stay small: every window from step 15 (SDXL) or 18 (FLUX.2 [klein]) has its interval within ± \pm 0.10 except one in each model (SDXL steps 20–24: [ − 0.004 , 0.18 ] [-0.004,0.18] ; FLUX.2 [klein] steps 18–23: [ − 0.07 , 0.10 ] [-0.07,0.10] , upper end 0.101). SDXL’s order on U2 is 0.76 at 2–8 and 0.61 at 12–30 ( Sec. C.1 ).
blocks.zh: 结果(SAM 3)。 在SDXL中,大字将计数移动在整个轨迹上(+ + 0.30),其前十步将全部运走(share 1.03);在其第一个窗口中,小字比重写(+ + 0.28 [0.14,0.42])更能改变类型,所有四个SDXL重写间隔都包含 零点 小字眼的第一个窗口将计数(0.17 [0.02,0.31])以74%的变动向该词转移,其窗口在步骤5-9和步骤10-14中;没有单一的大窗口行为。 在FLUX.2 [klein]中,大字将计数移动到整个轨迹上(++0.45);小字在0–5和6–11步中动作,大字的第一个窗口动作,其前十二步带有整个效果(share 1.00);在这个窗口中,大字的改变类型不超过其重写(++ 0.03 [−0.08,0.14]),尽管只有词的改变有方向(82%对58 % ) 。 在SD3.5-M中,大字的第一个窗口会与其重写(++ 0.05)一样多的种类变化,小字则会多变化0.33. 晚窗保持小:从第15步(SDXL)或第18步(FLUX.2 [klein])起,每个窗口的间隔都在±\pm0.10之内,但每个模型中只有一个(SDXL步骤20–24:[−0.004,0.18] [0.004,0.18];FLUX.2 [klein]步骤18–23:[−0.07,0.10] [0.07,0.10],上端0.101). SDXL对U2的订单为2–8的0.76,12–30的0.61(sec.C.1.).

blocks.en: What it shows. In FLUX.2 [klein] the earliest acting large window is the first, no later one acts and the prefix carries the whole effect: where its large number word moves the count, it acts early. In SDXL no single window passes the direction criterion, but the first ten steps act and carry about all of the effect (share 1.03 [0.53, 2.33]): an effect spread over the early windows, below single-window detection; under OWLv2 the first window acts (0.30 [0.15, 0.46], 69% toward). No window from step 10 acts in either model, so large numbers do not act late. In SD3.5-M the large word’s early change equals the respelling’s and has no direction.
blocks.zh: 所显示. 在FLUX.2 [klein]中,最早的演绎大窗口是第一个,没有后一个,前缀带有整个效果:在它的大量单词移动计数的地方,它动作很早. 在SDXL中,没有单一窗口通过方向标准,但前十步动作并携带了全部效果(共享1.03 [0.53,2.33]):这种效果分布在早期窗口,单窗检测以下;在OWLv2中,第一个窗口行为(0.30 [0.15,0.46],69%朝向). 无论是第10步还是第10步,都没有任何一个窗口,因此,大量人员不会迟到。 在SD3.5-M中,大字的早期变化等于重写,没有方向。

blocks.en: Counters. For SDXL, OWLv2 gives the clearest large-pair effect (whole trajectory 0.45 [0.25, 0.65], prefix share 0.86) and Grounding DINO the weakest (0.15 [ − - 0.07, 0.40]; its steps 5–9 window acts, and its respelling at steps 0–4 also leans toward the word, 0.25 [0.06, 0.43]). For FLUX.2 [klein] the detectors disagree with SAM 3 on direction: Grounding DINO reads fewer objects for twenty-five over the whole trajectory ( − - 0.38 [ − - 0.61, − - 0.16], set within the first twelve steps, share 1.01) and OWLv2 no change ( − - 0.04 [ − - 0.30, 0.22]); both miss many of FLUX.2 [klein]’s objects, which shrink to about 2% of the image at 25–30 ( Tab. 17 ), while people’s counts in the word test grow from 12 for twelve to 20 for twenty-five. In both models and under every counter, every window from step 15 or 18 on stays within − - 0.07 to 0.18.
blocks.zh: 计数器。 对SDXL来说,OWLv2给出了最明显的大平面效果(整个轨迹0.45 [0.25, 0.65],前缀份额0.86)和将最弱的DINO定位(0.15 [−-0.07, 040];其步骤5–9的窗口作用,其步骤0–4的重投也倾向于单词0.25 [0.06, 0.43]). 对于FLUX.2 [klein] 探测器在方向上不同意SAM 3: 俯冲DINO在整个轨迹上对25个物体的读数较少(− - 0.38 [− - - - 0.61,− - 0.16],设定在前十二步,共享1.01)和OWLv2无变化(− - 0.04 [− - 0.30,0.22]);两者都错过了许多FLUX.2[克林]的物体,在25–30时缩小到图像的约2%(图17),而人们在单词测试中的计数从12对12到25对20。 在两种模型和每个计数器下,从第15步或第18步到在−-0.07至0.18之间停留的每一窗口。

blocks.en: Up and down. At the first window, the large word moves the count toward itself in both directions by the point estimates: in SDXL by + + 0.16 for the 32 types asked to go up and + + 0.29 for the 32 asked to go down, in FLUX.2 [klein] by + + 0.16 and + + 0.33; each direction’s interval, on 32 types, contains 0.
blocks.zh: 上下无间. 在第一个窗口中,大字将计数以点估计的方式向自己两个方向移动:在SDXL中,要求上行的32种类型为+0.16,要求下行的32种类型为+0.29,在FLUX.2 [klein]中,以++0.16和++0.33表示;在32种类型上,每个方向的间隔包含0.

blocks.en: Noise levels. The three schedules reach a given noise level at different steps. From each sampler’s own settings, the noise level σ \sigma at the first step of the five-step windows 0, 5, 10, …, 30 is 1.00, 0.95, 0.90, 0.83, 0.74, 0.63 and 0.48 in SD3.5-M (FlowMatch, shift 3) and, as the rectified-flow equivalent σ Euler / ( 1 + σ Euler ) \sigma_{\text{Euler}}/(1+\sigma_{\text{Euler}}) , 0.93, 0.87, 0.79, 0.70, 0.60, 0.50 and 0.39 in SDXL (scaled-linear betas, leading spacing; its first step is not pure noise); at the six-step windows 0, 6, 12, …, 36 of FLUX.2 [klein] (dynamic shift for 1024 2 1024^{2} ) it is 1.00, 0.98, 0.96, 0.93, 0.89, 0.83 and 0.75. The small word’s acting windows therefore end at σ \sigma 0.91 in SD3.5-M, 0.96 in FLUX.2 [klein] and 0.72 in SDXL; the numbers are not strictly comparable across models, whose latent spaces differ.
blocks.zh: 噪声等级. 三个时间表在不同步骤上达到给定的噪音水平. 从每个采样者自己的设置来看,在SD3.5-M(FlowMatch, 3班)中,在五步窗口0,5,10,.,0.90,0.83,0.74,0.63,0.63和0.48的第一阶段,噪声水平为\sigma;在六步窗口0,6,12,36的FLUX.2[Klein](1024 2 1024^{2的动力转换)中,噪声水平为1.00,0.98,0.96,0.93,0.89,0.80,0.50,0.50,0.39,0.89,0.89,0.89,0.89,0.83和0.75。 因此,小字的动作窗口以SD3.5-M的\sigma 0.91、FLUX.2 [klein] 0.96和SDXL的0.72结束;这些数字在各种模型之间没有严格的可比性,其潜在空间不同。

blocks.en: Object sizes in the windows. Against the base request’s plain image, the change in log median SAM 3 box area, signed so that positive means the objects changed size the way the window’s word asks (smaller for the larger request): FLUX.2 [klein], large pair, + + 0.66 [0.41, 0.92] with the word at every step, + + 0.35 [0.15, 0.55] at steps 0–5, + + 0.33 [0.18, 0.48] at 6–11, + + 0.09 at 12–17, at most + + 0.04 later, + + 0.69 for the twelve-step prefix; SDXL, large pair, + + 0.35 [0.01, 0.69] at every step, + + 0.21 [ − - 0.09, 0.52] at steps 0–4, at most + + 0.03 later, + + 0.35 for the ten-step prefix; SD3.5-M, large pair, + + 0.01 [ − - 0.32, 0.35] at every step. The small pairs rescale by + + 0.49 to + + 0.71 at every step and by + + 0.28 to + + 0.36 in the first window; respelling rescales by at most + + 0.17 (intervals containing 0 except SDXL’s small pair at steps 5–9, + + 0.15 [0.02, 0.32]).

blocks.en: E.5 When the model’s own crowd is fixed
blocks.zh: E.5 联合国 当模型自己的人群固定

blocks.en: A commitment probe follows SD3.5-M’s own plain trajectories asked for 4, 12 and 25 objects (64 U2 types, seed 1; every final image equals U2’s, mean absolute difference 0). At each step the guided velocity gives an estimate x ^ 0 \hat{x}_{0} of the clean latent; we correlate it, after an ideal low-pass at 2, 4 or 8 cycles per image width, with the final latent, and SAM 3 counts the decoded x ^ 0 \hat{x}_{0} at twelve steps. The coarse layout is fixed at once: the correlation at 4 cycles reaches 0.9 by step 2 ( σ = 0.98 \sigma{=}0.98 ) in the median trajectory at every request (mean 0.84–0.86 at step 0, 0.99 at step 9), so its share fixed by step 9 is 1.00 at 4, 12 and 25. The count, as SAM 3 reads the estimated image, settles later: within max ⁡ ( 1 , 10 % ) \max(1,10\%) of the final count from step 9 on ( σ = 0.91 \sigma{=}0.91 ) in 47% [35, 60] of trajectories asked for four, 40% [27, 53] for twelve and 28% [16, 41] for twenty-five (25 minus 4: − - 0.19 [ − - 0.36, − - 0.02]), with median settling steps 12, 12 and 15 ( σ \sigma 0.87–0.83); blurred early estimates may be read late, so these bound the count’s commitment from above. The final counts stay small whatever the request (medians 4, 8 and 6). By step 9 the layout is set at every request, while the count is set in fewer than half of the trajectories at any request.
E.6 Amplifying the number word
blocks.zh: E.6 联合国 放大数字单词

blocks.en: SD3.5-M, U2, seed 1, SAM 3 unless stated. During the first ten steps ( σ ≥ 0.909 \sigma\geq 0.909 ), L ⁡ ( v ⁡ ( c ) − v ⁡ ( c ′ ) ) L\,(v(c)-v(c^{\prime})) was added to the guided velocity, c ′ c^{\prime} being the prompt with the pair’s other request, a contrastive guidance [ 59 ] used to improve counts up to ten [ 52 ] ( L = 2 L{=}2 , 5, 10; 768 images), or the prompt without its number ( L = 5 L{=}5 , 10; 896 images). The small pair stays ordered (0.86–0.92; 0.94 unsteered); the large pair does not become ordered (0.52 unsteered, 0.41 [0.28, 0.54] at L = 10 L{=}10 ). Against the number-free prompt the exact rate at 12–30 moves from 2.5% to 4.1% and 3.1% ( L = 5 L{=}5 minus L = 0 L{=}0 : + + 0.016 [ − - 0.006, 0.041]), and people find 4% exact at L = 10 L{=}10 , the plain prompt’s rate; their medians at 12, 16, 20, 25 and 30 are 8, 6, 8.5, 10.5 and 4.5 (SAM 3: 6.5, 2, 6, 4.5 and 5). In the timing test’s amplified arm ( Sec. E.3 ) the large word was amplified inside windows from step 10 to step 24 without effect. Amplified, the large number word gains no direction.
blocks.zh: SD3.5-M,U2,种子1,SAM 3 除非说明. 在前十步(σ 0.909\sigma\geq 0.909),L⁡(v ⁡ (c)- v (c′)),L\(v (c))-v((c^{\prime)))被加入到导引速度中,c′(c^{\prime)是配合对对等请求的提示,是用来改进计数的对比性指导[59],最多可达十 [52](L = 2 L{=}2, 5, 10; 768影像),或没有编号的提示(L = 5 L{=}5, 10;896影像). 小配对保持订购(0.86–0.92;0.94无蒸发);大配对没有变为订购(0.52无蒸发,0.41 [0.28,0.54] at L = 10 L{=}10). 以无数速率12至30从2.5%升至4.1%和3.1%(L = 5 L{=}5减L = 0 L{=}0:+ + 0.016 [− 0.006, 0.041])为例,人们发现有4%的精确率为L = 10 L{=}10,即平时速率;其12、16、20、25和30的中位数为8、6、8.5、10.5和4.5(SAM 3:6.5、2、6、4.5和5)。 在计时测试的放大臂(Sec. E.3 )中,大字从第10步放大到第24步的窗内没有效果. 放大了, 大量的单词没有方向。

blocks.en: E.7 A direction borrowed from small numbers
blocks.zh: E.7 联合国 从小数借方向

blocks.en: Design. SD3.5-M, 64 types, seed 1, the plain images’ noise ( 768 2 768^{2} , 40 steps, guidance 4.5). The prompt asks for twelve (the main case) or twenty-five; during the first ten steps ( σ ≥ 0.909 \sigma\geq 0.909 ) the guided velocity gets + L ⁡ ( v ⁡ ( four ) − v ⁡ ( two ) ) +L\,(v(\text{four})-v(\text{two})) (“up”) or the reverse (“down”), where v ⁡ ( c ) v(c) is the conditional velocity for “a photo of c c X X s” at the same state, with L = 1 , 2 , 4 , 8 L=1,2,4,8 , and L = 0 L=0 is the plain image (1,152 images); every cell differs from every other cell of its noise. The L-order is the share of same-noise pairs of strengths whose counts differ in which the stronger push moves the count the borrowed way (more objects up, fewer down).
blocks.zh: 设计. SD3.5-M,64型,种子1,平面图像的噪音(768 2 768^{2},40步,指导4.5). 即时请求十二(主案)或二十五(上),或倒数(“下”),在前十步(\\\ 0.909\sigma\geq 0.909)中,导引速度得到+L + + + + (v → (四) + → → + → → → (两)) + L\, (v(\ text{ four})- v(\text{ two}))(上)或逆数(“下”),其中v → (c) v → (c) v(c) v(c) v(c) v(c) 是同一状态的“c X s" 照片的有条件速度, L = 1, 2, 4 4, 8 L= 1, 2, 4, 8 L= 0 L= 0 L 是平面图像 (1, 152 图像); 每个细胞都不同于其噪声的所有其他单元格 。 L级是相同噪声的对强子的占比,其计数不同,较强的推力将计数方式移动(更多对象向上,更少向下).

blocks.en: Results. The up push moves the crowd the other way: its L-order is a reversal, with its interval below 0.5, and at L = 8 L{=}8 it shrinks the crowd. The down push shrinks it, the way it pushes (0.73). Both pushes bring the crowd toward the small pair’s own counts (medians about four and two at L = 8 L{=}8 ), and the exact rate at twelve falls from 9% to 5%. The small numbers’ difference points toward small counts, not toward “more”.
blocks.zh: 结果。 向上推力将人群推向另一方向:它的L-顺序是逆转,其间距低于0.5,在L=8 L{=}8时则缩小人群. 降压推力缩小,推力方式(0.73). 两种推力都把人群引向小对夫妇自己的计数(医学家在L = 8 L = 8 L = 8 ) , 12 的精确率从9%下降到5%。 人数少的差别是指人数少,而不是 " 更多 " 。

blocks.en: E.8 Text streams and dropped encoders
blocks.zh: 页:1 文本流和已丢弃的编码器

blocks.en: Design. From the noise of each type’s plain image (seeds 1 and 2), each text stream is given one number of a pair, two against four or twelve against twenty-five, in the prompt “a photo of c c X X s”. Cells are named by the number given to CLIP and to T5: LL and HH are the plain images of the smaller and the larger request; HL gives CLIP the larger and T5 the smaller, LH the reverse. In SD3.5-M, CLIP means both CLIP token sequences and the pooled CLIP vector; two more cells change the pooled vector alone. In FLUX.1-dev, CLIP is its only CLIP input, a pooled vector. The contrast for a stream compares two cells that differ only in that stream’s number (CLIP: HL against LL and HH against LH; T5: LH against LL and HH against HL; both: HH against LL); its order is the share of contrasts whose counts differ in which the cell with that stream’s larger number has more objects. SD3.5-M: 64 types, 1,536 images; FLUX.1-dev: 32 types (the 16 counted by people and 16 drawn at random from the other 48), 512 images, at the settings of its word test.
blocks.zh: 设计. 从每种类型的平面图像(种子1和2)的噪声中,每条文字流在即时 " 一张cc X X s的照片 " 中得到一个数的一对,两个对4或十二对25。 单元格由给CLIP和T5的号码命名: LL和HH是大小请求的平面图像;HL给CLIP更大的和T5的,LH反之. 在SD3.5-M中,CLIP既指CLIP符号序列,也指集合的CLIP矢量;另外两个单元格单独改变集合矢量. 在FLUX.1-dev中,CLIP是其唯一的CLIP输入,一个集合向量. 一个流的对比度比较了两个仅在该流数中存在差异的单元格(CLIP:HL对LL,HH对LH;T5:LH对LL,HH对HL;两者均:HH对LL);其顺序是其数与该流数较大的单元格有较多对象的对比量的比例. SD3.5-M:64类型,1,536张图像;FLUX.1-dev:32类型(16种由人计算,16种从其他48个随机抽取),512张图像,在其文字测试的设置上.

blocks.en: Table 33 : Stream test, every counter (order of each stream’s contrast; 95% intervals over types). SD3.5-M’s pooled vector alone: 0.56 [0.44, 0.66] at two vs four and 0.54 [0.45, 0.63] at twelve vs twenty-five (SAM 3). Interaction (both minus the sum of the two streams’ effects, in log ⁡ ( 1 + n ) \log(1{+}n) ): SD3.5-M − - 0.02 [ − - 0.11, 0.08] and + + 0.08 [ − - 0.10, 0.25]; FLUX.1-dev + + 0.04 [ − - 0.06, 0.15] and − - 0.08 [ − - 0.27, 0.08].

Results. In both models at least one stream carries two against four to the crowd in order, and no stream carries twelve against twenty-five ( Tab. 33 ). SD3.5-M’s CLIP and T5 streams each order the small pair and neither the large one; under Grounding DINO and the consensus its CLIP stream reverses the large pair. FLUX.1-dev’s T5 stream orders the small pair and moves the large one the wrong way if anything, a reversal under every counter.
blocks.zh: 结果。 两条车型中,至少有一条车流将2对4的车排到人群中,没有一条车流将12对25(Tab.33. SD3.5-M的CLIP和T5流各订购小对而不是大对;在Grounding DINO和共识下,它的CLIP流反转大对. FLUX.1-dev的T5流命令小对子,将大对子移动到任何错误的方式,每个计数器下都出现逆转.

blocks.en: One stream removed. SD3.5-M was trained with each encoder dropped at random, so it can draw with one of them empty (T5 as 77 zero tokens; CLIP as zero tokens and a zero pooled vector). With T5 dropped (CLIP only), the order at 2–8 stays at 0.88 [0.83, 0.93] and at 12–30 is 0.41 [0.34, 0.49] (plain images: 0.89 and 0.46; 64 types, seed 1, SAM 3); with CLIP dropped (T5 only), the order is 0.75 [0.67, 0.83] at 2–8 and 0.36 [0.28, 0.44] at 12–30, and the crowds past ten nearly vanish (medians 2, 1 and 1 objects at 12, 20 and 30, against 8, 6 and 4.5). Neither arm extends the reach: relative to the plain images, the order at 12–30 changes by − - 0.05 [ − - 0.13, 0.04] and − - 0.10 [ − - 0.20, 0.01], and both orders past ten are reversals. The large number is not lost in one encoder: in SD3.5-M each stream carries a small number to the crowd and none a large one, and in FLUX.1-dev the T5 stream carries a small number and not a large one.
blocks.zh: 一个溪流被移除。 SD3.5-M是随每个编码器随机投放而训练的,因此它可以随其中之一空投而画(T5为77个零符号;CLIP为零符号和一个零集合矢量). T5下降(仅限CLIP)后,2-8的订单停留在0.88 [0.83,0.93],12-30的订单停留在0.41 [0.34,0.49] (平面图像:0.89和0.46;64型,种子1,SAM 3);CLIP下降(仅限T5)后,2-8和0.36 [0.28,0.44]的订单停留在0.75 [0.28,0.44]的订单停留在12-30, 人群过去几乎消失的10个(医学家2,1和1个物体在12,20和30,对8,6和4.5). 两臂均不延伸伸展范围:相对于平面图像,12–30的顺序变化为−-0.05[−-0.13,0.04]和−-0.10[−-0.20,0.01],过去10的顺序都是逆向的. 在一个编码器中不会丢失大量数字:在SD3.5-M中,每条溪流携带一个小数给人群,没有一个大数,在FLUX中. 1-dev T5流携带着少量而非大数量.

blocks.en: E.9 Starts against a planted count
blocks.zh: E.9 以人工计数开始

blocks.en: SD3.5-M, U2, seed 1, SAM 3 unless stated.
blocks.zh: SD3.5-M,U2,种子1,SAM 3 除非说明.

blocks.en: Earlier starts against a plant of the other count. A grid of 2, 4, 12 or 25 cut-outs (58 types) was planted at σ \sigma from 0.991 to 0.909 and asked for the other count of its pair (116 conflicting and 116 agreeing cells per level). The small word pulls the count toward itself at every level (pull in log ⁡ ( 1 + n ) \log(1{+}n) from + + 0.40 at 0.991 to + + 0.18 at 0.909; all intervals exclude zero) and raises the share drawn with the asked count by 0.53 to 0.20 over the agreeing cells; the large word raises it by − - 0.01 to + + 0.03, and its pull lies between − - 0.20 and + + 0.14 with intervals that include zero except at 0.982 ( − - 0.40 to − - 0.02). Under Grounding DINO, OWLv2 and their consensus the small-pair lift lies between 0.13 and 0.53 and the large-pair lift between − - 0.01 and + + 0.03. A planted 2 or 4 leaves free canvas while a planted 12 or 25 fills it; the re-noise test below removes this difference.
blocks.zh: 早点开始对付另一个伯爵的植物 在0.991至0.909之间的\sigma上植入了2,4,12或25个剪接点(58种)的网格,并询问其配对的其他计数(每层116个相互冲突,116个同意细胞). 小字将计算从每个级别拉向自己(从0.991的+ 0.40到+ 0.18的+ 0.909的+ 0.40到+ 0.18;所有间隔均排除0),并将与要求的计数的比例比同意的单元格增加0.53至0.20;大字将计算从− 0.01提高到+ 0.03,将其拉在− 0.20至+ + 0.14之间,除0.982(−0.40至−-0.02)外,其间隔为0;在DINO、OWLv2及其共识下,小帕升力位于0.13至0.53之间,大帕升力位于−0.01至+ 0.03之间。

blocks.en: The model’s own images, re-noised. U2’s plain images asked for six and twenty objects (64 types; median SAM 3 count 5 and 6) were re-noised with their own noise to σ \sigma 0.991–0.813 and finished asking for 2 or 4, or for 12 or 25 (2,560 renders). The small pair stays ordered at 0.991 (order 0.93, pull + + 0.41) and loses order as the start sharpens (0.59 at 0.813); the large pair’s order is 0.45–0.56 down to σ = 0.872 \sigma{=}0.872 (pulls − - 0.08 to 0.00) and 0.80 at 0.813 (pull + + 0.07 [0.02, 0.16]), where most starts keep their count (0.69). Under Grounding DINO, OWLv2 and the consensus the large-pair pull never exceeds + + 0.02.
