blocks.en: Starts between the two requests. Here the planted crowd lies between the pair’s two requests, so that either word must add or remove objects. For the large pair it is the model’s own image of the type with 16–20 objects by SAM 3, closest to 18 (51 types: 49 self-planted images, Sec. F.4 , and 2 plain ones; mean SAM 3 count 17.9); for the small pair, a plain image with exactly three objects (32 types); seed 1, or seed 2 for a type without such an image. Each start is re-noised with its own noise ( Eq. 3 ) to σ \sigma 0.991, 0.963, 0.909, 0.872 or 0.813 and finished asking for 12 or 25, or for 2 or 4: 51 types × \times 2 requests × \times 5 levels and 32 × \times 2 × \times 5, 830 renders. At 0.991 the small pair is ordered (0.96) and the large pair is not (0.51 [0.36, 0.66]; small minus large 0.45 [0.28, 0.61]): asking for twelve thins the crowd in 98% of renders, and asking for twenty-five adds objects in only 18% (mean counts 8.3 and 10.6 from about 18). From the later starts the large pair’s order reaches 0.66 [0.51, 0.80] at σ = 0.963 \sigma{=}0.963 and 0.80 [0.60, 0.96] at 0.909, over the types whose two counts differ (41 and 20 of the 51), but the two words’ mean counts differ there by less than one object: 11.9 for twelve against 12.6 for twenty-five at 0.963, and 16.8 against 17.1 at 0.909 (differences 0.65 and 0.35). From 0.909 on, both words mostly keep the start’s count (0.55 of renders at 0.909, 0.74 at 0.813).
blocks.zh: 从两个请求之间开始。 在此, 被埋设的人群位于对子的两个请求之间, 因此任意一个词必须添加或删除对象 。 对于大配对来说,它是模型自己用16~20个物体的型号的图像,由SAM 3拍摄,最接近18个(51个类型:49个自植的图像,Sec.F.4,和2个平原的;指SAM 3 计17.9);对于小配对来说,一个完全有3个物体的平原图像(32个类型);种子1,或种子2为一个没有这种图像的类型. 每次开始时都会用自己的噪音(Eq. 3)重新点名到\sigma 0.991, 0.963, 0.909, 0.872或 0.813, 并完成要求 12 或 25, 或 2 或 4 : 51 型 × 时 2 请求 × 时 5 级 和 32 × 时 5, 830 制. 在0.991时订购小对子(0.96),大对子不是(0.51 [0.36, 0.66];小减大0.45 [0.28, 0.61]):要求在98%的成交量中将人群分12个稀释,要求仅增加18%的25个物体(平均计算8.3和约18的10.6). 从后来开始,在0.909的0.66 [0.51,0.80] 和0.86 = 0.963\sigma 0.963 和 0.80 [0.60, 0.96] 中,两个计数不同(51个中的41个和20个)的种类,但这两个字的平均计数差小于一个对象:在0.963时,12个为12个,25个为12.6个;在0.909时,16.8个为17.1个(差数0.65和0.35)。 从0.909起,这两个词大多都把开始的计数(0.55的计数为0.909,0.74的计数为0.813)。

blocks.en: From a planted crowd, a small word moves the count toward itself at every start level; a large word hardly moves it toward its own count.
blocks.zh: 一个小词会让伯爵在每一个起点上 向自己移动;一个大词几乎不会向自己的伯爵移动。

blocks.en: E.10 Training the number word
blocks.zh: E.10 联合国 训练数字单词

blocks.en: Design. Two LoRAs of SD3.5-M (rank 32, α = 64 \alpha{=}64 , the attention projections of every joint block; learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , batch 2, 1,500 steps, about 1.5 passes; seed 2027) were trained with the model’s own flow-matching loss on 2,037 of its own images of U1 and U3, none of a U2 type, whose SAM 3 count equals the request: 1,653 self-planted crowds of 12–30 objects (99 types; every arrangement of Sec. F.4 ; 768 2 768^{2} ) and 384 plain images of two to four objects (111 types; 512 2 512^{2} ). The count LoRA sees each image with its own prompt; the shuffled LoRA sees the same images in the same order with the same noise, but each crowd with the number word of another crowd (a seeded permutation; 162 of 1,653 keep their own). Each was tested at its training scale from U2’s plain prompts and noise (64 types, nine requests, seed 1, 768 2 768^{2} , 40 steps, guidance 4.5; 576 images per arm). Twelve is the most common crowd count among the training images (306 of 1,653; 216 at twenty, 172 at thirty).
blocks.zh: 设计. SD3.5-M的两个LORA(排名32,α = 64\alpha{=}64),每个联合区块的注意力预测;学习率10−4 10^{-4},第2批1,500步,约1.5次通过;种子2027在2,037个自己的U1和U3图像上接受了自流匹配损失的培训,没有一个U2型,其SAM 3的计数等于请求:1,653个自植群12-30个物体(99种;每安排Sec.F.4;768 2,768^{2)和384个2至4个物体(111型;512,512^{2})的平面图像。 伯爵LORA用自己的即时看到每个图像;被洗涤的LORA用相同的噪音以相同的顺序看到相同的图像,但每个人群都用另一个人群的数字(一个种子的长音;1,653个中的162个保留自己的). 每一个都通过U2的平原导火索和噪音(64型,9项请求,种子1,768 2,768^{2}),40步,导火索4.5;每臂576幅图像)进行了训练规模的测试. 十二是训练画面中最常见的人群数(1,653人中有306人;20人中有216人,30人中有172人)。

Medians at 12, 16, 20, 25 and 30: 12, 12, 14, 12, 10 (count), 28, 28, 28, 26, 24 (shuffled), 8, 8, 6, 6, 4 (plain). The count arm’s order at 2–8 is 0.98 and its mean log ⁡ ( 1 + n ) \log(1{+}n) at 12–30 exceeds the untrained model’s by 0.46 [0.13, 0.80], but its order at 12–30, 0.43 [0.26, 0.61], is no higher than the shuffled arm’s (count minus shuffled 0.08 [ − - 0.12, 0.27]): by people the count LoRA does not beat the shuffled one. Exact by request (count arm): 1.00, 0.81, 0.38, 0.44, 0.38, 0.06, 0.06, 0 and 0.06 at 2–30 (untrained 0.94, 0.38, 0, 0.13, 0.13, 0.06, 0, 0, 0; shuffled 0.81, 0.13 and then 0); at 12–30, 11% against 4% untrained and 0% shuffled. Medians at 12–30: 12, 12, 12, 12, 9.5 (count), 36, 35, 33, 34.5, 17.5 (shuffled); on the same pictures SAM 3’s medians of the count arm at 16–30 are 12, 12, 12 and 7.5.

blocks.en: Trained on its own counted crowds, SD3.5-M learns counts up to about twelve, the most common crowd count among the training images, but not an order past it; trained on the same crowds with shuffled counts, it draws crowds of about 35 objects, so drawing capacity is not the limit.
blocks.zh: SD3.5-M在自己统计的人群中接受训练,学习的人群数最多可达12人左右,是训练画面中最常见的人群数,但不是经过它的命令;在同一个人群中接受用洗牌计数的训练,它吸引了大约35个物体的人群,所以绘图能力不是极限.

blocks.en: E.11 The conditional read as a classifier
blocks.zh: 页:1 条件读作分类器

blocks.en: Method. A diffusion classifier [ 30 , 10 ] , as Zhao et al . use to probe numerosity [ 68 ] , compares, on an image y y of known count, the conditional denoising loss under two prompts. The image is encoded to x 0 x_{0} (latent mode), noised to x k = ( 1 − σ k ) ​ x 0 + σ k ​ ϵ x_{k}=(1-\sigma_{k})x_{0}+\sigma_{k}\epsilon at ten steps k k of the model’s own schedule (six draws of ϵ \epsilon per image and step, shared by the prompts), and the conditional branch alone gives the velocity. An image prefers the true count when the loss under the other count’s prompt, averaged over the draws, is higher; the next type’s noun at the true count checks that the classifier reads the image at all. Win rate: share of images that prefer the true prompt, with 95% intervals over object types. The separation of a pair is the probability that an image with the larger count favours the larger word more than an image with the smaller count does (an AUC of the loss difference; 0.5: no separation), which, unlike the win rate, ignores a shift of both counts toward one word. Early steps ( σ ≥ 0.91 \sigma\geq 0.91 in SD3.5-M) are those of the small word’s acting windows in the timing test. A version on composites of known count (cut-outs pasted on a flat ground) did not pass its own validity check, as the conditional named the object there less reliably than on the model’s own images, so we do not use it.
blocks.zh: 方法。 方法吗? 一个扩散分类器[30, 10],如赵等人用来探测数值[68],用已知数的图像yy来比较两个提示下有条件的去诺损失. 图像编码为x 0 x%\0} (相对模式), 噪声为x k = (1 − \ k) x 0 + \ k x_{k}=(1-\ssigma_{k})x_{0}+\sigma_{k}\epsilon在模型自身时间表的十步 kk上(每幅图像和台阶六幅\εeepsilon的图画,由提示共享),条件分支单独给出速度. 图像更喜欢真实的计数, 当其他计数的提示下的损失, 平均比绘图要高时; 下一个类型在真正的计数检查时的名词, 分类者会读取图像 。 胜率(Win rate):偏爱真实提示的图像份额,间隔95%,而非对象类型. 配对的分离是指一个拥有较大计数的图像比拥有较小计数的图像更偏爱大字的概率(一个损失差的AUC;0.5:不分离),这与胜率不同,忽略了两个计数向一个字的转变. 早期步骤(σ 0.91\sigma\geq 0.91 in SD3.5-M)是计时测试中小字的动作窗口的步法. 关于已知计数的复合材料(在平地上粘贴)的版本没有通过自己的有效性检查,因为那里有条件的命名对象比模型自己的图像更不可靠,所以我们不使用它.

blocks.en: The model’s own images. The probe uses 259 of SD3.5-M’s own U2 images whose SAM 3 count equals the request: plain images asked for two (84 images of 52 types) or four (50 of 37), self-planted images asked for twelve (59 of 36) or twenty-five (56 of 37), and plain images asked for twelve (10). Here the classifier reads the object name: 0.97 at σ = 0.94 \sigma{=}0.94 and 1.00 from 0.91 on. Two against four: 0.83, 0.88, 0.93 and 0.90 at σ \sigma 0.98, 0.96, 0.94 and 0.91 (two objects 0.81–0.92, four 0.86–0.96); at σ = 1 \sigma{=}1 both small counts lean toward “four” (two objects 0.49, four 0.86). Twelve against twenty-five: images of twelve prefer “twelve” throughout the high-noise steps (0.81–0.88), but images of twenty-five prefer “twenty-five” in only 0.14 [0.05, 0.25] and 0.32 [0.18, 0.46] at σ \sigma 1 and 0.98, in 0.54 [0.39, 0.68] and 0.48 [0.33, 0.64] at 0.96 and 0.94, and in 0.71 [0.61, 0.82] at 0.91, 0.64–0.89 below. Pooled over both directions, the large pair reaches 0.78 [0.72, 0.85] at σ = 0.91 \sigma{=}0.91 , the last step of the word’s acting windows; above it, the pooled rate is at most 0.69, the later steps prefer the true large count more often than the early ones (difference 0.10 [0.04, 0.15]), and at the noisiest steps both large counts lean toward “twelve”. Separation: two from four 0.90, 0.98, 0.99 and 0.98 at σ \sigma 0.98–0.91; twelve from twenty-five 0.68 [0.58, 0.77], 0.76 [0.67, 0.83], 0.76 [0.68, 0.84] and 0.83 [0.76, 0.90]. The ten plain images of twelve objects prefer “twelve” in 0.80–1.00 at high noise. At the noise levels where SD3.5-M’s layout forms, its conditional thus carries the large count, but separates it far less than the small one and leans toward the smaller word.
blocks.zh: 模型本身的图像. 探测器使用了SD3.5-M自己的U2图像中的259幅,其SAM 3的计数等于请求:平面图像要求2幅(52型的84幅图像)或4幅(37幅的50幅),自植图像要求12幅(36幅的59幅)或25幅(37幅的56幅),平面图像要求12幅(10). 这里的分类器读取对象名称: 0.97 = 0.94\sigma\0.94 和 1.00 = 0.91 on. 二对四:0.83、0.88、0.93和0.90,载于\sigma 0.98、0.96、0.94和0.91(两个物体0.81-0.92、4个0.86-0.96);在3/=1\sigma{=}1时,这两个小项都倾向于 " 四 " (两个物体0.49、4个0.86)。 12对25:12的图像更喜欢在整个高噪音步骤(0.81-0.8)中 " 十二 " ,但25的图像更喜欢 " 二十五 " ,只有0.14[0.05,0.25]和0.32[0.18,0.46],在\sigma 1和0.98,在0.54[0.39,0.68]和0.48[0.33,0.64],在0.96和0.94,在0.71[0.61,0.82],在0.91,0.64-0.89。 在两个方向上,大一对合在一起,达到0.78 [0.72,0.85],在 " = 0.91\sigma > 0.91 " 时,是该词动作窗口的最后一步;在它的上方,集合率最多为0.69, 后一步比早期步骤更倾向于真正的大数(差数0.10 [0.04,0.15]),在最短的步骤上,两个大数都倾向于 " 十二 " 。 分离:从4个0.90,0.98,0.99和0.98,在\sigma 0.98–0.91;从25个0.68 [0.58,0.77],0.76 [0.83],0.76 [0.68,0.84]和0.83 [0.90] 中分离出12个. 12个物体的10个平面图像在高噪音下更倾向于0.80-1.00中的 " 十二 " 。 在SD3.5-M的布局形态的噪声水平上,它的有条件条件因此带有大计数,但分离远小于小计数,并倾向于较小的单词.

blocks.en: An observer baseline. A small convolutional network trained on noised latents of the same images (fresh noise at each level; five folds over object types, the large pair’s training folds adding 356 self-planted grids of U1 and U3) and tested on the classifier’s own six noise draws per image and level gives a reference for what the noisy latent itself carries. Ranking images by the loss difference, SD3.5-M’s conditional separates two objects from four almost fully from σ = 0.98 \sigma{=}0.98 on (area under the curve 0.90–0.99) and twelve from twenty-five partly (0.68–0.83); with the counts written in digits it separates the large pair less (0.55–0.63; digits minus words − - 0.14 [ − - 0.19, − - 0.09]). The observer separates the twelve- and twenty-five-object grids almost fully from σ = 0.96 \sigma{=}0.96 on (0.97–1.00; 0.87 at 0.98) but the plain two- and four-object images poorly (0.65–0.68): averaged over σ \sigma 0.98–0.94, it separates the small pair worse than the conditional does, by − - 0.29 [ − - 0.36, − - 0.22]. The grids’ count is thus present in the noisy latent where the conditional reads it only partly, but the observer may read the grid’s periodic layout rather than its count, so the comparison is descriptive only.

blocks.en: Start levels in SDXL and FLUX.1-dev. Start levels were calibrated on object types outside the sets, as the largest level at which a planted grid is kept in at least half of the cells, applied to nominal levels; on the families’ own step grids they start at σ = 0.881 \sigma{=}0.881 for SDXL (nominal 0.89, step 4 of 40) and 0.933 for FLUX.1-dev (nominal 0.95, step 4 of 28). For SDXL the calibration decided between neighbouring levels; for FLUX.1-dev the earliest level tried already met it, so its start may be later than needed. SDXL’s noise scale is matched to these levels by signal-to-noise ratio, and both families receive SD3.5-M’s composites. SDXL and FLUX.1-dev were tested at this one start level each, and at large counts only.
blocks.zh: SDXL和FLUX.1-dev的启动水平. 启动水平按设定外的物体类型进行校准,这是将植入的电网保存在至少一半的电池中的最大水平,适用于名义电网;在家庭本身的台阶电网中,起始时间为:SDXL(名义0.89,第4步,第40段)为0.933(名义0.95,第28段第4步)。 就SDXL而言,在相邻水平之间决定了校准;就FLUX.1-dev而言,试验最早的水平已经达到,因此其开始时间可能晚于需要。 SDXL的噪声尺度通过信号与噪声之比与这些水平相匹配,两个家庭都得到SD3.5-M的复合材料. SDXL和FLUX. (英语). 1-dev在每一个起始阶段都进行了测试,而且基本上只进行了计算。

blocks.en: Other requests and other counters. With a planted 20 and requests of 6, 9, 16, 25, 30 or 36 instead, the requested number is drawn in 0.7% of images; across these requests and a prompt with no number, the count equals that of the agreeing render in 58% [47, 69] of images. Grounding DINO and OWLv2 undercount large grids even on clean composites; on S2’s cells whose clean composite all three counters count exactly, the net kept rate is 0.66, 0.62 and 0.43 under SAM 3, Grounding DINO and OWLv2.
blocks.zh: 其他请求和其他计数器。 所投放的20份请求以及6、9、16、25、30或36份请求,所要求的数字以0.7%的图像表示;在这些请求中,没有数字的提示,计数等于58%[47、69]的图像的商定渲染。 将DINO和OWLv2压低了大网格,甚至放在干净的复合材料上;在S2的细胞上,所有三个计数器都精确计算干净的复合材料上,在SAM 3,Grounding DINO和OWLv2下,净保持率为0.66,0.62和0.43.

blocks.en: Irregular arrangements. Planted irregular arrangements in the conflict design on S1 are kept net of chance in 0.24 of cells for a hole-free scatter (0.45 for objects on a plain ground, 0.20–0.26 under the other counters; 0.12 and 0.08 for scene-like and thin ones) and 0.23 for a jittered grid, under SAM 3.

blocks.en: The object test. On S1, each type’s grid of twenty is paired with a partner type by a greedy matching, improved by pairwise swaps, that keeps the median aspect ratio and size of their detected boxes close ( | Δ ​ log ⁡ aspect ​ | + 0.5 | ​ Δ ​ log ​ side | |\Delta\log\text{aspect}|+0.5\,|\Delta\log\text{side}| ), and the grid is asked for twenty of the partner (“a photo of twenty hamsters” on a grid of dartboards; σ = 0.909 \sigma{=}0.909 , two seeds, 96 images). SAM 3 is prompted with both names, and each detected object goes to the name with the higher score where the two names’ boxes overlap (IoU ≥ 0.5 {\geq}\,0.5 ). The prompt’s object takes most of the detected objects in 75% [65, 84] of images, and in 77% without two near-white images of one cell (a spoon grid asked for meatballs); this readout uses SAM 3 alone. The count suffers: exactly twenty of the prompt’s object appear in 27.1% [17.7, 37.5] of these images, against 56.2% when the same grids are asked for their own object (paired difference 0.29 [0.18, 0.41]). From pure noise, asked for twenty red or blue objects of the same set, the model makes the asked colour dominant in 95% [90, 99] of images, draws the object in 74% and the count exactly in 1%.
blocks.zh: 对象测试. 在S1上,每类20的网格通过贪婪的匹配与伴侣类型对齐,通过对偶互换加以改进,使其检测到的盒子的中位宽比和大小保持接近(XXX log {{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{}〕),网格要求伴侣中二十个(“二十只仓鼠的照片”在镖板的网格上;\\sigma{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{}})), =0.909\西格,2个种子,96个图像)。 SAM 3是用两个名字来提示的,每个被检测到的物体在两个名字的盒子重合的地方会转到分数较高的名称(IoU ≥ 0.5 {\geq}\,0.5 ). 提示对象在75% [65,84] 的图像中占据了大部分检测到的物体,在77%的图像中没有一个细胞的两个近白色的图像(一个勺形网格要求肉丸);这个读出单使用SAM 3. 计数受到影响:这些图像中,有20个出现在27.1%[17.7,37.5]的提示对象中,而56.2%的提示对象被要求提供自己的对象(差值为0.29[0.18,0.41])。 从纯噪声,要求同一集的二十个红色或蓝色对象,模型使被询问的颜色在95%的图像[90,99]中占据主导地位,以74%绘制对象,精确的计数为1%.

blocks.en: A planted count holds against the number word, while the object word repaints the planted grid as its own object.
blocks.zh: 一个植入的计数与数字单词相对,而对象单词将植入的网格重新漆成自己的对象.

blocks.en: F.4 Self-planting details
blocks.zh: F.4 自种详情

blocks.en: Figure 12 : Self-planting on six images drawn at random from the 80 people-counted images of U2 at the counts whose grids have only complete rows (16 types × \times 5 counts). Top: plain prompt; bottom: the same prompt and noise from a self-planted start. Counts by people; bold: exact. Three of the six are exact (59% over all 80 cells). The failures show how a planted grid goes wrong: scene-like objects turn into a scene (shelving for spice racks, a closet for wardrobes), and thin objects lose their rows.
blocks.zh: 图12:在网格只有完整行数(16类×\time 5计数)的计数中,从80个人计算的U2图像中随机抽取的6幅图像上自植. 顶部:纯即时;底部:相同的即时和自植起的噪音. 以人计数;大胆:准确. 6个细胞中有3个是准确的(占全部80个细胞的59%). 失败显示一个被植入的网格是如何出错的:类似场景的物体会变成场景(用于香料架,衣柜的衣柜),而薄的物体会失去他们的行.

blocks.en: Figure 13 : Self-planting. The model’s own small-count drawing supplies the object, a grid supplies the count, and the unchanged model, started at σ = 0.909 \sigma{=}0.909 from the cell’s own noise, supplies everything else. The plain prompt from the same noise draws 10 cream pitchers. One clean instance suffices; the canvas takes the source image’s border colour. Cell from U1, chosen to illustrate the steps.

blocks.en: Settings. The start level (step 9 of 40), the grid’s spacing and object size and the cut-out rule were set on object types outside all sets. The canvas takes the source image’s border colour, the ground on which the object was drawn. The six small drawings per type cost less than three plain 768 2 768^{2} images, and each self-planted image costs 31 of the 40 steps of one.

blocks.en: Cut-out rule. Among the six small-count draws (“two”, “three” and “four”, two seeds, 512 2 512^{2} ), SAM 3 detections are ranked in three tiers. Tier 1: score ≥ 0.8 {\geq}\,0.8 , overlap (IoU) ≤ 0.05 {\leq}\,0.05 with every other detection of score ≥ 0.3 {\geq}\,0.3 , both box sides ≥ 40 {\geq}\,40 px, not touching the border. Tier 2: score ≥ 0.6 {\geq}\,0.6 , IoU ≤ 0.20 {\leq}\,0.20 , sides ≥ 32 {\geq}\,32 px, not touching the border. Tier 3: as tier 2, touching allowed. The best tier wins, then the highest score; the box is clamped to the image. On U1, 45, 6 and 6 types received tier 1, 2 and 3 cut-outs (exact 48%, 27% and 19%), and 7 received none; on U2 45, 8 and 5 (none for 6), on U3 61 in all. Types without a cut-out count with their plain image in every rate.
blocks.zh: 截断规则. 在6个小计数图(“2”、“3”和“4”)、2个种子、512 2 512^{2}中,SAM 3检测分为三级。 1级:积分 0.8 ~ geq}\,0.8,重叠(IoU) 0.05 ~ leq}\,0.05 与每一次其他检测得分 0.3 ~ geq}\,0.3,两箱边 ~ 40 ~ geq}\,40 px,不接触边界. 第2级:分 0.6 ~ geq ~ 0.6,IoU 0.20 ~ leq ~ 0.20,侧 ~ 32 ~ geq ~ 32 px,不接触边界. 第3级:作为第2级,允许触摸. 最好的一级获胜,然后是最高的得分;盒子被夹在图像上. 在U1、45、6和6型中,有1、2和3级停产(确切比例为48%、27%和19%),有7种没有;在U2、45、8和5型中(没有6种),共有U3 61型。 类型没有切除计数 它们的平面图像 在每个速率。

blocks.en: Arrangements. All arrangements of a cell share the cut-out and its size d d . Hole-free scatter : Lloyd relaxation of random points with jitter, best of four starts by hole statistics, centres ≥ 1.2 ​ d {\geq}\,1.2d apart. Random placement : random sequential addition with centres ≥ 1.3 ​ d {\geq}\,1.3d apart, d d shrinking by 3% after each failed attempt. Grid with random scale and offset : the grid scaled about the canvas centre by a factor in [ 0.55 , 1 ] [0.55,1] and shifted.
blocks.zh: 安排 一个单元格的所有安排都共享剪切和大小 d。 无孔散射 : Lloyd放松随机点与焦躁,最好的四个从孔统计开始,中心 1.2 d ~ geq}\,1.2d 分开. 随机放置 : 随机依次添加中心 ^ 1. 3 d ~ geq}\, 1. 3d 相隔, d 在每次尝试失败后缩小 3% 。 网格为随机缩放并抵消 : 网格在 [0.55, 1] [0.55, 1] 中将帆布中心缩放一个系数, 并移动。

blocks.en: Table 40: Self-planting on U1. Exact rate at 12–30 objects (12, 13, 17, 20, 23, 29, 30; two seeds; 896 cells per row). Δ \Delta : paired difference to the grid; 95% intervals for the grid [.291, .468], and for Δ \Delta [ − - .445, − - .275], [ − - .429, − - .260], [ − - .233, − - .129], [ − - .146, − - .066], [ − - .065, − - .008].

Counters. SAM 3 also selects the cut-out, so its judgement of self-planted images is not independent of the method; the other counters and people are. Under the other counters self-planting reaches 0.27–0.36 on U2 ( Tab. 41 ).
blocks.zh: 计数器。 SAM 3也选择了切片,因此其对自植图像的判断并不独立于方法;其他计数器和人都是独立的. 在其他计数器下,U2上的自植达到0.27-0.36(表41)。

blocks.en: Rows and the object type. Reading rows from the SAM 3 boxes on U1, a complete last row of a planted grid comes out right in 99–100% of the cells whose upper rows are intact, a partial one in 64–81%; the grid beats a hole-free scatter of the same cut-outs by 0.22 [0.15, 0.29] at counts with complete rows and by 0.04 [0.00, 0.09] at the others (U2: 0.19 [0.13, 0.26] at 12, 20 and 30). Types that would have passed the screened sets’ visibility check reach 0.46–0.50 on the three unscreened sets, the others 0.19–0.33; in a variance decomposition of U1’s grids the object type accounts for 52% of the variance of the per-image exact outcome and the count for 7%.
blocks.zh: 行和对象类型。 从U1上的SAM 3盒读出一整排的植入网格,在上排完好无损的细胞中,有99-100%的细胞右出,有64-81%的部分;网格以0.22 [0.15,0.29]在整排计数时击败同一切口的无孔散射,以0.04 [0.00,0.09]在其他细胞(U2:0.19 [0.13,0.26]在12,20和30时击败. 原本会通过筛选的套件的能见度检查类型在三套未筛选的套件上达到0.46–0.50,其他为0.19–0.33;在U1网格的分解差异中,对象类型占每个图像准确结果的52%,计为7%。

blocks.en: The third unscreened set. On U3 (64 types, mostly furniture, appliances and animals; 61 with a cut-out; two seeds) self-planting is exact in 21–54% of images at each count from 12 to 30, against 0–10% for the plain prompt from the same noise; by class, in 69% of images of objects drawn on a plain ground, 36% of thin objects and 27% of scene-like ones.
blocks.zh: 第三无屏集. 在U3(64种,主要是家具、电器和动物;61种有切口;2种种子)上,从12到30的每个计数中,21-54%的图像是自我栽培的,而同样噪音产生的平原即刻栽培的图像是0-10%;按类别,在平原上提取的物体的图像是69%,稀薄物体的36%和场景状物体的27%。

blocks.en: Look. PickScore [ 28 ] of the self-planted image minus the plain image of the same cell: − 0.65 -0.65 [ − - 0.80, − - 0.51], − 0.57 -0.57 [ − - 0.72, − - 0.43] and − 0.85 -0.85 [ − - 1.03, − - 0.68] on the three unscreened sets. On U2, exact renders lose less ( − 0.45 -0.45 ) than failed ones ( − 0.67 -0.67 ), and the grid scores above the hole-free scatter ( + 0.07 +0.07 [0.03, 0.12]).
A complete grid of the model’s own object sets the count best; the object type matters more than the count, and scene-like and thin objects fail most.
blocks.zh: 模型自己对象的完整网格设置计数最好;对象类型比计数更重要,而场景类和细小对象最失败.

blocks.en: F.5 Two layout models given the same grid
blocks.zh: F.5 联合国 两个布局模式给定相同的网格

blocks.en: GLIGEN [ 33 ] with the public text-box checkpoint ( gligen-1-4-generation-text-box , revision d2820dc , a SD 1.4 backbone) in diffusers, at 512 2 512^{2} with 50 steps and guidance 7.5. For every cell of U2 it receives the boxes of the self-planted grid: each grid centre as a square box of the grid’s object size, one phrase per box (“a cream pitcher”), and the prompt “a photo of twenty cream pitchers”. We use two grounding schedules from the same noise: the authors’ scheduled sampling, which grounds the first 30% of steps ( β = 0.3 \beta{=}0.3 ), and grounding at every step ( β = 1 \beta{=}1 ). The checkpoint’s NSFW filter, which blanks an image when it fires, is off, as SD3.5-M has none. Two seeds per cell, 2,304 images, counted like every other image. Where SAM 3 finds the object, GLIGEN turns partial grids into rectangles: given the 14 boxes of a 4 × 4 4{\times}4 grid with two missing, it draws 16 objects in 76% of those images (82% with β = 0.3 \beta{=}0.3 ) and 14 in none.
blocks.zh: GLIGEN [33] 带有公共文本箱检查站(gligen-1-4-gen-text-box,修订版d2820dc,一个SD 1.4主干线)在扩散器中,位于512 2 512^{2}有50步和指导7.5. 对于每个U2细胞,它接收自植网格的盒子:每个网格中心作为网格物体大小的方形盒,每盒一个短语(“奶油投子”),以及即时的“20个奶油投子的照片”。 我们使用来自同一噪音的两个搁浅时间表:作者的预定采样,这些采样将前30%的步骤(β = 0.3\β{=}0.3)和每个步骤(β = 1\β{=}1)搁浅。 检查站的NSFW过滤器在发射时会空白一个图像, 每个细胞有两个种子,2,304个图像,像其他图像一样计算. 在 SAM 3 找到对象的地方, GLIGEN 将部分网格变为矩格: 鉴于一个 4× 4 4 4} 4 个网格中的 14 个盒中缺少两个, 它在这些图像的 76% ( 其中 82% 的 β = 0.3\β 0.3) 和 无 14 个

blocks.en: InstanceAssemble [ 62 ] , SD3 -Medium version, with the authors’ released code (commit 39f98cd , run unchanged) and weights, their pinned library versions and their default settings: 50 steps, guidance 7.0, grounding for the first 30% of steps, layout scale 1.0, bf16, at its native 1024 2 1024^{2} . It receives the same boxes (scaled to 1024 2 1024^{2} ), one phrase per box and the same prompt as GLIGEN; the generator is seeded on the GPU as in the authors’ script. All layout weights load as in the authors’ own loader. 1,152 images, two seeds per cell. Where SAM 3 finds the object, InstanceAssemble is exact in 80–90% of images at complete counts and 57–60% at partial ones; at 14 boxes it draws 16 objects in 23% of those images and 14 in 58%, and it never drops a partial row.
blocks.zh: 案例Assemble [62], SD3 - Medium 版本, 作者发布代码(承诺39f98cd, 运行不变)和权重, 其被绑定的库版本及其默认设置: 50 步, 引导 7. 0 为前30%的步, 排版比例为 1.0, bf16, 原版为 1024 2 1024^{2} . 它接收到相同的盒(缩写为1024 2 1024^{2}),每个盒一个短语,和GLIGEN一样的提示;生成器和作者的脚本一样在GPU上播种. 所有布局的重量都与作者自己的装载器一样。 1,152幅图像,每个细胞有两个种子. 在 SAM 3 找到对象时, EctoryAssemble 精确地在 80–90% 的图像完全计数中,在 57–60% 的 部分 中;在 14 个 框 中, 它在 23% 的 图像 中 抽取 16 个对象,在 58% 中抽取 14 个对象, 并且它从不掉一行 。

blocks.en: Figure 14 : The same cells drawn three ways (the first four types with a cut-out of U2, asked for 20, seed 1; SAM 3 count under each image). GLIGEN fills each box of the grid, but often with an icon of something else: houses for cribs, ovals for capes. The koala tiles are counted in one schedule and not in the other.
blocks.zh: 图14:同一组细胞画了三种方法(前四类有U2切出,要求20,种子1;SAM3在每个图像下计数). GLIGEN填充网格的每个盒子,但经常会有一个其他东西的图标:婴儿床的房屋,斗篷的椭圆形. 考拉瓦片在一个表中计算,而不是在另一个表中计算.

blocks.en: Table 41 : Two layout models given the self-planted grid (U2; exact rates unless stated; SAM 3 below the first block; none of the asked object: SAM 3 finds none). For GLIGEN the difference to self-planting, paired on type, count and seed, is 0.25 under SAM 3 for either schedule ([0.17, 0.33] and [0.17, 0.34]) and 0.14–0.23 under the other counters, with every interval above zero. For InstanceAssemble it is 0.08 [ − - 0.00, 0.17] under SAM 3, 0.06 [ − - 0.02, 0.15] under the consensus, 0.13 [0.07, 0.21] under OWLv2 and − - 0.11 [ − - 0.20, − - 0.01] under Grounding DINO; the counters disagree on InstanceAssemble’s images more than on any other method’s, and we compare the methods by people’s counts ( Tab. 37 ).
blocks.zh: 表41:两种布局模型,给出自植网格(U2;除非注明精确速率;SAM 3在第一个区块下方;没有被问到的对象:SAM 3找不到任何). 对GLIGEN来说,在类型、计数和种子上进行配对的自植的区别是,SAM 3中的0.25分([0.17,0.33]和[0.17,0.34]),其他计数器中的0.14–0.23分,间隔均高于0。 在SAM 3, 0.06 [ - 0.02, 0.15] 中, 在协商一致中, 在OWLv2 中, 在 0.13 [0.07, 0.21] 中, 在Grounding DNO 中, 在 − 0.11 [ − - 0.20, − - 0.01] 中, 在SAM 3, 0.06 [ - 0.02, 0.15] 中, 在协商一致意见中, 在 OWLv2 中, 在 0.13 [0.07, 021] 中, 在 而在 Grounding DNO 中, 在 0.11 [− - 0.20, − - - 0.01] 中, 反差分数 中, 在 EscentleAsemble 的图像上, 在任何其他方法上, 我们用人们的计数来比较方法(表 37) 。

blocks.en: By people, InstanceAssemble given the grid’s boxes is exact as often as self-planting within the intervals, while GLIGEN fills the boxes but often with something else ( Tab. 37 ).
blocks.zh: 人们认为,“实例组合”给电网的盒子的精确度与在间隔内自我种植的精确度相同,而GLIGEN则填满盒子,但常常填满其他东西(表37)。

blocks.en: F.6 FLUX.2 [klein] from a planted start
blocks.zh: F.6 FLUX.2 从一个植入的起始点[鸣]

blocks.en: Design. The composites are U2’s own-cut-out grids of the content test ( Sec. F.2 ), that is, SD3.5-M’s cut-outs on their 768 2 768^{2} canvas, for the 58 types with a cut-out at 12, 16, 20, 25 and 30 objects (290 starts). Each is resized to 1024 2 1024^{2} , encoded as the pipeline encodes reference images (the VAE’s mode, 2 × 2 2{\times}2 patches, the VAE’s normalisation statistics) and mixed with the cell’s own noise at the level of step k k of the model’s 50-step schedule ( Eq. 3 ); the unchanged pipeline then runs the remaining 50 − k 50-k steps of that schedule with the plain prompt. Each render therefore shares prompt and noise with the plain image of the same cell in Sec. C.5 .
blocks.zh: 设计. 复合材料是U2自己在内容测试(Sec.F.2)中剪除的网格,即SD3.5-M在他们的768 2 768^{2}帆布上的剪除,用于在12、16、20、25和30个物体(290个开始)上剪除的58种。 每一个都调整为1024 2 1024\},编码为管道编码参考图像(VAE模式,2×2 2\times}2补丁,VAE的正常化统计),并在模型的50步时间表(Eq. 3)的k级上与电池本身的噪音混合;没有改变的管道随即运行该时间表的其余50-k 50-k级与平速。 因此,每种变异都与Sec.C.5中同一细胞的平面图像一样迅速发出噪音。

blocks.en: Start level. The level was set on 24 development grids of twenty objects (U1 types, none in U2): the smallest k ∈ { 16 , 20 , 24 , 28 } k\in\{16,20,24,28\} at which SAM 3 counts exactly twenty in at least half of the renders. SAM 3 kept 0.79, 0.83, 0.83 and 0.88, so k = 16 k{=}16 ( σ = 0.941 \sigma{=}0.941 ). As checks, k = 0 k{=}0 reproduces the word test’s sampler and k = 46 k{=}46 returns the composite.
blocks.zh: 启动关卡 。 该关卡设定在24个开发网格上,共有20个对象(U1型,U2型无):最小的k {{{ 16, 20, 24, 28}} k\in 16, 20, 24, 28} 其中SAM 3在至少一半的成份中精确计算为20个. SAM 3保留了0.79,0.83,0.83和0.88,因此k=16 k{=}16(\\sigma\0=0.941). 由于检查,k=0 k{=}0复制了单词测试的采样器,k=46 k{=}46返回复合体.

blocks.en: Flat renders. A check for flat images (grey standard deviation below 0.03, or mean outside [ 0.03 , 0.97 ] [0.03,0.97] ) flags 26 of the 290 U2 renders, which are kept. The 14 among the 16 people-counted types are low-contrast grids (pale bath mats, spice racks, white ironing boards, and desks whose cut-outs look like stools). People find the asked count in 9 of them, none of them desks (they count twice the request or none), and judge the ironing boards at 30 not to look like ironing boards.
blocks.zh: 平面变形 检查平面图像(灰色标准偏差低于0.03,或指外[0.03,0.97]][0.03,0.97]]290 U2制成的旗26,保存. 在16种人统计的种类中,14种是低混凝土网格(板浴垫,香料架,白色熨斗板,以及切口看起来像凳子的桌子). 人们在其中的9个中发现被询问的计数器,没有一张桌子(他们数到要求的两倍或没有),30岁时就判断熨斗板不似熨斗板.

blocks.en: Table 42 : FLUX.2 [klein] from the planted grids (U2, 58 types with a cut-out × \times 12, 16, 20, 25, 30, seed 1; exact rates unless stated; plain: the word test’s image of the same cell). blocks.en: F.7 Noise re-layout past ten
blocks.zh: F.7 联合国 十点后噪声重播

blocks.en: Method and settings. Gu et al . [ 17 ] with the released code (commit d5d49ba , single-object pipeline, the README’s library versions), SDXL base 1.0 in fp16 with its DDPM scheduler, 50 steps, guidance 5.0, 1024 2 1024^{2} and every released hyperparameter. A first pass from the cell’s noise is counted by Grounding DINO, the method’s gate, and an image already at the asked count is kept. Otherwise the object token’s cross-attention, averaged over the first 20 steps, is clustered into the requested number of high-attention regions, the noise is re-laid around them, and a second pass guided by an attention loss over its first 20 steps renders the result. Documented differences from the release: (1) the gate runs the Hugging Face port of the same Grounding DINO weights, because the released call passes undefined names; (2) the object token is the noun’s first token after the number word, which is what the released script’s fixed index selects for its own prompts; (3) with fewer high-attention cells than requested, the released fallback of one cluster per cell is kept and the re-layout runs over those clusters, where the released loop indexes past its end and stops; (4) one seed per type, shared by its requests, instead of 42 for every prompt; (5) no attention-map figures; (6) self-attention runs PyTorch’s fused attention, the same function, which fits the guided pass into an L4’s memory at 1024 2 1024^{2} . A method error other than running out of memory leaves the first pass as the output. Settings were set after a probe on two types outside the sets.
blocks.zh: 方法与设置. Gu et al. [17] 与发布代码(承诺d5d49ba,单对象管道,README的库版本),Fp16中的SDXL Base 1.0及其DDPM调度器,50步,指向5.0,1024 2 1024^{2}和每个发布超参数. 手机噪音的第一通道通过该方法的门Grounding DINO进行计数,并且保留了已经出现在被询问的计数处的图像。 否则,对象符号的交叉注意(平均在前20个步骤上)被组合成要求的高注意区域的数目,周围的噪音被重新贴上,并且由于前20个步骤上的注意力损失而导致第二次通过。 有文件记载的与发行的区别:(1) 闸门运行着同一地平线DINO重量的Hugging Face端口,因为发行的呼号通过未定义的名称;(2) 对象符是数字单词之后名词的第一个代号,这是发行的脚本的固定索引选择给它自己的提示;(3) 每个单元的释放回放量比要求的要少,而且重播流过这些集群,释放的循环指数经过它的结束和停止;(4) 每类种子一个,由它的请求共享,而不是42个;(5) 无注意图数字;(6) 自留心运行PyTorch的引信注意,同样的功能,它符合在1024 2 1024\2}时被引导传入L4的记忆。 除内存耗尽之外的方法错误会留下第一个传球作为输出. 设置是在探测器外的两个类型之后设置的。

blocks.en: A layout misses differently from a word. Of the images whose SAM 3 count lands within one of the request, 80–94% are exact for grids planted at σ = 0.909 \sigma{=}0.909 or given as boxes, against 66–77% for irregular arrangements of the same cut-outs and 37–48% for the plain prompt; a count that followed the request with log-normal scatter of 5% or more would give at most 0.48 ( Tab. 44 ). When a grid fails, it mostly fails by more than one object.
